## File: docs/16-worker.md

# 16 · Worker (Redis + BullMQ)

Slow or outward-facing work runs outside the request, in a **worker process**: the same code, config
and services as the API, with a second entry point (`src/worker.ts`). The API puts jobs in Redis with
[BullMQ](https://docs.bullmq.io); any number of workers take them.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  C["Client"] -- "startDocumentJob / requestPasswordReset" --> API["api (src/main.ts)"]
  API -- "Queue.add" --> R[("Redis<br/>QUEUE_PREFIX:mail · :documents")]
  R --> W1["worker #1 (src/worker.ts)"]
  R --> W2["worker #2"]
  W1 & W2 --> SVC["the same services<br/>(auth-kit · db-kit · report-kit · invoice-kit)"]
  SVC --> DB[("PostgreSQL / MongoDB")]
  W1 -- "mail-kit (SMTP_URL)" --> M["mail server"]
  C -- "job(id) (poll)" --> API
  API -- "Job.fromId" --> R
```

## Queues and jobs

| Queue | Job | Started by | What the worker does | Retries |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mail` | `password-reset` | `requestPasswordReset` | creates the single-use token (auth-kit), sends the link through the `Mailer` | 5, exponential from 2 s; a rate-limited request is dropped |
| `documents` | `invoice` · `booking_reports` | `startDocumentJob` | renders the stored invoice or the booking's reports (invoice-kit / report-kit) | 2; NOT_FOUND / CONFLICT / BAD_USER_INPUT fail at once |

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> waiting: startDocumentJob
  waiting --> active: a worker takes it
  active --> completed: document ready (kept JOB_RESULT_TTL_MS, default 1 h)
  active --> delayed: error, retry with back-off
  delayed --> active
  active --> failed: no retries left, or a domain error
  completed --> [*]
  failed --> [*]
```

## Security

- **No raw token in Redis.** A password-reset job carries only `{ email, orgCode, ip }`; the worker
  creates the token and hands it straight to the mailer. The test suite checks the queue keys.
- **Same answer for every email.** `requestPasswordReset` only enqueues, so its timing does not reveal
  whether the account exists.
- **Permissions at the door, user re-read at work.** `startDocumentJob` loads the record and checks
  `invoice:read` / `report:read` on its branch before queueing. The worker re-reads the user and fails
  the job when the user has been disabled or moved.
- **Only the owner reads a job.** Job ids are random UUIDs, and `job(id)` returns null unless the
  signed-in user started it (same organisation).
- Job errors shown to clients are domain messages or "Rendering failed"; stack traces stay in the worker log.

## Running

```bash
REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379 npm run dev            # API
REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379 npm run worker:dev     # worker (watch)

npm run build && npm start                              # production API: dist/main.js
npm run worker                                          # production worker: dist/worker.js
```

The worker refuses to start without `REDIS_URL`. **Without Redis** the API runs jobs in its own
process at once (`createInlineJobQueue`): same GraphQL, same results, the request just waits. That is
what development and one-server installs get.

| Variable | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `REDIS_URL` | — | Turns on BullMQ; required by the worker |
| `QUEUE_PREFIX` | `mgpl` | Redis key prefix (separate apps or environments) |
| `WORKER_CONCURRENCY` | `4` | Jobs per worker at once, per queue |
| `JOB_RESULT_TTL_MS` | `3600000` | How long finished jobs (and their documents) stay readable |
| `SMTP_URL`, `MAIL_FROM` | — | Mail through mail-kit (our mail design language → HTML + text, sent over SMTP) |
| `MAIL_WEBHOOK_URL` | — | Fallback when `SMTP_URL` is not set: POST `{ to, subject, text }` JSON to a relay |

Shutdown (`SIGTERM`) lets the jobs in hand finish, then closes the database.

## From the client

```ts
const job = await mgpl.documents.startJob({ kind: "invoice", invoiceId });
const done = await mgpl.documents.waitForJob(job.id);       // polls job(id); throws if it failed
openBlob(documentBlob(done.document!));
```

## Adding a job

1. Its payload type in `src/jobs/types.ts` (ids and the actor, never secrets), and a method on `JobQueue`.
2. A processor in `src/jobs/processors.ts` that calls services. Throw `JobFailure(message, false)` when
   retrying cannot help.
3. Add it to both queues: `bullmq.ts` (`Queue.add`, a `Worker`) and `inline.ts`.
4. A service method that enqueues it; a controller that checks permissions first.
5. Tests: the in-process path in `suite()` and the BullMQ path in `workerSuite()` (`test/run.ts`).

Repeatable jobs (a nightly day-end reminder, say) use `queue.upsertJobScheduler(...)` in the worker entry.


---

## File: docs/LOCAL-AGENT-BRIEF.md

# Brief for the local agent: what to do outside this repo

**Audience:** an AI agent (Claude Code or similar) or a developer working on the owner's machine with
an org-owner GitHub login (`gh auth status`), Node 22, and Docker or local databases.
**Why local:** the cloud session that built this API could not create releases or tags (403), change org
settings, or download MongoDB binaries. Everything below needs one of those.
**Written:** 2026-10-14, when `mgpl-diagnostics/api` was first published.

Work top to bottom. Each step says how to check it is done. Report back with the checklist at the end.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["1 · Protect the api repo"] --> B["2 · Run the Mongo tests locally"]
  B --> C["3 · Release client 1.1.0"]
  C --> D["4 · Publish finance-kit 1.0.0"]
  D --> E{"5 · tally-kit name<br/>confirmed by owner?"}
  E -- yes --> F["publish tally-kit"]
  E -- no --> G["leave unpublished"]
  F & G --> H["6 · Package access for api's Actions"]
  H --> I["7 · Switch api CI to the registry"]
  I --> J["8 · db-kit 2.0.0: remove src/graphql"]
  J --> K["9 · Deploy + seed"]
  K --> L["10 · CA review"]
  L --> M["11 · Tokens, worker, device binding"]
```

## Ground rules

- `main` in every repo takes pull requests only (squash, 1 code-owner review by `@BackStacked`, the
  `ci` check). Never push to `main`; never force-push someone else's branch.
- Release tags `v*` are admin-only and publish packages (`publish.yml`). Bump the version in a PR first,
  merge it, then tag the merge commit.
- Never commit real patient data, signatures, `.env` files or tokens.
- **Ask the owner before changing any value marked "verify with CA"** (GST rates, TDS sections and
  rates, thresholds).
- **Do not release tally-kit until the owner confirms its final package name** ("Tally" is a trademark).

## 1. Protect the api repo

In `mgpl-diagnostics/.github`, `scripts/protect-repos.mjs` lists required checks per repo in `CHECKS`.
Add `api: ["ci"]` (a PR from the cloud session may already do this; check first), merge, then:

```bash
cd .github && node scripts/protect-repos.mjs api
```

Done when: `gh api repos/mgpl-diagnostics/api/rulesets` lists "main" and "release tags", and a direct
push to `api/main` is refused.

## 2. Run the full test suite with MongoDB

The cloud session ran the api's tests on PostgreSQL only (MongoDB downloads were blocked); CI runs both.
Confirm locally:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/api && cd api
npm run kits
npm test                                   # both backends; first run downloads mongod and postgres
# behind a proxy: MONGOMS_SYSTEM_BINARY=$(which mongod) npm test
```

Done when: `… passed, 0 failed` with both `[pg]` and `[mongo]` sections. If Mongo fails and Postgres
passes, the bug is backend-specific: reproduce it in db-kit's contract suite and fix it there (rule 1 of
db-kit's AGENTS.md: both backends behave identically).

## 3. Release client 1.1.0

The GraphQL client (`createMgplGraphQLClient`) was merged with version `1.1.0` in package.json.

```bash
cd client && git checkout main && git pull
git tag v1.1.0 && git push origin v1.1.0        # publish.yml publishes to GitHub Packages
```

Done when: `npm view @mgpl-diagnostics/client@1.1.0 --registry https://npm.pkg.github.com` works.

## 4. Publish finance-kit 1.0.0

finance-kit has no tag yet. Its package.json says `1.0.0`.

```bash
cd finance-kit && git checkout main && git pull && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
git tag v1.0.0 && git push origin v1.0.0
```

Done when: the publish workflow is green and the package is visible in the org's packages.

## 5. tally-kit: name, then publish

Ask the owner to confirm the final package name (tally-kit's AGENTS.md rule 7). Only then, tag
`v0.1.0` (or the renamed package) and publish. If the name changes, update every `@mgpl-diagnostics/tally-kit`
import and dependency (finance-kit, api) in one coordinated set of PRs.

## 6. Give the api repo access to the packages

For each package (auth-kit, catalog-kit, db-kit, report-kit, invoice-kit, client, finance-kit,
tally-kit): GitHub → org → Packages → the package → Package settings → **Manage Actions access** → add
`mgpl-diagnostics/api` with **Read**. (Alternatively make the packages public.)

Done when: a workflow in api can `npm install` them with `GITHUB_TOKEN`.

## 7. Switch api CI from source builds to the registry

Today `npm run kits` (scripts/kits.mjs) clones each kit at the ref in `kits.json` and builds it, because
the packages were not all published or readable. After steps 3–6:

1. In `api/.github/workflows/ci.yml`: replace `npm run kits` with
   ```yaml
   - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
     with: { node-version: 22, registry-url: https://npm.pkg.github.com, scope: "@mgpl-diagnostics" }
   - run: npm install
     env: { NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" }
   ```
   and add `packages: read` to the workflow `permissions`.
2. Add `"@mgpl-diagnostics/client": "^1.1.0"` to api's devDependencies (today `npm run kits` installs it without saving), so the client contract test
   uses the released client.
3. Commit a `package-lock.json` (`npm install` with the registry configured).
4. Keep `scripts/kits.mjs` and `kits.json` for building unreleased kit branches locally (`KITS_SRC`).
5. Update docs/03-getting-started.md and docs/11-testing.md (they describe `npm run kits` as the default).

Done when: api CI is green with the registry install.

## 8. db-kit 2.0.0: remove the old GraphQL layer

db-kit still carries `src/graphql/` and the `./graphql` export (see db-kit
`docs/MOVE-GRAPHQL-TO-BACKEND.md`). The api replaces it. Removing an export is a breaking change:

1. db-kit PR: delete `src/graphql/`, the `./graphql` export and entry, its tests and graphql peer
   dependencies; update README / AGENTS.md / llms; mark the handoff doc "done (moved to mgpl-diagnostics/api)";
   version `2.0.0`.
2. Before tagging, widen the peer ranges in **finance-kit** and **tally-kit** to
   `"@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit": "^1.1.0 || ^2.0.0"` (PRs, with their tests green against 2.0.0).
3. Tag db-kit `v2.0.0`; release finance-kit/tally-kit patch versions with the widened ranges.
4. Bump api to `^2.0.0` and run its tests on both backends.

Done when: no repo imports `@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit/graphql` (`gh search code "db-kit/graphql" --owner mgpl-diagnostics`).

## 9. Deploy and seed

Follow [12-deployment.md](12-deployment.md). In particular:

- `REDIS_URL` for more than one server; `CORS_ORIGINS` set to the app origins; `TRUST_PROXY=true`.
- Real signature images in a secret volume, `MGPL_SIGNATURE_HEADER_FILE` / `MGPL_SIGNATURE_NONHEADER_FILE`.
  Never commit them.
- `JWT_SECRET` from your secret store (≥ 32 random characters: `openssl rand -base64 48`), the same on every API server and worker.
- Run at least one worker: `node dist/worker.js` with `REDIS_URL` and the API's environment.
- `SMTP_URL` + `MAIL_FROM` (mail-kit sends over SMTP) for password-reset links, and `PASSWORD_RESET_URL`.
- `npm run seed` once, with the branch's GST state code (`SEED_BRANCH_STATE`, 22 for Chhattisgarh) and
  the organisation's GSTIN (`SEED_ORG_GSTIN`); billing needs the first, GST returns the second.
- Add every other branch with `createBranch` **including its `stateCode`**.

Done when: `GET /health` → 200, an owner can sign in, issue an invoice, and print it.

## 10. CA review (owner + CA, not the agent)

Call `verifyWithCA` and `taxRules` after `seedTaxRules`, and give the list to the lab's chartered
accountant. The agent records answers only as the owner instructs (`addTaxRule`, `settings.finance`);
it never picks rates itself. finance-kit's `docs/gst-notes.md` explains each item.

## 11. Tokens, worker, device binding

Added after the first release (auth-kit 1.2.0, client 1.2.0, api with JWT and the worker).

- **Tag the releases.** auth-kit: bump nothing (package.json already says 1.2.0), tag `v1.2.0` on
  `main`'s head. client: tag `v1.2.0` on `main`'s head. Done when both appear on GitHub Packages.
  Then, in step 7, point `kits.json` / `package.json` at those versions.
- **Redis in production** is now required for more than one server *and* for the worker. Create it
  with AOF persistence if queued emails must survive a restart.
- **Run the worker** next to the API (same image, command `node dist/worker.js`), at least one, with
  `WORKER_CONCURRENCY` sized to the CPU (rendering is CPU-bound). Check its log line
  `[worker] queues mail, documents on mgpl:`.
- **Email.** Set `SMTP_URL` (e.g. `smtps://user:app-password@smtp.example.com:465`) and `MAIL_FROM`;
  mail-kit sends the mails. The provider's SPF/DKIM must cover the sending domain. Done when "Forgot
  password" delivers a link.
- **Secret rotation drill.** Set `JWT_SECRET=new,old`, deploy, wait 15 minutes, set `JWT_SECRET=new`.
- **Device binding** is `enforce` by default. If staff share browsers or wipe storage often and get
  signed out, switch to `DEVICE_BINDING=flag` and read the `auth.device_mismatch` audit entries first.
- **Privacy notice.** The client sends device signals (list in the client's `docs/session.md`); add
  them to the lab's privacy notice before going live.
- **security-kit.** The client collects device signals with security-kit, and the api uses it for
  security headers and the client IP. Publish it (see the shared brief's security-kit step), then switch
  the client's git dev dependency on it to `^0.2.0`.

Done when: a login survives an access-token expiry without the user noticing, a reset email arrives,
and `startDocumentJob` completes with a worker running.

```

## File: llms.txt

# @mgpl-diagnostics/api

> The MGPL Diagnostics backend (Node.js ≥ 20, TypeScript): one GraphQL endpoint, `POST /graphql` (GraphQL Yoga on Fastify), for sign-in, users and roles, the test catalog, patients, bookings, samples, results and reports, billing, double-entry books, GST returns, B2B receivables, partner settlements, cash and bank, lock dates, CSV exports, and rendered report/invoice documents (base64 PDF or HTML). The kits (auth, db, catalog, report, invoice, tally, finance) are internal libraries behind a controller → service layer. PostgreSQL or MongoDB; Redis optional.

Key facts for agents:
- Layers: `src/schema` (SDL) → `src/controllers` (authorize, map) → `src/services` (kit calls) → kits. No REST routes except `GET /health`.
- Auth: `login(input: { email, password, device })` returns an access JWT (15 min, Bearer) and a single-use refresh token; `refreshSession(refreshToken, device)` rotates them; a refresh from another deviceId ends the session (DEVICE_BINDING). Every request still checks the session and re-reads the user. `JWT_SECRET` required in production.
- Worker: `src/worker.ts` (`npm run worker`) runs BullMQ jobs from Redis (`src/jobs/`): password-reset emails (MAIL_WEBHOOK_URL) and documents (`startDocumentJob`, `job(id)`). Without REDIS_URL jobs run in the API process. Permissions are `resource:action`, checked per branch with `authorize(ctx, perm, branchId)`.
- Tenant isolation: orgId and actorId come from the session, never from arguments; every id is checked against the organisation.
- Errors carry `extensions.code`: UNAUTHENTICATED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, BAD_USER_INPUT, CONFLICT, PERIOD_LOCKED, CREDIT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, plus auth-kit codes. Unknown errors are masked.
- Money is integer paise; days are IST "YYYY-MM-DD"; the financial year is April–March. Billing needs the branch's GST stateCode; GSTR-1/3B need the organisation's GSTIN.
- Frontends use `createMgplGraphQLClient` from `@mgpl-diagnostics/client`.
- Generated files (CI-checked): schema.graphql (`npm run schema`), docs/04-api-reference.md (`npm run docs:reference`), llms-full.txt (`npm run llms`).

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it is, quick start
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): index of the A-to-Z docs (architecture, getting started, API reference, errors, auth, flows, documents, configuration, data and money, testing, deployment, adding a feature, client, glossary)
- [docs/04-api-reference.md](docs/04-api-reference.md): every operation with its permission
- [docs/LOCAL-AGENT-BRIEF.md](docs/LOCAL-AGENT-BRIEF.md): releases, org settings and deployment to do outside this repo
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): map and rules
- [schema.graphql](schema.graphql): the SDL
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): everything above plus the source

## Source

- [src/server.ts](src/server.ts): Fastify + Yoga, one endpoint
- [src/container.ts](src/container.ts): db, auth, job queue, services
- [src/worker.ts](src/worker.ts): the worker entry
- [src/jobs/](src/jobs/): queues, processors, mailer
- [src/graphql/](src/graphql/): context, guards, errors, scalars, loaders, schema assembly
- [src/schema/](src/schema/): SDL per module
- [src/controllers/](src/controllers/): resolvers per module
- [src/services/](src/services/): business logic on the kits
- [test/run.ts](test/run.ts): end-to-end suite

type AccountGroup {

"""
Security signals the client sends with login and refreshSession (the client SDK collects them).
All optional; malformed values are dropped. See docs/06-authentication.md.
"""
input DeviceInput {
  """Random id per tab or app run."""
  clientSessionId: String

  """
  Random id the client keeps per browser profile or app install (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . : + / = -).
  """
  deviceId: String

  """
  Client-side hash of stable device attributes. A change is logged, never blocked.
  """
  fingerprint: String

  """
  Descriptive values: at most 20 keys, short strings, numbers or booleans.
  """
  info: JSON
}

"""
Background work run by the worker (BullMQ on Redis), or in the API process when there is no Redis.
"""
type Job {
  """Tries so far (failed jobs are retried with back-off)."""
  attempts: Int!
  createdAt: DateTime!

  """The rendered document (state completed). Kept for an hour by default."""
  document: Document

  """Why it failed (state failed)."""
  error: String
  finishedAt: DateTime
  id: ID!
  kind: DocumentJobKind!
  state: JobState!
}

enum JobState {
  active
  completed
  delayed
  failed
  waiting
}

input LoginInput {
  device: DeviceInput
  email: String!

  """Only when the same email exists in several organisations."""
  orgCode: String
  password: String!
}

"""
Tokens after login or refresh. Send the access token as 'Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>'; when
it expires (UNAUTHENTICATED), trade the refresh token for a new pair with refreshSession.
"""
type LoginResult {
  accessExpiresAt: DateTime!

  """
  Short-lived HS256 JWT (default 15 minutes). Every request still checks the session and re-reads the user.
  """
  accessToken: String!

  """Same as accessExpiresAt."""
  expiresAt: DateTime! @deprecated(reason: "Use accessExpiresAt.")

  """
  Slides with each refresh (idle window), never past the session's maximum age.
  """
  refreshExpiresAt: DateTime!

  """
  Opaque and single-use: refreshSession returns the next one. The server stores only its SHA-256.
  """
  refreshToken: String!

  """Same as accessToken."""
  token: String! @deprecated(reason: "Use accessToken.")
  user: User!
}

type Mutation {
  accrueSettlement(id: ID!): Settlement!
  addAgreement(input: AgreementInput!): PartnerAgreement!
  addTaxRule(input: TaxRuleInput!): TaxRule!
  amendReport(id: ID!): Report!
  cancelBooking(id: ID!): Booking!
  cancelInvoice(id: ID!, reason: String!): Invoice!
  cancelSettlement(id: ID!): Settlement!
  cancelVoucher(id: ID!): Voucher!
  changePassword(currentPassword: String!, newPassword: String!): Boolean!
  closeCashDay(input: CloseCashDayInput!): CashClosing!

  """Closing vouchers on 31 March and a lock. fy: 2026-27."""
  closeFinancialYear(fy: String!): YearEndResult!
  collectSample(id: ID!): Sample!
  createBooking(input: CreateBookingInput!): CreateBookingResult!
  createBranch(input: BranchInput!): Branch!
  createCustomer(input: CustomerInput!): Customer!
  createDoctor(input: DoctorInput!): Doctor!
  createLedger(input: LedgerInput!): Ledger!
  createPartner(input: PartnerInput!): Partner!
  createReport(bookingId: ID!, testCode: String!, testName: String): Report!
  createSettlement(deductions: [SettlementDeductionInput!], partnerId: ID!, period: String!): Settlement!
  createUser(input: CreateUserInput!): User!
  disableUser(userId: ID!): User!
  enableUser(userId: ID!): User!
  importBankStatement(input: BankImportInput!): BankImportResult!
  issueCreditNote(input: CreditNoteInput!): CreditNoteResult!
  issueCustomerInvoice(input: CustomerInvoiceInput!): Invoice!
  issueInvoice(input: IssueInvoiceInput!): Invoice!
  login(input: LoginInput!): LoginResult!

  """
  Ends this session: the bearer token (even an expired access token), or the refresh token when given.
  """
  logout(refreshToken: String): Boolean!

  """Ends every other session of the signed-in user; returns how many."""
  logoutOtherSessions: Int!
  matchBankLine(lineId: ID!, voucherIds: [ID!]!): BankLine!
  paySettlement(input: PaySettlementInput!): Settlement!

  """Does nothing; lets clients check that mutations reach the server."""
  ping: String!
  postVoucher(input: PostVoucherInput!): Voucher!
  receiveSample(id: ID!): Sample!
  reconcileBank(ledgerId: ID!, statementId: ID): ReconcileResult!
  recordPayment(invoiceId: ID!, payment: PaymentInput!): Invoice!

  """
  Spends a refresh token and returns a new access token and the next refresh token. A refresh token
  used twice ends its session (it was copied); within a few seconds (two tabs) the second use only fails.
  Send the same device as at login: a refresh from another device id ends the session (DEVICE_BINDING).
  INVALID_TOKEN when it is unknown, spent or expired: sign in again.
  """
  refreshSession(device: DeviceInput, refreshToken: String!): LoginResult!
  refundPayment(invoiceId: ID!, payment: PaymentInput!): Invoice!
  registerPatient(input: RegisterPatientInput!): Patient!
  rejectSample(id: ID!, reason: String!): Sample!
  releaseReport(id: ID!): Report!

  """
  Always true (never reveals whether the email exists). Queued: the worker creates the single-use token and mails the link.
  """
  requestPasswordReset(email: String!, orgCode: String): Boolean!
  resetPassword(newPassword: String!, token: String!): Boolean!
  revokeSession(id: ID!): Boolean!
  saveResults(reportId: ID!, results: [ResultInput!]!): Report!

  """
  finance-kit's starting rules. Every rate must be verified with the lab's CA.
  """
  seedTaxRules: [TaxRule!]!
  setBankLineStatus(lineId: ID!, status: BankLineManualStatus!): BankLine!
  setLockDate(input: LockDateInput!): PeriodLock!
  setUserPassword(newPassword: String!, userId: ID!): Boolean!
  setUserRoles(roles: [RoleAssignmentInput!]!, userId: ID!): User!

  """
  Seeds the standard chart (28 groups, default ledgers) and finance-kit's ledgers. Idempotent.
  """
  setupChartOfAccounts: [Ledger!]!

  """
  Renders a stored invoice or a booking's reports in the background; poll job(id) until completed or failed.
  """
  startDocumentJob(input: DocumentJobInput!): Job!
  updateBranch(id: ID!, input: BranchPatch!): Branch!
  updateCustomer(id: ID!, input: CustomerPatch!): Customer!
  updateDoctor(id: ID!, input: DoctorPatch!): Doctor!
  updateOrganization(input: OrganizationInput!): Organization!
  updatePartner(id: ID!, input: PartnerPatch!): Partner!
  updatePatient(id: ID!, input: UpdatePatientInput!): Patient!
  upsertRole(input: RoleInput!): Role!
  verifyReport(id: ID!): Report!
}

  receivablesSummary(asOf: DateTime!): ReceivablesSummary!

  """
  Any invoice: request = invoice-kit's InvoiceRequest JSON ({ invoice } or { sample }).
  """
  renderInvoice(fileName: String, format: DocumentFormat = pdf, request: JSON!, variant: ReportVariant = header): Document!

  """
  Any report: request = report-kit's ReportRequest JSON (patient + tests | profile | report | sample).
  """
  renderReport(design: ReportDesign = sidebar, fileName: String, format: DocumentFormat = pdf, request: JSON!, variant: ReportVariant = header): Document!
  report(id: ID!): Report
  reportTemplates: TemplateCatalog!
  roles: [Role!]!
  sample(id: ID!): Sample
  sampleByBarcode(barcode: String!): Sample
  settlement(id: ID!): Settlement

  """Computes a month's settlement without saving it. period: YYYY-MM."""
  settlementPreview(deductions: [SettlementDeductionInput!], partnerId: ID!, period: String!): SettlementPreview!
  settlements(branchId: ID, limit: Int = 50, offset: Int = 0, partnerId: ID, status: SettlementStatus): [Settlement!]!
  taxRules: [TaxRule!]!
  trialBalance(asOf: DateTime, branchId: ID): TrialBalance!
  user(id: ID!): User
  users: [User!]!

  """Items the lab's CA must confirm before these values are relied on."""
  verifyWithCA: [String!]!

  """null when not signed in."""
  viewer: Viewer
  voucher(id: ID!): Voucher
}

## File: scripts/api-reference.ts

```ts
// Writes docs/04-api-reference.md from the schema (operations, arguments, return types, descriptions)
// and the controllers (the permission each resolver checks). Run `npm run docs:reference`; CI fails when it is stale.
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { GraphQLObjectType, type GraphQLField } from "graphql";
import { buildSchema, MODULES } from "../src/graphql/schema";

const root = new URL("..", import.meta.url).pathname;
const schema = buildSchema();

/** field → permissions found in its resolver body, per root type. */
function permissionsByField(): Record<"Query" | "Mutation", Map<string, Set<string>>> {
  const out = { Query: new Map<string, Set<string>>(), Mutation: new Map<string, Set<string>>() };
  for (const file of readdirSync(`${root}src/controllers`)) {
    const src = readFileSync(`${root}src/controllers/${file}`, "utf8");
    // helpers like `reportFor(ctx, id, "report:read")` pass the permission literally, so a literal scan is enough
    for (const kind of ["Query", "Mutation"] as const) {
      const start = src.indexOf(`\n  ${kind}: {`);
      if (start < 0) continue;
      const end = src.indexOf("\n  },", start);
      const block = src.slice(start, end);
      const keys = [...block.matchAll(/^ {4}(?:async )?(\w+)(?=\s*[:(])/gm)];
      keys.forEach((k, i) => {
        const body = block.slice(k.index!, keys[i + 1]?.index ?? block.length);
        const perms = new Set([...body.matchAll(/"([a-z]+:[a-z]+)"/g)].map((m) => m[1]!));
        const signedIn = /actorOf|authorize|viewerOrThrow|requireViewer/.test(body);
        if (!perms.size && signedIn) perms.add("(signed in)");
        out[kind].set(k[1]!, perms);
      });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

const perms = permissionsByField();
const moduleOf = new Map<string, string>();
for (const { name, typeDefs } of MODULES) {
  const sdl = String(typeDefs).replace(/"""[\s\S]*?"""/g, "");
  for (const kind of ["Query", "Mutation"]) {
    for (const m of sdl.matchAll(new RegExp(`type ${kind} \\{([\\s\\S]*?)\\n\\s*\\}`, "g")))
      for (const f of m[1]!.matchAll(/^\s+(\w+)\s*[(:]/gm)) moduleOf.set(`${kind}.${f[1]}`, name);
  }
}

const sig = (f: GraphQLField<unknown, unknown>) =>
  `${f.name}${f.args.length ? `(${f.args.map((a) => `${a.name}: ${a.type}`).join(", ")})` : ""}: ${f.type}`;
const one = (s?: string | null) => (s ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").replace(/\|/g, "\\|").trim();

const lines: string[] = [
  "# 04 · API reference",
  "",
  "<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:reference` (scripts/api-reference.ts). Do not edit by hand. -->",
  "",
  "Every operation of `POST /graphql`, grouped by module, with the permission its resolver checks.",
  "**Permission** lists what `authorize()` requires; a branch-scoped permission is checked against the",
  "record's branch (see [06-auth-and-permissions.md](06-auth-and-permissions.md)). `public` means no",
  "sign-in is needed; `(signed in)` means any signed-in user. The full SDL is [schema.graphql](../schema.graphql),",
  "and runnable examples are in [examples/](examples/).",
  "",
];
for (const { name } of MODULES) {
  const rows: string[] = [];
  for (const kind of ["Query", "Mutation"] as const) {
    const type = (kind === "Query" ? schema.getQueryType() : schema.getMutationType()) as GraphQLObjectType;
    for (const f of Object.values(type.getFields()).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))) {
      if (moduleOf.get(`${kind}.${f.name}`) !== name) continue;
      const p = perms[kind].get(f.name);
      const perm = p && p.size ? [...p].map((x) => (x.startsWith("(") ? x : `\`${x}\``)).join(", ") : "public";
      rows.push(`| ${kind === "Query" ? "query" : "mutation"} | \`${sig(f)}\` | ${perm} | ${one(f.description)} |`);
    }
  }
  if (!rows.length) continue;
  lines.push(`## ${name}`, "", "| Kind | Operation | Permission | Notes |", "|---|---|---|---|", ...rows, "");
}
writeFileSync(`${root}docs/04-api-reference.md`, lines.join("\n"));
console.log(`docs/04-api-reference.md: ${lines.filter((l) => l.startsWith("| q") || l.startsWith("| m")).length} operations`);
```

## File: scripts/kits.mjs

```js
// Builds every @mgpl-diagnostics kit from source into .kits/*.tgz and installs them with this repo's
// dependencies. Needed because not every kit is on GitHub Packages yet (finance-kit), and this repo's
// CI token has no package access yet. See docs/12-local-agent-brief.md for the switch to the registry.
//
//   npm run kits                       # clone each kit at the ref in kits.json (public repos, no token)
//   KITS_SRC=.. npm run kits           # use local checkouts next to this repo instead (their working tree)
//   npm run kits -- --no-install       # only build the tarballs
//
// Each kit is copied to .kits/src/<name>, its @mgpl-diagnostics dependencies are pointed at the
// tarballs built before it, it is built with tsup and packed with its ORIGINAL package.json.
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { cpSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join, resolve } from "node:path";

const root = resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..");
const out = join(root, ".kits");
const { kits } = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, "kits.json"), "utf8"));
const local = process.env.KITS_SRC ? resolve(root, process.env.KITS_SRC) : null;
const install = !process.argv.includes("--no-install");
const run = (cmd, args, cwd) => execFileSync(cmd, args, { cwd, stdio: ["ignore", "inherit", "inherit"], env: { ...process.env, npm_config_audit: "false", npm_config_fund: "false" } });
const tgz = (name) => join(out, `${name}.tgz`);

rmSync(out, { recursive: true, force: true });
mkdirSync(join(out, "src"), { recursive: true });

for (const { name, ref } of kits) {
  const dir = join(out, "src", name);
  console.log(`\n▶ ${name} (${local ? `local ${join(local, name)}` : ref})`);
  if (local) {
    cpSync(join(local, name), dir, { recursive: true, filter: (p) => !/[\\/](node_modules|dist|\.git)$/.test(p) });
  } else {
    mkdirSync(dir);
    run("git", ["init", "-q"], dir);
    run("git", ["fetch", "-q", "--depth", "1", `https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/${name}.git`, ref], dir);
    run("git", ["checkout", "-q", "FETCH_HEAD"], dir);
  }
  const pkgFile = join(dir, "package.json");
  const original = readFileSync(pkgFile, "utf8");
  const pkg = JSON.parse(original);
  // build-time view of the package: our kits come from the tarballs built so far
  for (const field of ["dependencies", "devDependencies", "peerDependencies"]) {
    for (const dep of Object.keys(pkg[field] ?? {})) {
      if (!dep.startsWith("@mgpl-diagnostics/")) continue;
      const file = tgz(dep.split("/")[1]);
      if (!existsSync(file)) throw new Error(`${name} needs ${dep}; list it earlier in kits.json`);
      pkg[field][dep] = `file:${file}`; // same field, so tsup still treats peers as external
    }
  }
  writeFileSync(pkgFile, JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2));
  run("npm", ["install", "--no-package-lock", "--ignore-scripts", "--loglevel=error"], dir);
  run("npm", ["run", "prepare"], dir);
  writeFileSync(pkgFile, original);
  run("npm", ["pack", "--ignore-scripts", "--silent", "--pack-destination", out], dir);
  const packed = readdirSync(out).find((f) => f.startsWith(`mgpl-diagnostics-${name}-`) && f.endsWith(".tgz"));
  if (!packed) throw new Error(`npm pack produced no tarball for ${name}`);
  cpSync(join(out, packed), tgz(name));
  rmSync(join(out, packed));
}

if (install) {
  console.log("\n▶ installing this repo's dependencies with the kits");
  run("npm", ["install", "--no-package-lock", "--no-save", "--loglevel=error", ...kits.map((k) => tgz(k.name))], root);
}
console.log("\n✓ kits ready");
```

## File: scripts/llms-full.mjs

````js
// Builds llms-full.txt: every doc and source file of the repo in one plain-text document for AI tools.
//   node scripts/llms-full.mjs "<title>" <file-or-folder> [file-or-folder …]
// Folders are walked recursively. Output order: README, AGENTS, docs, then the rest alphabetically.
// Skipped: build output, dependencies, lockfiles, generated files, binaries. Files over 150 KB are
// listed (path + size) instead of inlined. CI checks the file is up to date (`npm run llms` + git diff).
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { extname, join, relative } from "node:path";

const [title, ...inputs] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!title || !inputs.length) {
  console.error('usage: node scripts/llms-full.mjs "<title>" <file-or-folder> …');
  process.exit(1);
}

const TEXT = new Set([".ts", ".tsx", ".mts", ".cts", ".js", ".mjs", ".cjs", ".md", ".mdx", ".json", ".css", ".yml", ".yaml", ".txt", ".graphql", ".gql", ".sql", ".html"]);
const SKIP_DIRS = new Set(["node_modules", "dist", ".next", ".git", ".turbo", "coverage", "examples", ".pg-test"]);
const SKIP_FILES = /(^|\/)(package-lock\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml|yarn\.lock|llms-full\.txt|[^/]*\.generated\.[^/]+|[^/]*\.log)$/;
const MAX = 150 * 1024;
const LANG = { ".ts": "ts", ".tsx": "tsx", ".mts": "ts", ".cts": "ts", ".js": "js", ".mjs": "js", ".cjs": "js", ".json": "json", ".css": "css", ".yml": "yaml", ".yaml": "yaml", ".graphql": "graphql", ".gql": "graphql", ".sql": "sql", ".html": "html" };

const posix = (p) => p.split("\\").join("/");
const files = new Set();
function walk(p) {
  const st = statSync(p);
  if (st.isDirectory()) {
    for (const name of readdirSync(p)) if (!SKIP_DIRS.has(name)) walk(join(p, name));
  } else if (TEXT.has(extname(p).toLowerCase()) && !SKIP_FILES.test(posix(p))) {
    files.add(posix(relative(".", p)));
  }
}
for (const input of inputs) walk(input);

const rank = (f) => (/^README\.md$/i.test(f) ? 0 : /^AGENTS\.md$/i.test(f) ? 1 : /^docs\//.test(f) ? 2 : 3);
const ordered = [...files].sort((a, b) => rank(a) - rank(b) || (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));

const parts = [`# ${title} — full documentation and source\n\n> Generated by scripts/llms-full.mjs. Do not edit by hand. ${ordered.length} files.\n\n## Contents\n\n${ordered.map((f) => `- ${f}`).join("\n")}\n`];
const omitted = [];
for (const f of ordered) {
  // LF-normalised text, so Windows and Linux checkouts produce byte-identical output
  const body = readFileSync(f, "utf8").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").trim();
  const size = Buffer.byteLength(body);
  if (size > MAX) {
    omitted.push(`${f} (${(size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB)`);
    parts.push(`\n\n---\n\n## File: ${f}\n\n_Omitted: ${(size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB. Read the file directly._\n`);
    continue;
  }
  const lang = LANG[extname(f).toLowerCase()];
  const fence = body.includes("```") ? "````" : "```";
  parts.push(`\n\n---\n\n## File: ${f}\n\n${lang ? `${fence}${lang}\n${body}\n${fence}` : body}\n`);
}
const out = parts.join("");
writeFileSync("llms-full.txt", out);
console.log(`llms-full.txt: ${ordered.length} files, ${(out.length / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB${omitted.length ? `; omitted (too large): ${omitted.join(", ")}` : ""}`);
````

## File: scripts/print-schema.ts

```ts
// Writes schema.graphql (the whole API in SDL) for clients, codegen and review. CI checks it is current.
import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { lexicographicSortSchema, printSchema } from "graphql";
import { buildSchema } from "../src/graphql/schema";

const sdl = `# Generated by \`npm run schema\` from src/schema. Do not edit by hand.\n\n${printSchema(lexicographicSortSchema(buildSchema()))}\n`;
writeFileSync("schema.graphql", sdl);
console.log(`schema.graphql: ${sdl.split("\n").length} lines`);
```

## File: scripts/seed.ts

```ts
// Creates the first organisation, its first branch, the owner account, auth-kit's system roles and
// the chart of accounts. Run once per new database:
//   SEED_ORG_NAME="Maa Gayatri Path Lab" SEED_ORG_CODE=MGPL SEED_BRANCH_CODE=ARG01 SEED_BRANCH_NAME=Arang \
//   SEED_BRANCH_STATE=22 SEED_OWNER_NAME="…" SEED_OWNER_EMAIL=… SEED_OWNER_PASSWORD=… npm run seed
// The password is read from the environment and never printed. Change it after the first sign-in.
import { assertPasswordPolicy, hashPassword, SYSTEM_ROLES } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/auth-kit";
import { createDb, seedOrganization } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { financePosting, seedFinanceLedgers } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit";
import { loadConfig } from "../src/config/env";

const need = (k: string) => {
  const v = process.env[k]?.trim();
  if (!v) throw new Error(`Set ${k}`);
  return v;
};

const config = loadConfig();
const org = { name: need("SEED_ORG_NAME"), code: need("SEED_ORG_CODE").toUpperCase(), gstin: process.env.SEED_ORG_GSTIN || undefined };
const branch = { code: need("SEED_BRANCH_CODE").toUpperCase(), name: need("SEED_BRANCH_NAME"), stateCode: need("SEED_BRANCH_STATE") };
const owner = { name: need("SEED_OWNER_NAME"), email: need("SEED_OWNER_EMAIL"), password: need("SEED_OWNER_PASSWORD") };
assertPasswordPolicy(owner.password, { email: owner.email, name: owner.name });

const db = await createDb({
  backend: config.db.backend,
  ...(config.db.backend === "pg" ? { pg: { url: config.db.url } } : { mongo: { uri: config.db.url } }),
  posting: financePosting,
} as Parameters<typeof createDb>[0]);
try {
  if (await db.rawRepos.orgs.findOne({ code: org.code })) throw new Error(`Organisation ${org.code} already exists`);
  const seeded = await seedOrganization(db.rawRepos, {
    org,
    branch,
    owner: { name: owner.name, email: owner.email, passwordHash: await hashPassword(owner.password) },
    roles: SYSTEM_ROLES,
  });
  const ledgers = await seedFinanceLedgers(db.rawRepos, seeded.org.id);
  console.log(`Organisation ${seeded.org.code} (${seeded.org.id}), branch ${seeded.branch.code}, owner ${seeded.owner.email}, ${ledgers.length} ledgers.`);
} finally {
  await db.close();
}
```

## File: src/config/env.ts

```ts
import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";

// Runtime configuration, read once from the environment. Every value has a safe development default;
// production sets them explicitly (see docs/09-configuration.md).

export type DbBackend = "pg" | "mongo";

export interface Config {
  env: "development" | "production" | "test";
  host: string;
  port: number;
  /** URL path of the one GraphQL endpoint. */
  graphqlPath: string;
  db: { backend: DbBackend; url: string };
  /** Sessions, reset tokens, rate limits and the read cache. Without it they live in process memory (one server only). */
  redisUrl: string | null;
  /** Origins allowed to call the API from a browser; "*" only in development. */
  corsOrigins: string[];
  /** GraphiQL in the browser at the GraphQL path (development only by default). */
  graphiql: boolean;
  /** Enables introspection (schema download). Development only by default. */
  introspection: boolean;
  /** Largest request body, bytes. */
  bodyLimit: number;
  /** Behind a proxy (nginx, a load balancer): read the client IP from X-Forwarded-For. */
  /** Reverse proxies in front of the API that append to X-Forwarded-For (TRUST_PROXY). 0 = use the socket address. */
  trustedHops: number;
  /** Demo report and invoice samples (report-kit / invoice-kit) in `documents`. */
  samples: boolean;
  /** Session lifetime knobs, passed to auth-kit. */
  session: { idleMs: number; maxAgeMs: number };
  /** Password-reset links point here: `${resetUrl}?token=…`. */
  resetUrl: string | null;
  /**
   * Access tokens (HS256 JWT) and refresh tokens. `secrets[0]` signs, every one verifies (rotation).
   * Development without JWT_SECRET uses a random secret per process (tokens die on restart).
   */
  jwt: { secrets: string[]; issuer: string; accessTtlMs: number; generated: boolean };
  /** A refresh from another device: "enforce" ends the session (default), "flag" only audits, "off" ignores. */
  deviceBinding: "enforce" | "flag" | "off";
  /** Background jobs (BullMQ on REDIS_URL): key prefix and how many jobs a worker runs at once. */
  jobs: { prefix: string; concurrency: number; keepResultsMs: number };
  /**
   * Mail (mail-kit): `SMTP_URL` (smtps://user:pass@host:465 or smtp://…:587) and the sender `MAIL_FROM`.
   * Preferred over `mailWebhookUrl` when both are set.
   */
  smtp: { url: string; from: string } | null;
  /** Optional HTTP relay for emails sent by the worker: POST { to, subject, text } as JSON. */
  mailWebhookUrl: string | null;
}

const bool = (v: string | undefined, d: boolean) => (v == null || v === "" ? d : ["1", "true", "yes", "on"].includes(v.toLowerCase()));
const int = (v: string | undefined, d: number) => {
  if (v == null || v === "") return d;
  const n = Number(v);
  if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 0) throw new Error(`Expected a whole number, got "${v}"`);
  return n;
};

/** TRUST_PROXY: "false"/"0" (default), "true" (= 1 proxy), or the number of proxies (CDN + load balancer = 2). */
function hops(v: string | undefined): number {
  if (v === undefined || v === "") return 0;
  if (/^(true|yes|on)$/i.test(v)) return 1;
  if (/^(false|no|off)$/i.test(v)) return 0;
  return int(v, 0);
}

export function loadConfig(env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env): Config {
  const mode = env.NODE_ENV === "production" ? "production" : env.NODE_ENV === "test" ? "test" : "development";
  const dev = mode !== "production";
  const backend = (env.DB_BACKEND ?? "pg") as DbBackend;
  if (backend !== "pg" && backend !== "mongo") throw new Error(`DB_BACKEND must be "pg" or "mongo", got "${backend}"`);
  const url = env.DATABASE_URL ?? (dev ? (backend === "pg" ? "postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/mgpl" : "mongodb://localhost:27017/mgpl?replicaSet=rs0") : "");
  if (!url) throw new Error("DATABASE_URL is required in production");
  const corsOrigins = (env.CORS_ORIGINS ?? (dev ? "*" : "")).split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  if (!dev && corsOrigins.includes("*")) throw new Error('CORS_ORIGINS cannot be "*" in production');
  const secrets = (env.JWT_SECRET ?? "").split(",").map((v) => v.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  if (!secrets.length && !dev) throw new Error("JWT_SECRET is required in production (at least 32 characters; comma-separate to rotate)");
  if (secrets.some((v) => v.length < 32)) throw new Error("Every JWT_SECRET needs at least 32 characters");
  const deviceBinding = (env.DEVICE_BINDING || "enforce") as Config["deviceBinding"];
  if (!["enforce", "flag", "off"].includes(deviceBinding)) throw new Error(`DEVICE_BINDING must be enforce, flag or off, got "${deviceBinding}"`);
  const smtpUrl = env.SMTP_URL || null;
  if (smtpUrl && !/^smtps?:\/\//.test(smtpUrl)) throw new Error("SMTP_URL must start with smtp:// or smtps://");
  if (smtpUrl && !env.MAIL_FROM && !dev) throw new Error('MAIL_FROM is required with SMTP_URL (e.g. "Maa Gayatri Path Lab <no-reply@your-domain>")');
  return {
    env: mode,
    host: env.HOST ?? "0.0.0.0",
    port: int(env.PORT, 4000),
    graphqlPath: env.GRAPHQL_PATH ?? "/graphql",
    db: { backend, url },
    redisUrl: env.REDIS_URL || null,
    corsOrigins,
    graphiql: bool(env.GRAPHIQL, dev),
    introspection: bool(env.INTROSPECTION, dev),
    bodyLimit: int(env.BODY_LIMIT_BYTES, 2_000_000),
    trustedHops: hops(env.TRUST_PROXY),
    samples: bool(env.MGPL_SAMPLES, dev),
    session: { idleMs: int(env.SESSION_IDLE_MS, 12 * 3600_000), maxAgeMs: int(env.SESSION_MAX_AGE_MS, 30 * 86400_000) },
    resetUrl: env.PASSWORD_RESET_URL || null,
    jwt: {
      secrets: secrets.length ? secrets : [randomBytes(32).toString("base64url")],
      issuer: env.JWT_ISSUER || "mgpl-api",
      accessTtlMs: int(env.ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_MS, 15 * 60_000),
      generated: !secrets.length,
    },
    deviceBinding,
    jobs: { prefix: env.QUEUE_PREFIX || "mgpl", concurrency: Math.max(1, int(env.WORKER_CONCURRENCY, 4)), keepResultsMs: int(env.JOB_RESULT_TTL_MS, 3600_000) },
    smtp: smtpUrl ? { url: smtpUrl, from: env.MAIL_FROM || "MGPL Diagnostics <no-reply@localhost.localdomain>" } : null,
    mailWebhookUrl: env.MAIL_WEBHOOK_URL || null,
  };
}
```

## File: src/container.ts

```ts
import { createAuth, memoryKeyValueStore, memoryRateLimiter, memorySessionStore, type Auth } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/auth-kit";
import { createDb, type Db } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { financePosting } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit";
import type { Config } from "./config/env";
import { defaultLab, type LabProfile } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { createBullJobQueue, createInlineJobQueue, mailerFromConfig, type JobDeps, type JobQueue } from "./jobs";
import { createServices, type Mailer, type Services } from "./services";

export interface ContainerOptions {
  config: Config;
  /** Inject a database (tests). Default: createDb from config, posting through finance-kit. */
  db?: Db;
  /** Inject auth (tests). Default: auth-kit on db-kit's users/orgs/roles/audit, sessions in Redis or memory. */
  auth?: Auth;
  /** Sends password-reset links. Default: mail-kit over SMTP_URL, else MAIL_WEBHOOK_URL, else none (links are not sent). */
  mailer?: Mailer;
  /** Inject a job queue (tests). Default: BullMQ when REDIS_URL is set, otherwise in-process. */
  jobs?: JobQueue;
  /** Lab branding and signatures for documents. Default: report-kit's defaultLab() (MGPL_SIGNATURE_* files). */
  lab?: LabProfile;
}

/** The composition root: one database, one auth, one set of services, shared by every request. */
export interface Container {
  config: Config;
  db: Db;
  auth: Auth;
  services: Services;
  /** Background jobs: BullMQ (REDIS_URL; `npm run worker` runs them) or in-process. */
  jobs: JobQueue;
  /** What the worker's processors need (the same services). */
  jobDeps: JobDeps;
  close(): Promise<void>;
}

export async function createContainer(o: ContainerOptions): Promise<Container> {
  const { config } = o;
  const ownsDb = !o.db;
  const db =
    o.db ??
    (await createDb({
      backend: config.db.backend,
      ...(config.db.backend === "pg" ? { pg: { url: config.db.url } } : { mongo: { uri: config.db.url } }),
      redis: config.redisUrl ?? undefined,
      // invoices and payments post to the books through finance-kit → tally-kit
      posting: financePosting,
    } as Parameters<typeof createDb>[0]));

  let auth = o.auth;
  if (!auth) {
    const redis = db.redis;
    const stores = redis
      ? await (async () => {
          const r = await import("@mgpl-diagnostics/auth-kit/redis");
          return {
            sessions: r.redisSessionStore(redis),
            kv: r.redisKeyValueStore(redis),
            limiter: r.redisRateLimiter(redis, { limit: 10, windowMs: 15 * 60_000 }),
          };
        })()
      : { sessions: memorySessionStore(), kv: memoryKeyValueStore(), limiter: memoryRateLimiter({ limit: 10, windowMs: 15 * 60_000 }) };
    // auth reads users on every request: use the raw (uncached) repositories so a disabled user is out at once
    const r = db.rawRepos;
    // JWT mode: short-lived access tokens + single-use refresh tokens (kv), sessions still checked per request
    auth = createAuth({
      users: r.users, orgs: r.orgs, roles: r.roles, audit: r.audit, ...stores, session: config.session,
      jwt: { secret: config.jwt.secrets, issuer: config.jwt.issuer, accessTtlMs: config.jwt.accessTtlMs },
      deviceBinding: config.deviceBinding,
    });
  }

  const lab = o.lab ?? defaultLab();
  const mailer = o.mailer ?? mailerFromConfig(config, lab);
  let jobDeps: JobDeps | undefined;
  const jobs =
    o.jobs ??
    (config.redisUrl
      ? createBullJobQueue({ redisUrl: config.redisUrl, prefix: config.jobs.prefix, keepResultsMs: config.jobs.keepResultsMs })
      : createInlineJobQueue(() => jobDeps!, { keepResultsMs: config.jobs.keepResultsMs }));
  const services = createServices({ repos: db.repos, auth, mailer, resetUrl: config.resetUrl, lab, samples: config.samples, jobs: () => jobs });
  jobDeps = { repos: db.repos, auth, services };
  return {
    config,
    db,
    auth,
    services,
    jobs,
    jobDeps,
    async close() {
      if (!o.jobs) await jobs.close();
      if (ownsDb) await db.close();
    },
  };
}
```

## File: src/controllers/auth.controller.ts

```ts
import type { RoleAssignment, User } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import type { RequestContext as Ctx } from "../graphql/context";
import { unauthenticated, withErrorCodes } from "../graphql/errors";
import { actorOf, authorize } from "../graphql/guards";
import { deviceOf, type DeviceInput } from "../graphql/device";

/** auth-kit: sign-in, sessions, passwords; users and roles. */
export const authController = withErrorCodes({
  Query: {
    viewer: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => (ctx.viewer ? {} : null),
    mySessions: async (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const sessions = await ctx.services.auth.sessions(actorOf(ctx));
      return sessions.map((s) => ({ ...s, current: s.id === ctx.viewer!.sessionId, createdAt: new Date(s.createdAt), lastSeenAt: new Date(s.lastSeenAt), expiresAt: new Date(s.expiresAt), deviceId: s.device?.deviceId ?? null, deviceInfo: s.device?.info ?? null }));
    },
    users: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.auth.users(authorize(ctx, "user:read")),
    user: (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.auth.user(authorize(ctx, "user:read"), a.id),
    roles: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.auth.roles(authorize(ctx, "role:read")),
    permissions: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => (actorOf(ctx), ctx.services.auth.permissions()),
  },

  Viewer: {
    user: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.auth.me(actorOf(ctx)),
    organization: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.organization.organization(actorOf(ctx)),
    permissions: (_: unknown, a: { branchId?: string | null }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.permissions(a.branchId),
    branchesFor: (_: unknown, a: { permission: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const b = ctx.branchesFor(a.permission);
      return b === "all" ? null : b;
    },
    can: (_: unknown, a: { permission: string; branchId?: string | null }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.can(a.permission, a.branchId),
  },

  RoleAssignment: {
    branch: (r: RoleAssignment, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.branch.load(r.branchId),
  },

  User: {
    createdAt: (u: User) => u.createdAt,
  },

  Mutation: {
    login: async (_: unknown, { input: { device, ...input } }: { input: { email: string; password: string; orgCode?: string | null; device?: DeviceInput | null } }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const r = await ctx.services.auth.login({ ...input, ip: ctx.ip, userAgent: ctx.userAgent, device: deviceOf(device) });
      return { ...r, accessToken: r.token, accessExpiresAt: r.expiresAt };
    },
    refreshSession: (_: unknown, a: { refreshToken: string; device?: DeviceInput | null }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.auth.refresh({ refreshToken: a.refreshToken, ip: ctx.ip, userAgent: ctx.userAgent, device: deviceOf(a.device) }),
    logout: async (_: unknown, a: { refreshToken?: string | null }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const token = a.refreshToken || ctx.token;
      if (!token) throw unauthenticated();
      await ctx.services.auth.logout(token);
      return true;
    },
    logoutOtherSessions: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.auth.logoutOthers(actorOf(ctx), ctx.token!),
    revokeSession: (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.auth.revokeSession(actorOf(ctx), a.id),
    changePassword: async (_: unknown, a: { currentPassword: string; newPassword: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      await ctx.services.auth.changePassword(actorOf(ctx), a.currentPassword, a.newPassword, ctx.token ?? undefined);
      return true;
    },
    requestPasswordReset: async (_: unknown, a: { email: string; orgCode?: string | null }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      await ctx.services.auth.requestPasswordReset({ ...a, ip: ctx.ip });
      return true;
    },
    resetPassword: async (_: unknown, a: { token: string; newPassword: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      await ctx.services.auth.resetPassword(a.token, a.newPassword);
      return true;
    },

    createUser: (_: unknown, { input }: { input: { name: string; email: string; phone?: string | null; password: string; roles: RoleAssignment[] } }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.auth.createUser(authorize(ctx, "user:create"), { ...input, roles: input.roles.map((r) => ({ role: r.role, branchId: r.branchId ?? null })) }),
    setUserRoles: (_: unknown, a: { userId: string; roles: RoleAssignment[] }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.auth.setUserRoles(authorize(ctx, "user:update"), a.userId, a.roles.map((r) => ({ role: r.role, branchId: r.branchId ?? null }))),
    disableUser: (_: unknown, a: { userId: string }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.auth.setUserStatus(authorize(ctx, "user:disable"), a.userId, "disabled"),
    enableUser: (_: unknown, a: { userId: string }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.auth.setUserStatus(authorize(ctx, "user:disable"), a.userId, "active"),
    setUserPassword: async (_: unknown, a: { userId: string; newPassword: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      await ctx.services.auth.setUserPassword(authorize(ctx, "user:update"), a.userId, a.newPassword);
      return true;
    },
    upsertRole: (_: unknown, { input }: { input: { key: string; name: string; permissions: string[] } }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.auth.upsertRole(authorize(ctx, "role:manage"), input),
  },
});
```

## File: src/controllers/base.controller.ts

```ts
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import type { RequestContext } from "../graphql/context";
import { Day, DateTime, JSONScalar } from "../graphql/scalars";

const VERSION = (() => {
  try {
    return (JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL("../../package.json", import.meta.url), "utf8")) as { version: string }).version;
  } catch {
    return "0.0.0";
  }
})();

export const baseController = {
  DateTime,
  Day,
  JSON: JSONScalar,
  Query: {
    health: async (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: RequestContext) => {
      let database = "ok";
      try {
        await ctx.repos.orgs.count();
      } catch {
        database = "unreachable";
      }
      return { ok: database === "ok", service: "@mgpl-diagnostics/api", version: VERSION, database, time: new Date() };
    },
  },
  Mutation: {
    ping: () => "pong",
  },
};
```

## File: src/controllers/billing.controller.ts

```ts
import type { Invoice, InvoiceStatus } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import type { RequestContext as Ctx } from "../graphql/context";
import { withErrorCodes } from "../graphql/errors";
import { actorOf, authorize, branchScope, canSee, cap } from "../graphql/guards";
import { BillingService, type IssueInvoiceInput, type PaymentInput } from "../services/billing.service";

async function invoiceFor(ctx: Ctx, id: string, permission: string) {
  const inv = await ctx.services.billing.get(actorOf(ctx), id);
  authorize(ctx, permission, inv.branchId);
  return inv;
}

/** Invoices and payments. */
export const billingController = withErrorCodes({
  Query: {
    invoice: (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => invoiceFor(ctx, a.id, "invoice:read"),
    invoices: (_: unknown, a: { branchId?: string | null; status?: InvoiceStatus | null; patientId?: string | null; customerId?: string | null; limit?: number; offset?: number }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.billing.list(actorOf(ctx), { scope: branchScope(ctx, "invoice:read", a.branchId), status: a.status, patientId: a.patientId, customerId: a.customerId, limit: cap(a.limit, 50), offset: a.offset ?? 0 }),
  },
  Invoice: {
    patient: (i: Invoice, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.patient.load(i.patientId),
    branch: (i: Invoice, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.branch.load(i.branchId),
    booking: (i: Invoice, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.booking.load(i.bookingId),
    customer: (i: Invoice, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.customer.load(i.customerId),
    creditedPaise: (i: Invoice) => i.creditedPaise ?? 0,
    payments: (i: Invoice, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.billing.payments(i.id),
    vouchers: (i: Invoice, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => (canSee(ctx, "accounts:read", i.branchId) ? ctx.services.billing.vouchers(i.id) : []),
    creditNotes: (i: Invoice, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.billing.creditNotes(i.id),
  },
  Mutation: {
    issueInvoice: (_: unknown, { input }: { input: IssueInvoiceInput }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const actor = authorize(ctx, "invoice:create", input.branchId);
      if (BillingService.discounted(input)) authorize(ctx, "invoice:discount", input.branchId);
      if (input.payments?.length) authorize(ctx, "payment:create", input.branchId);
      return ctx.services.billing.issue(actor, input);
    },
    recordPayment: async (_: unknown, a: { invoiceId: string; payment: PaymentInput }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.billing.pay(actorOf(ctx), await invoiceFor(ctx, a.invoiceId, "payment:create"), a.payment, "payment"),
    refundPayment: async (_: unknown, a: { invoiceId: string; payment: PaymentInput }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.billing.pay(actorOf(ctx), await invoiceFor(ctx, a.invoiceId, "payment:refund"), a.payment, "refund"),
    cancelInvoice: async (_: unknown, a: { id: string; reason: string }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.billing.cancel(actorOf(ctx), await invoiceFor(ctx, a.id, "invoice:cancel"), a.reason),
  },
});
```

## File: src/controllers/books.controller.ts

```ts
import type { AccountGroup, Ledger, Voucher, VoucherEntry, VoucherType } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import type { RequestContext as Ctx } from "../graphql/context";
import { withErrorCodes } from "../graphql/errors";
import { actorOf, authorize } from "../graphql/guards";
import type { PostVoucherInput } from "../services/books.service";

const BUCKET = { "0-30": "D0_30", "31-60": "D31_60", "61-90": "D61_90", "90+": "D90_PLUS" } as const;

type Range = { from: Date; to: Date; branchId?: string | null };

/** The books (tally-kit). Reads need accounts:read, manual vouchers accounts:post, setup accounts:manage. */
export const booksController = withErrorCodes({
  Query: {
    accountGroups: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.books.groups(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read")),
    ledgers: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.books.ledgers(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read")),
    ledger: async (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const l = await ctx.loaders.ledger.load(a.id);
      return l && l.orgId === authorize(ctx, "accounts:read").orgId ? l : null;
    },
    voucher: async (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const v = await ctx.services.books.voucher(actorOf(ctx), a.id);
      authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", v.branchId);
      return v;
    },
    ledgerStatement: (_: unknown, a: Range & { ledgerId: string }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.books.ledgerStatement(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId), a),
    cashBook: (_: unknown, a: Range, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.books.cashBook(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId), a),
    trialBalance: (_: unknown, a: { asOf?: Date | null; branchId?: string | null }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.books.trialBalance(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId), a),
    profitAndLoss: (_: unknown, a: Range, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.books.profitAndLoss(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId), a),
    balanceSheet: (_: unknown, a: { asOf: Date; branchId?: string | null }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.books.balanceSheet(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId), a),
    dayBook: (_: unknown, a: Range & { type?: VoucherType | null }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.books.dayBook(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId), a),
    outstandingReceivables: async (_: unknown, a: { asOf?: Date | null; branchId?: string | null }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const out = await ctx.services.books.outstanding(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId), a);
      return {
        rows: out.rows.map((r) => ({ ...r, bucket: BUCKET[r.bucket] })),
        buckets: { d0to30: out.buckets["0-30"], d31to60: out.buckets["31-60"], d61to90: out.buckets["61-90"], d90plus: out.buckets["90+"] },
        totalDuePaise: out.totalDuePaise,
      };
    },
    gstSummary: (_: unknown, a: Range, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.books.gstSummary(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId), a),
  },
  AccountGroup: {
    parent: (g: AccountGroup, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.group.load(g.parentId),
  },
  Ledger: {
    group: (l: Ledger, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.group.load(l.groupId),
    balancePaise: (l: Ledger, a: { asOf?: Date | null; branchId?: string | null }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.books.balance(l.orgId, l.id, a),
  },
  Voucher: {
    branch: (v: Voucher, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.branch.load(v.branchId),
  },
  VoucherEntry: {
    ledger: (e: VoucherEntry, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.ledger.load(e.ledgerId),
  },
  Mutation: {
    setupChartOfAccounts: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.books.setupChartOfAccounts(authorize(ctx, "accounts:manage")),
    createLedger: (_: unknown, { input }: { input: { name: string; groupId: string; openingPaise?: number | null; gstin?: string | null } }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.books.createLedger(authorize(ctx, "accounts:manage"), input),
    postVoucher: (_: unknown, { input }: { input: PostVoucherInput }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.books.postVoucher(authorize(ctx, "accounts:post", input.branchId), input),
    cancelVoucher: async (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const v = await ctx.services.books.voucher(actorOf(ctx), a.id);
      return ctx.services.books.cancelVoucher(authorize(ctx, "accounts:post", v.branchId), a.id);
    },
  },
});

## File: src/controllers/catalog.controller.ts

```ts
import type { Interval, LabTest, Parameter } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/catalog-kit";
import type { RequestContext as Ctx } from "../graphql/context";
import { withErrorCodes } from "../graphql/errors";
import { cap } from "../graphql/guards";

const bound = (b: Interval["low"]) => (b == null ? null : String(b));

/** catalog-kit. Public: the same tests and prices are on the website. */
export const catalogController = withErrorCodes({
  Query: {
    catalogSearch: (_: unknown, a: { query: string; limit?: number; department?: string | null; sampleType?: string | null; fuzzy?: boolean | null }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.catalog.search(a.query, { limit: cap(a.limit, 20), department: a.department, sampleType: a.sampleType, fuzzy: a.fuzzy }),
    catalogTest: (_: unknown, a: { id?: number | null; code?: string | null }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.catalog.test(a),
    catalogTests: (_: unknown, a: { department?: string | null; sampleType?: string | null; limit?: number; offset?: number }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.catalog.tests({ department: a.department, sampleType: a.sampleType, limit: cap(a.limit, 50), offset: a.offset ?? 0 }),
    catalogDepartments: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.catalog.departments(),
    catalogSampleTypes: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.catalog.sampleTypes(),
    priceQuote: (_: unknown, a: { tests: string[] }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const q = ctx.services.catalog.quote(a.tests.slice(0, 200).map((t) => (/^\d+$/.test(t) ? Number(t) : t)));
      return { total: q.total, totalPaise: q.total * 100, tests: q.tests, unknown: q.unknown.map(String) };
    },
  },
  CatalogTest: {
    pricePaise: (t: LabTest) => (t.mrp == null ? null : t.mrp * 100),
    isProfile: (t: LabTest, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.catalog.isProfile(t),
  },
  CatalogParameter: {
    male: (p: Parameter) => (p.male ? { low: bound(p.male.low), high: bound(p.male.high) } : null),
    female: (p: Parameter) => (p.female ? { low: bound(p.female.low), high: bound(p.female.high) } : null),
    range: (p: Parameter, a: { sex?: "male" | "female" | "other" | null }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.catalog.formatRange(p, a.sex === "other" ? null : a.sex),
  },
});
```

## File: src/controllers/documents.controller.ts

```ts
import type { InvoiceRequest } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit";
import type { ReportDesign, ReportRequest, ReportVariant } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import type { RequestContext as Ctx } from "../graphql/context";
import { badInput, withErrorCodes } from "../graphql/errors";
import { actorOf, authorize } from "../graphql/guards";
import type { DocumentFormat } from "../services/document.service";

type Opts = { format?: DocumentFormat; variant?: "header" | "non_header"; design?: ReportDesign; fileName?: string | null };

const variantOf = (v?: string): ReportVariant => (v === "non_header" ? "non-header" : "header");
const options = (a: Opts) => ({ format: a.format ?? "pdf", variant: variantOf(a.variant), design: a.design ?? "sidebar", fileName: a.fileName });
const objectOf = <T>(v: unknown, what: string): T => {
  if (!v || typeof v !== "object" || Array.isArray(v)) throw badInput(`${what} must be a JSON object`);
  return v as T;
};

/** report-kit and invoice-kit, used as internal libraries behind this one endpoint. */
export const documentsController = withErrorCodes({
  Query: {
    job: (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.jobs.get(actorOf(ctx), a.id),
    reportTemplates: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => (actorOf(ctx), ctx.services.documents.templates()),
    priceList: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => (actorOf(ctx), ctx.services.documents.priceList()),
    documentSamples: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => (actorOf(ctx), ctx.services.documents.reportSamples()),
    invoiceSamples: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => (actorOf(ctx), ctx.services.documents.invoiceSamples()),

    renderReport: (_: unknown, a: Opts & { request: unknown }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      authorize(ctx, "report:read");
      return ctx.services.documents.renderReportRequest(objectOf<ReportRequest>(a.request, "request"), options(a));
    },
    renderInvoice: (_: unknown, a: Opts & { request: unknown }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      authorize(ctx, "invoice:read");
      return ctx.services.documents.renderInvoiceRequest(objectOf<InvoiceRequest>(a.request, "request"), options(a));
    },
    invoiceTotals: (_: unknown, a: { request: unknown }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      authorize(ctx, "invoice:read");
      return ctx.services.documents.invoiceTotals(objectOf<InvoiceRequest>(a.request, "request"));
    },
    letterhead: (_: unknown, a: { format?: DocumentFormat }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      authorize(ctx, "report:read");
      return ctx.services.documents.letterhead(a.format ?? "pdf");
    },

    invoiceDocument: async (_: unknown, a: Opts & { invoiceId: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const inv = await ctx.services.billing.get(actorOf(ctx), a.invoiceId);
      return ctx.services.documents.renderStoredInvoice(authorize(ctx, "invoice:read", inv.branchId), inv, options(a));
    },
    bookingReportDocument: async (_: unknown, a: Opts & { bookingId: string; reportIds?: string[] | null }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const b = await ctx.services.bookings.get(actorOf(ctx), a.bookingId);
      return ctx.services.documents.renderBookingReports(authorize(ctx, "report:read", b.branchId), a.bookingId, a.reportIds ?? null, options(a));
    },
  },
  Mutation: {
    startDocumentJob: async (_: unknown, { input: a }: { input: Opts & { kind: "invoice" | "booking_reports"; invoiceId?: string | null; bookingId?: string | null; reportIds?: string[] | null } }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      if (a.kind === "invoice") {
        if (!a.invoiceId) throw badInput("invoiceId is required for kind invoice");
        const inv = await ctx.services.billing.get(actorOf(ctx), a.invoiceId);
        return ctx.services.jobs.invoiceDocument(authorize(ctx, "invoice:read", inv.branchId), inv.id, options(a));
      }
      if (!a.bookingId) throw badInput("bookingId is required for kind booking_reports");
      const b = await ctx.services.bookings.get(actorOf(ctx), a.bookingId);
      return ctx.services.jobs.bookingReports(authorize(ctx, "report:read", b.branchId), b.id, a.reportIds ?? null, options(a));
    },
  },
  TemplateField: {
    range: (f: { range?: string | string[] }) => (f.range == null ? null : Array.isArray(f.range) ? f.range : [f.range]),
  },
});
```

import type {
  BankLineStatus, BankStatement, CashClosing, CreditNote, Customer, Partner, PeriodLock, Settlement, SettlementDeduction, SettlementStatus,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import type { AgeBucket, FinanceConfig } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit";
import type { RequestContext as Ctx } from "../graphql/context";
import { withErrorCodes } from "../graphql/errors";
import { actorOf, authorize, branchScope, cap } from "../graphql/guards";
import type { CustomerInput, CustomerInvoiceInput } from "../services/receivables.service";
import type { AgreementInput, PartnerInput } from "../services/settlement.service";
import type { TaxRuleInput } from "../services/gst.service";

const OPEN_BUCKET: Record<AgeBucket, string> = { not_due: "not_due", "1-30": "D1_30", "31-60": "D31_60", "61-90": "D61_90", "90+": "D90_PLUS" };
const ageing = (a: Record<AgeBucket, number>) => ({ notDue: a.not_due, d1to30: a["1-30"], d31to60: a["31-60"], d61to90: a["61-90"], d90plus: a["90+"] });
const voucherById = (ctx: Ctx, id?: string | null) => (id ? ctx.repos.vouchers.get(id) : null);

type Range = { from: Date; to: Date; branchId?: string | null; bom?: boolean };
type Gst = { from: Date; to: Date; gstin?: string | null; bom?: boolean };

async function settlementFor(ctx: Ctx, id: string, permission: string) {
  const s = await ctx.services.settlements.settlement(actorOf(ctx), id);
  authorize(ctx, permission, s.branchId);
  return s;
}

/**
 * finance-kit. Permissions as in finance-kit's docs/api.md: accounts:read for returns, statements and
 * exports; accounts:post for invoices, credit notes, settlements, cash and bank; accounts:manage for
 * tax rules, customers, partners, lock dates and the year-end close.
 */
export const financeController = withErrorCodes({
  Query: {
    taxRules: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.gst.taxRules(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read")),
    financeConfig: async (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const c: FinanceConfig = await ctx.services.gst.config(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read"));
      return { b2clThresholdPaise: c.gst.b2clThresholdPaise, tds: c.tds, bankToleranceDays: c.bank.toleranceDays, bankMaxFeeBp: c.bank.maxFeeBp, clearingLedgerKeys: c.bank.clearingLedgerKeys };
    },
    verifyWithCA: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => (actorOf(ctx), ctx.services.gst.verifyWithCA()),
    gstr1: (_: unknown, a: Gst, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.gst.gstr1(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read"), a),
    gstr3b: (_: unknown, a: Gst, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.gst.gstr3b(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read"), a),

    customers: (_: unknown, a: { activeOnly?: boolean }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.receivables.customers(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read"), a.activeOnly ?? true),
    customer: async (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const c = await ctx.loaders.customer.load(a.id);
      return c && c.orgId === authorize(ctx, "accounts:read").orgId ? c : null;
    },
    customerStatement: async (_: unknown, a: { customerId: string; from: Date; to: Date }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const s = await ctx.services.receivables.statement(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read"), a);
      return { ...s, open: s.open.map((o) => ({ ...o, bucket: OPEN_BUCKET[o.bucket] })), ageing: ageing(s.ageing) };
    },
    receivablesSummary: async (_: unknown, a: { asOf: Date }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const s = await ctx.services.receivables.summary(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read"), a.asOf);
      return { ...s, rows: s.rows.map((r) => ({ ...r, ageing: ageing(r.ageing) })) };
    },
    creditNote: async (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const n = await ctx.services.receivables.creditNote(actorOf(ctx), a.id);
      authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", n.branchId);
      return n;
    },
    creditNotes: (_: unknown, a: { invoiceId?: string | null; customerId?: string | null; limit?: number; offset?: number }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.receivables.creditNotes(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read"), { ...a, limit: cap(a.limit, 50), offset: a.offset ?? 0 }),

    partners: (_: unknown, a: { branchId?: string | null }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.settlements.partners(actorOf(ctx), { branchIds: branchScope(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId) }),
    partner: async (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const p = await ctx.services.settlements.partner(actorOf(ctx), a.id);
      authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", p.branchId);
      return p;
    },
    settlementPreview: async (_: unknown, a: { partnerId: string; period: string; deductions?: SettlementDeduction[] | null }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const p = await ctx.services.settlements.partner(actorOf(ctx), a.partnerId);
      return ctx.services.settlements.compute(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", p.branchId), a);
    },
    settlements: (_: unknown, a: { partnerId?: string | null; status?: SettlementStatus | null; branchId?: string | null; limit?: number; offset?: number }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.settlements.settlements(actorOf(ctx), { ...a, branchIds: branchScope(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId), limit: cap(a.limit, 50), offset: a.offset ?? 0 }),
    settlement: (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => settlementFor(ctx, a.id, "accounts:read"),

    cashClosings: (_: unknown, a: { branchId: string; limit?: number; offset?: number }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.cashBank.cashClosings(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId), { branchId: a.branchId, limit: cap(a.limit, 31), offset: a.offset ?? 0 }),
    bankStatements: (_: unknown, a: { ledgerId?: string | null; limit?: number; offset?: number }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.cashBank.bankStatements(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read"), { ledgerId: a.ledgerId, limit: cap(a.limit, 50), offset: a.offset ?? 0 }),
    bankLines: (_: unknown, a: { ledgerId?: string | null; statementId?: string | null; status?: BankLineStatus | null; limit?: number; offset?: number }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.cashBank.bankLines(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read"), { ...a, limit: cap(a.limit, 100), offset: a.offset ?? 0 }),
    bankReconciliation: (_: unknown, a: { ledgerId: string; asOf: Date }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.cashBank.reconciliation(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read"), a),

    lockDates: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.periods.locks(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read")),

    exportDayBook: (_: unknown, a: Range, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.exports.dayBook(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId), { ...a, bom: !!a.bom }),
    exportLedger: async (_: unknown, a: Range & { ledgerId: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const actor = authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId);
      await ctx.services.books.ledger(actor, a.ledgerId);
      return ctx.services.exports.ledger(actor, { ...a, bom: !!a.bom });
    },
    exportTrialBalance: (_: unknown, a: { asOf?: Date | null; branchId?: string | null; bom?: boolean }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.exports.trialBalance(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId), { ...a, bom: !!a.bom }),
    exportProfitAndLoss: (_: unknown, a: Range, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.exports.profitAndLoss(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId), { ...a, bom: !!a.bom }),
    exportBalanceSheet: (_: unknown, a: { asOf: Date; branchId?: string | null; bom?: boolean }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.exports.balanceSheet(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read", a.branchId), { ...a, bom: !!a.bom }),
    exportSettlement: async (_: unknown, a: { settlementId: string; bom?: boolean }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      await settlementFor(ctx, a.settlementId, "accounts:read");
      return ctx.services.exports.settlement(actorOf(ctx), { settlementId: a.settlementId, bom: !!a.bom });
    },
    exportGstr1: (_: unknown, a: Gst, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.exports.gstr1(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read"), { ...a, bom: !!a.bom }),
    exportGstr3b: (_: unknown, a: Gst, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.exports.gstr3b(authorize(ctx, "accounts:read"), { ...a, bom: !!a.bom }),
  },

  Customer: {
    ledger: (c: Customer, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.ledger.load(c.ledgerId),
  },
  CreditNote: {
    invoice: (n: CreditNote, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.invoice.load(n.invoiceId),
    customer: (n: CreditNote, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.customer.load(n.customerId),
  },
  Partner: {
    branch: (p: Partner, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.branch.load(p.branchId),
    ledger: (p: Partner, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.ledger.load(p.ledgerId),
    agreements: (p: Partner, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.settlements.agreements(p.id),
  },
  Settlement: {
    partner: (s: Settlement, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.partner.load(s.partnerId),
    branch: (s: Settlement, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.branch.load(s.branchId),
    accrualVoucher: (s: Settlement, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => voucherById(ctx, s.accrualVoucherId),
    payoutVoucher: (s: Settlement, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => voucherById(ctx, s.payoutVoucherId),
  },
  CashClosing: {
    branch: (c: CashClosing, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.branch.load(c.branchId),
    voucher: (c: CashClosing, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => voucherById(ctx, c.voucherId),
  },
  BankStatement: {
    branch: (s: BankStatement, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.branch.load(s.branchId),
    ledger: (s: BankStatement, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.ledger.load(s.ledgerId),
  },
  PeriodLock: {

  },

    seedTaxRules: (_: unknown, __: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.gst.seedTaxRules(authorize(ctx, "accounts:manage")),

    createCustomer: (_: unknown, { input }: { input: CustomerInput }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.receivables.createCustomer(authorize(ctx, "accounts:manage"), input),
    updateCustomer: (_: unknown, a: { id: string; input: Partial<CustomerInput> & { active?: boolean | null } }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.receivables.updateCustomer(authorize(ctx, "accounts:manage"), a.id, a.input),
    issueCustomerInvoice: (_: unknown, { input }: { input: CustomerInvoiceInput }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const actor = authorize(ctx, "accounts:post", input.branchId);
      authorize(ctx, "invoice:create", input.branchId);
      return ctx.services.receivables.issueInvoice(actor, input);
    },
