```ts
      const inv = await ctx.services.billing.get(actorOf(ctx), input.invoiceId);
      return ctx.services.receivables.issueCreditNote(authorize(ctx, "accounts:post", inv.branchId), input);
    },

    createPartner: (_: unknown, { input }: { input: PartnerInput }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.settlements.createPartner(authorize(ctx, "accounts:manage", input.branchId), input),

      const p = await ctx.services.settlements.partner(actorOf(ctx), a.id);
      return ctx.services.settlements.updatePartner(authorize(ctx, "accounts:manage", p.branchId), a.id, a.input);
    },
    addAgreement: async (_: unknown, { input }: { input: AgreementInput }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const p = await ctx.services.settlements.partner(actorOf(ctx), input.partnerId);
      return ctx.services.settlements.addAgreement(authorize(ctx, "accounts:manage", p.branchId), input);
    },

      return ctx.services.settlements.create(authorize(ctx, "accounts:post", p.branchId), a);
    },
    accrueSettlement: async (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => (await settlementFor(ctx, a.id, "accounts:post"), ctx.services.settlements.accrue(actorOf(ctx), a.id)),

    setBankLineStatus: (_: unknown, a: { lineId: string; status: "ignored" | "unmatched" }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.cashBank.setLineStatus(authorize(ctx, "accounts:post"), a),

    setLockDate: (_: unknown, { input }: { input: { branchId?: string | null; upTo: string | null; reason?: string | null } }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.periods.setLockDate(authorize(ctx, "accounts:manage", input.branchId), input),

  },
});
```

## File: src/controllers/lab.controller.ts

```ts
import { getTestByCode } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/catalog-kit";
import type { Booking, BookingStatus, BookingTest, Patient, Report, ResultValue, Sample } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import type { RequestContext as Ctx } from "../graphql/context";
import { withErrorCodes } from "../graphql/errors";
import { actorOf, authorize, branchScope, canSee, cap } from "../graphql/guards";
import type { CreateBookingInput } from "../services/booking.service";
import type { DoctorInput, RegisterPatientInput } from "../services/patient.service";
import { scopedFind } from "../services/util";

/** A result flag "" (normal) is NONE in GraphQL. */
export const flagOut = (f: ResultValue["flag"]) => (f === "" ? "NONE" : f ?? null);
export const flagIn = (f?: string | null): ResultValue["flag"] => (f === "NONE" ? "" : ((f ?? undefined) as ResultValue["flag"]));

async function sampleFor(ctx: Ctx, id: string, permission: string) {
  const s = await ctx.services.bookings.sample(actorOf(ctx), id);
  authorize(ctx, permission, s.branchId);
  return s;
}

async function reportFor(ctx: Ctx, id: string, permission: string) {
  const r = await ctx.services.reports.get(actorOf(ctx), id);
  authorize(ctx, permission, r.branchId);
  return r;
}

/** Patients, doctors, bookings, samples, reports. */
export const labController = withErrorCodes({
  Query: {
    patient: async (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.patients.get(authorize(ctx, "patient:read"), a.id),
    patients: (_: unknown, a: { search: string; limit?: number }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.patients.search(authorize(ctx, "patient:read"), a.search, cap(a.limit, 20)),
    doctors: (_: unknown, a: { activeOnly?: boolean }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.patients.doctors(authorize(ctx, "doctor:read"), a.activeOnly ?? true),

    booking: async (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const b = await ctx.services.bookings.get(actorOf(ctx), a.id);
      authorize(ctx, "booking:read", b.branchId);
      return b;
    },
    bookings: (_: unknown, a: { branchId?: string | null; status?: BookingStatus | null; patientId?: string | null; limit?: number; offset?: number }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      ctx.services.bookings.list(actorOf(ctx), { scope: branchScope(ctx, "booking:read", a.branchId), status: a.status, patientId: a.patientId, limit: cap(a.limit, 50), offset: a.offset ?? 0 }),
    sample: (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => sampleFor(ctx, a.id, "sample:read"),
    sampleByBarcode: async (_: unknown, a: { barcode: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const s = await ctx.services.bookings.sampleByBarcode(actorOf(ctx), a.barcode);
      if (s) authorize(ctx, "sample:read", s.branchId);
      return s;
    },
    report: (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => reportFor(ctx, a.id, "report:read"),
  },

  Patient: {
    branch: (p: Patient, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.branch.load(p.branchId),
    bookings: (p: Patient, a: { limit?: number }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      canSee(ctx, "booking:read") ? scopedFind(ctx.repos.bookings, { patientId: p.id }, ctx.branchesFor("booking:read"), cap(a.limit, 20), 0, "createdAt") : [],
    invoices: (p: Patient, a: { limit?: number }, ctx: Ctx) =>
      canSee(ctx, "invoice:read") ? scopedFind(ctx.repos.invoices, { patientId: p.id }, ctx.branchesFor("invoice:read"), cap(a.limit, 20), 0, "createdAt") : [],
  },
  Booking: {
    patient: (b: Booking, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.patient.load(b.patientId),
    doctor: (b: Booking, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.doctor.load(b.doctorId),
    branch: (b: Booking, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.branch.load(b.branchId),
    samples: (b: Booking, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.bookings.samplesOf(b.id),
    reports: (b: Booking, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => (canSee(ctx, "report:read", b.branchId) ? ctx.services.reports.ofBooking(b.id) : []),
    invoice: (b: Booking, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => (canSee(ctx, "invoice:read", b.branchId) ? ctx.loaders.invoice.load(b.invoiceId) : null),
  },
  BookingTest: {
    catalog: (t: BookingTest) => getTestByCode(t.testCode) ?? null,
  },
  Sample: {
    booking: (s: Sample, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.booking.load(s.bookingId),
  },
  Report: {
    results: (r: Report) => r.results.map((x) => ({ ...x, flag: flagOut(x.flag) })),
    patient: (r: Report, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.patient.load(r.patientId),
    booking: (r: Report, _: unknown, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.loaders.booking.load(r.bookingId),
  },

  Mutation: {
    registerPatient: (_: unknown, { input }: { input: RegisterPatientInput }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.patients.register(authorize(ctx, "patient:create", input.branchId), input),
    updatePatient: async (_: unknown, a: { id: string; input: Partial<RegisterPatientInput> }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const actor = authorize(ctx, "patient:update");
      return ctx.services.patients.update(actor, a.id, a.input);
    },
    createDoctor: (_: unknown, { input }: { input: DoctorInput }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.patients.createDoctor(authorize(ctx, "doctor:manage"), input),
    updateDoctor: (_: unknown, a: { id: string; input: Partial<DoctorInput> }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.patients.updateDoctor(authorize(ctx, "doctor:manage"), a.id, a.input),

    createBooking: (_: unknown, { input }: { input: CreateBookingInput }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.bookings.create(authorize(ctx, "booking:create", input.branchId), input),
    cancelBooking: async (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const b = await ctx.services.bookings.get(actorOf(ctx), a.id);
      return ctx.services.bookings.cancel(authorize(ctx, "booking:cancel", b.branchId), a.id);
    },
    collectSample: async (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.bookings.collectSample(actorOf(ctx), await sampleFor(ctx, a.id, "sample:collect")),
    receiveSample: async (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.bookings.receiveSample(actorOf(ctx), await sampleFor(ctx, a.id, "sample:receive")),
    rejectSample: async (_: unknown, a: { id: string; reason: string }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.bookings.rejectSample(actorOf(ctx), await sampleFor(ctx, a.id, "sample:reject"), a.reason),

    createReport: async (_: unknown, a: { bookingId: string; testCode: string; testName?: string | null }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const b = await ctx.services.bookings.get(actorOf(ctx), a.bookingId);
      return ctx.services.reports.create(authorize(ctx, "report:enter", b.branchId), b, a.testCode, a.testName);
    },
    saveResults: async (_: unknown, a: { reportId: string; results: (Omit<ResultValue, "flag"> & { flag?: string | null })[] }, ctx: Ctx) => {
      const r = await reportFor(ctx, a.reportId, "report:enter");
      const results = a.results.map((x) => ({ parameter: x.parameter, value: x.value, ...(x.unit != null ? { unit: x.unit } : {}), ...(x.range != null ? { range: x.range } : {}), ...(x.flag != null ? { flag: flagIn(x.flag) } : {}) }));
      return ctx.services.reports.saveResults(actorOf(ctx), r, results);
    },
    verifyReport: async (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.reports.verify(actorOf(ctx), await reportFor(ctx, a.id, "report:verify")),
    releaseReport: async (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.reports.release(actorOf(ctx), await reportFor(ctx, a.id, "report:release")),
    amendReport: async (_: unknown, a: { id: string }, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.services.reports.amend(actorOf(ctx), await reportFor(ctx, a.id, "report:amend")),
  },
});
```

```ts
import type { AuditEntry, Organization } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
```

## File: src/graphql/context.ts

```ts
import type { AuthContext, Viewer } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/auth-kit";
import type { Repositories } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import type { Container } from "../container";
import type { Services } from "../services";
import { createLoaders, type Loaders } from "./loaders";

/** Who is acting: always taken from the session, never from client input. */
export interface Actor {
  userId: string;
  orgId: string;
}

/** Everything a controller (resolver) gets for one request. */
export interface RequestContext extends AuthContext {
  services: Services;
  /** Cached repositories (db-kit `db.repos`); workflows open their own transactions. */
  repos: Repositories;
  viewer: Viewer | null;
  /** The bearer token of this request (needed by logout and password change). */
  token: string | null;
  ip?: string;
  userAgent?: string;
  /** Per-request batch loaders, created on first use. */
  readonly loaders: Loaders;
}

export function bearerToken(header: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  const m = /^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i.exec(header?.trim() ?? "");
  return m ? m[1]!.trim() : null;
}

/** Builds the request context from the Authorization header, through auth-kit. */
export async function createContext(container: Container, req: { headers: Headers; ip?: string }): Promise<RequestContext> {
  const token = bearerToken(req.headers.get("authorization"));
  const auth = await container.auth.context(token);
  let loaders: Loaders | undefined;
  const repos = container.db.repos;
  return {
    ...auth,
    services: container.services,
    repos,
    token,
    ip: req.ip,
    userAgent: req.headers.get("user-agent") ?? undefined,
    get loaders() {
      return (loaders ??= createLoaders(repos));
    },
  };
}
```

## File: src/graphql/device.ts

```ts
// Device signals (DeviceInput, collected in the client by @mgpl-diagnostics/security-kit) → auth-kit's
// DeviceSignals. auth-kit cleans and caps the values (cleanDeviceSignals); this only maps shapes.
import type { DeviceSignals } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/auth-kit";

export interface DeviceInput {
  deviceId?: string | null;
  fingerprint?: string | null;
  clientSessionId?: string | null;
  info?: unknown;
}

export function deviceOf(d: DeviceInput | null | undefined): DeviceSignals | undefined {
  if (!d) return undefined;
  const info = d.info && typeof d.info === "object" && !Array.isArray(d.info) ? (d.info as DeviceSignals["info"]) : undefined;
  return { deviceId: d.deviceId ?? undefined, fingerprint: d.fingerprint ?? undefined, clientSessionId: d.clientSessionId ?? undefined, info };
}
```

## File: src/graphql/errors.ts

```ts
import { AuthError } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/auth-kit";
import { ConflictError, NotFoundError, PeriodLockedError, ValidationError } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { CreditLimitError } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit";
import { HttpError } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { GraphQLError } from "graphql";

/**
 * Every error code a client can see in `errors[].extensions.code`. A public contract: add codes,
 * never rename them (docs/05-errors.md). Anything else is masked as "Unexpected error".
 */
export const ERROR_CODES = [
  "UNAUTHENTICATED", "FORBIDDEN", "NOT_FOUND", "CONFLICT", "BAD_USER_INPUT",
  "PERIOD_LOCKED", "CREDIT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
  // auth-kit's own codes, passed through
  "INVALID_CREDENTIALS", "ACCOUNT_DISABLED", "INVITE_PENDING", "ORG_REQUIRED", "RATE_LIMITED", "WEAK_PASSWORD", "INVALID_TOKEN",
] as const;
export type ErrorCode = (typeof ERROR_CODES)[number];

export function apiError(code: ErrorCode, message: string, status: number, extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}): GraphQLError {
  // never pass `originalError`: Yoga masks any GraphQLError that wraps a non-GraphQL error as "Unexpected error"
  return new GraphQLError(message, { extensions: { code, http: { status }, ...extra } });
}

export const unauthenticated = () => apiError("UNAUTHENTICATED", "Sign in required", 401);
export const forbidden = (permission: string) => apiError("FORBIDDEN", `Missing permission ${permission}`, 403, { permission });
export const notFound = (what: string) => apiError("NOT_FOUND", `${what} not found`, 404);
export const badInput = (message: string) => apiError("BAD_USER_INPUT", message, 400);

/** Domain errors from the kits → GraphQL errors with codes. Anything unknown is re-thrown (and masked by Yoga). */
export function toGraphQLError(e: unknown): unknown {
  if (e instanceof GraphQLError) return e;
  if (e instanceof AuthError) return apiError(e.code as ErrorCode, e.message, e.statusCode, e.details.retryAfterMs ? { retryAfterMs: e.details.retryAfterMs } : {});
  if (e instanceof PeriodLockedError) return apiError("PERIOD_LOCKED", e.message, 409);
  if (e instanceof CreditLimitError) return apiError("CREDIT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", e.message, 409);
  if (e instanceof NotFoundError) return apiError("NOT_FOUND", e.message, 404);
  if (e instanceof ConflictError) return apiError("CONFLICT", e.message, 409);
  if (e instanceof ValidationError) return apiError("BAD_USER_INPUT", e.message, 400);
  // report-kit / invoice-kit input validation (HttpError 400)
  if (e instanceof HttpError && e.status === 400) return apiError("BAD_USER_INPUT", e.message, 400);
  return e;
}

type ResolverMap = Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>;

/** Wraps every resolver function of a map so domain errors surface with proper codes. */
export function withErrorCodes<R extends ResolverMap>(resolvers: R): R {
  for (const type of Object.values(resolvers)) {
    for (const [field, fn] of Object.entries(type)) {
      if (typeof fn !== "function") continue;
      type[field] = async (...args: unknown[]) => {
        try {
          return await (fn as (...a: unknown[]) => unknown)(...args);
        } catch (e) {
          throw toGraphQLError(e);
        }
      };
    }
  }
  return resolvers;
}
```

## File: src/graphql/guards.ts

```ts
import type { Id } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import type { Actor, RequestContext } from "./context";
import { forbidden, unauthenticated } from "./errors";

/** The signed-in user as an Actor; UNAUTHENTICATED otherwise. */
export function actorOf(ctx: RequestContext): Actor {
  if (!ctx.viewer) throw unauthenticated();
  return { userId: ctx.viewer.userId, orgId: ctx.viewer.orgId };
}

/** FORBIDDEN unless the viewer has `permission` in `branchId` (anywhere, when omitted). */
export function authorize(ctx: RequestContext, permission: string, branchId?: Id | null): Actor {
  const actor = actorOf(ctx);
  if (!ctx.can(permission, branchId)) throw forbidden(permission);
  return actor;
}

/** True when the viewer may see a nested field (no error: the field resolves to empty). */
export const canSee = (ctx: RequestContext, permission: string, branchId?: Id | null) => !!ctx.viewer && ctx.can(permission, branchId);

/** The branch filter for a list: the requested branch (checked) or every branch the viewer may read. */
export function branchScope(ctx: RequestContext, permission: string, branchId?: Id | null): "all" | Id[] {
  if (branchId) {
    authorize(ctx, permission, branchId);
    return [branchId];
  }
  actorOf(ctx);
  const allowed = ctx.branchesFor(permission);
  if (allowed !== "all" && !allowed.length) throw forbidden(permission);
  return allowed;
}

/** List limits are capped at 200. */
export const cap = (n: number | null | undefined, d: number) => Math.min(Math.max(1, n ?? d), 200);
```

## File: src/graphql/limits.ts

```ts
import { GraphQLError, Kind, type ASTVisitor, type FragmentDefinitionNode, type SelectionSetNode, type ValidationContext } from "graphql";

/** Rejects queries nested deeper than `max` levels (a cheap guard against abusive queries). */
export function depthLimit(max: number) {
  return (context: ValidationContext): ASTVisitor => {
    const fragments = new Map<string, FragmentDefinitionNode>();
    for (const d of context.getDocument().definitions) if (d.kind === Kind.FRAGMENT_DEFINITION) fragments.set(d.name.value, d);
    const depthOf = (set: SelectionSetNode | undefined, depth: number, seen: Set<string>): number => {
      if (!set) return depth;
      let deepest = depth;
      for (const s of set.selections) {
        if (s.kind === Kind.FIELD) deepest = Math.max(deepest, depthOf(s.selectionSet, s.selectionSet ? depth + 1 : depth, seen));
        else if (s.kind === Kind.INLINE_FRAGMENT) deepest = Math.max(deepest, depthOf(s.selectionSet, depth, seen));
        else if (!seen.has(s.name.value)) {
          const f = fragments.get(s.name.value);
          if (f) deepest = Math.max(deepest, depthOf(f.selectionSet, depth, new Set(seen).add(s.name.value)));
        }
      }
      return deepest;
    };
    return {
      OperationDefinition(op) {
        const depth = depthOf(op.selectionSet, 0, new Set());
        if (depth > max) context.reportError(new GraphQLError(`Query is ${depth} levels deep; the limit is ${max}`, { extensions: { code: "BAD_USER_INPUT" } }));
      },
    };
  };
}
```

## File: src/graphql/loaders.ts

```ts
import type { AccountGroup, Booking, Branch, Customer, Doctor, Invoice, Ledger, Partner, Patient, Repositories, User } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";

/**
 * Minimal DataLoader: every load() in the same tick is batched into one getMany(), and results are
 * memoised for the request. Prevents N+1 queries when a list resolves nested fields
 * (50 invoices → 1 query for their patients).
 */
export class BatchLoader<T extends { id: string }> {
  private cache = new Map<string, Promise<T | null>>();
  private queue: { id: string; resolve: (v: T | null) => void; reject: (e: unknown) => void }[] = [];

  constructor(private readonly fetchMany: (ids: readonly string[]) => Promise<T[]>) {}

  load(id: string | null | undefined): Promise<T | null> {
    if (!id) return Promise.resolve(null);
    const hit = this.cache.get(id);
    if (hit) return hit;
    const p = new Promise<T | null>((resolve, reject) => {
      this.queue.push({ id, resolve, reject });
      if (this.queue.length === 1) queueMicrotask(() => void this.flush());
    });
    this.cache.set(id, p);
    return p;
  }

  /** Seeds the cache with an entity you already have (e.g. just created). */
  prime(entity: T): void {
    this.cache.set(entity.id, Promise.resolve(entity));
  }

  clear(id: string): void {
    this.cache.delete(id);
  }

  private async flush(): Promise<void> {
    const batch = this.queue;
    this.queue = [];
    try {
      const rows = await this.fetchMany([...new Set(batch.map((b) => b.id))]);
      const byId = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r]));
      for (const b of batch) b.resolve(byId.get(b.id) ?? null);
    } catch (e) {
      for (const b of batch) {
        this.cache.delete(b.id);
        b.reject(e);
      }
    }
  }
}

/** One set per request (created lazily by the context). */
export function createLoaders(r: Repositories) {
  return {
    patient: new BatchLoader<Patient>((ids) => r.patients.getMany(ids)),
    branch: new BatchLoader<Branch>((ids) => r.branches.getMany(ids)),
    doctor: new BatchLoader<Doctor>((ids) => r.doctors.getMany(ids)),
    booking: new BatchLoader<Booking>((ids) => r.bookings.getMany(ids)),
    invoice: new BatchLoader<Invoice>((ids) => r.invoices.getMany(ids)),
    ledger: new BatchLoader<Ledger>((ids) => r.ledgers.getMany(ids)),
    group: new BatchLoader<AccountGroup>((ids) => r.accountGroups.getMany(ids)),
    customer: new BatchLoader<Customer>((ids) => r.customers.getMany(ids)),
    partner: new BatchLoader<Partner>((ids) => r.partners.getMany(ids)),
    user: new BatchLoader<User>((ids) => r.users.getMany(ids)),
  };
}

export type Loaders = ReturnType<typeof createLoaders>;
```

## File: src/graphql/scalars.ts

```ts
import { istDay } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit";
import { GraphQLScalarType, Kind } from "graphql";

const DAY = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;

const toDate = (v: unknown): Date => {
  const d = v instanceof Date ? v : new Date(v as string);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) throw new TypeError("Invalid DateTime");
  return d;
};

/** ISO-8601 instant, e.g. "2026-10-14T09:30:00.000Z". */
export const DateTime = new GraphQLScalarType({
  name: "DateTime",
  description: "ISO-8601 date-time (UTC), e.g. 2026-10-14T09:30:00.000Z",
  serialize: (v) => toDate(v).toISOString(),
  parseValue: (v) => toDate(v),
  parseLiteral: (ast) => (ast.kind === Kind.STRING ? toDate(ast.value) : null),
});

const toDay = (v: unknown): string => {
  if (typeof v !== "string" || !DAY.test(v) || Number.isNaN(Date.parse(`${v}T00:00:00Z`))) throw new TypeError(`Invalid Day "${String(v)}", expected YYYY-MM-DD`);
  return v;
};

/** A calendar day in India (IST), e.g. "2026-10-14". */
export const Day = new GraphQLScalarType({
  name: "Day",
  description: "Calendar day in IST, YYYY-MM-DD",
  serialize: (v) => (v instanceof Date ? istDay(v) : toDay(v)),
  parseValue: toDay,
  parseLiteral: (ast) => (ast.kind === Kind.STRING ? toDay(ast.value) : null),
});

/** Free-form JSON (report-kit report requests and other open shapes). */
export const JSONScalar = new GraphQLScalarType({
  name: "JSON",
  description: "Any JSON value",
  serialize: (v) => v,
  parseValue: (v) => v,
  parseLiteral: function literal(ast): unknown {
    switch (ast.kind) {
      case Kind.STRING:
      case Kind.BOOLEAN:
        return ast.value;
      case Kind.INT:
      case Kind.FLOAT:
        return Number(ast.value);
      case Kind.OBJECT:
        return Object.fromEntries(ast.fields.map((f) => [f.name.value, literal(f.value)]));
      case Kind.LIST:
        return ast.values.map((v) => literal(v));
      default:
        return null;
    }
  },
});
```

## File: src/graphql/schema.ts

```ts
import { makeExecutableSchema } from "@graphql-tools/schema";
import type { GraphQLSchema } from "graphql";
import { authController } from "../controllers/auth.controller";
import { baseController } from "../controllers/base.controller";
import { billingController } from "../controllers/billing.controller";
import { booksController } from "../controllers/books.controller";
import { catalogController } from "../controllers/catalog.controller";
import { documentsController } from "../controllers/documents.controller";
import { financeController } from "../controllers/finance.controller";
import { labController } from "../controllers/lab.controller";
import { organizationController } from "../controllers/organization.controller";
import { authTypeDefs } from "../schema/auth.graphql";
import { baseTypeDefs } from "../schema/base.graphql";
import { billingTypeDefs } from "../schema/billing.graphql";
import { booksTypeDefs } from "../schema/books.graphql";
import { catalogTypeDefs } from "../schema/catalog.graphql";
import { documentsTypeDefs } from "../schema/documents.graphql";
import { financeTypeDefs } from "../schema/finance.graphql";
import { labTypeDefs } from "../schema/lab.graphql";
import { organizationTypeDefs } from "../schema/organization.graphql";

/** One domain = one SDL file in src/schema + one controller in src/controllers. */
export interface GraphQLModule {
  name: string;
  typeDefs: string;
  resolvers: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export const MODULES: GraphQLModule[] = [
  { name: "base", typeDefs: baseTypeDefs, resolvers: baseController },
  { name: "auth", typeDefs: authTypeDefs, resolvers: authController },
  { name: "organization", typeDefs: organizationTypeDefs, resolvers: organizationController },
  { name: "catalog", typeDefs: catalogTypeDefs, resolvers: catalogController },
  { name: "lab", typeDefs: labTypeDefs, resolvers: labController },
  { name: "billing", typeDefs: billingTypeDefs, resolvers: billingController },
  { name: "books", typeDefs: booksTypeDefs, resolvers: booksController },
  { name: "finance", typeDefs: financeTypeDefs, resolvers: financeController },
  { name: "documents", typeDefs: documentsTypeDefs, resolvers: documentsController },
];

/** The whole API as one executable schema. */
export function buildSchema(modules: GraphQLModule[] = MODULES): GraphQLSchema {
  return makeExecutableSchema({ typeDefs: modules.map((m) => m.typeDefs), resolvers: modules.map((m) => m.resolvers) as never });
}
```

## File: src/index.ts

```ts
// The api as a library (tests, scripts, other entry points): build a container and a server.
export { loadConfig, type Config } from "./config/env";
```

## File: src/jobs/bullmq.ts

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { Job, Queue, UnrecoverableError, Worker, type JobsOptions } from "bullmq";
import { Redis } from "ioredis";
import type { RenderedDocument } from "../services/document.service";
import { processDocument, processPasswordReset, type JobDeps } from "./processors";
import { JobFailure, QUEUES, type DocumentJob, type JobInfo, type JobQueue, type JobState, type PasswordResetJob } from "./types";

export interface BullOptions {
  redisUrl: string;
  prefix: string;
  /** How long finished jobs (and their documents) stay readable. */
  keepResultsMs: number;
}

// BullMQ needs maxRetriesPerRequest: null on its connections (blocking commands)
const connect = (url: string) => new Redis(url, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null });

const jobOptions = (o: BullOptions, attempts: number): JobsOptions => ({
  jobId: randomUUID(), // unguessable; ownership is still checked on every read
  attempts,
  backoff: { type: "exponential", delay: 2000 },
  removeOnComplete: { age: Math.ceil(o.keepResultsMs / 1000) },
  removeOnFail: { age: Math.max(86_400, Math.ceil(o.keepResultsMs / 1000)) },
});

const STATES: Record<string, JobState> = { waiting: "waiting", "waiting-children": "waiting", prioritized: "waiting", active: "active", completed: "completed", failed: "failed", delayed: "delayed" };

async function toInfo(job: Job<DocumentJob, RenderedDocument>): Promise<JobInfo> {
  const state = STATES[await job.getState()] ?? "waiting";
  return {
    id: job.id!,
    kind: job.data.kind,
    state,
    attempts: job.attemptsMade,
    error: state === "failed" ? (job.failedReason ?? "Job failed") : null,
    document: state === "completed" ? (job.returnvalue ?? null) : null,
    createdAt: new Date(job.timestamp),
    finishedAt: job.finishedOn ? new Date(job.finishedOn) : null,
    actor: job.data.actor,
  };
}

/** The producer side, used by the API process: adds jobs to Redis. `npm run worker` runs them. */
export function createBullJobQueue(o: BullOptions): JobQueue {
  const connection = connect(o.redisUrl);
  const mail = new Queue<PasswordResetJob>(QUEUES.mail, { connection, prefix: o.prefix });
  const documents = new Queue<DocumentJob, RenderedDocument>(QUEUES.documents, { connection, prefix: o.prefix });
  return {
    mode: "bullmq",
    async passwordReset(job) {
      await mail.add("password-reset", job, jobOptions(o, 5));
    },
    async document(job) {
      return toInfo(await documents.add(job.kind, job, jobOptions(o, 2)));
    },
    async get(id) {
      const job = await Job.fromId<DocumentJob, RenderedDocument>(documents, id);
      return job ? toInfo(job) : null;
    },
    async close() {
      await Promise.all([mail.close(), documents.close()]);
      await connection.quit();
    },
  };
}

/** The consumer side (`src/worker.ts`): one BullMQ Worker per queue, sharing the API's services. */
export function startWorkers(deps: JobDeps, o: BullOptions & { concurrency: number }) {
  const connection = connect(o.redisUrl);
  // a JobFailure that retrying cannot fix fails the job at once
  const run = <T>(fn: () => Promise<T>) =>
    fn().catch((e: unknown) => {
      if (e instanceof JobFailure && !e.retry) throw new UnrecoverableError(e.message);
      throw e;
    });
  const workers = [
    new Worker<PasswordResetJob>(QUEUES.mail, (job) => run(() => processPasswordReset(deps, job.data)), { connection, prefix: o.prefix, concurrency: o.concurrency }),
    new Worker<DocumentJob, RenderedDocument>(QUEUES.documents, (job) => run(() => processDocument(deps, job.data)), { connection, prefix: o.prefix, concurrency: o.concurrency }),
  ];
  for (const w of workers) w.on("failed", (job, err) => console.warn(`[worker] ${w.name} job ${job?.id} failed (attempt ${job?.attemptsMade}): ${err.message}`));
  return {
    workers,
    async close() {
      await Promise.all(workers.map((w) => w.close()));
      await connection.quit();
    },
  };
}
```

## File: src/jobs/inline.ts

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { processDocument, processPasswordReset, type JobDeps } from "./processors";
import { JobFailure, type DocumentJob, type JobInfo, type JobQueue, type PasswordResetJob } from "./types";

/**
 * Jobs in this process, at once (no Redis): development, tests and a single server. Same results as
 * BullMQ, but the request waits for the work. Finished document jobs are kept for `keepResultsMs`.
 */
export function createInlineJobQueue(deps: () => JobDeps, o: { keepResultsMs: number }): JobQueue {
  const jobs = new Map<string, JobInfo>();
  const prune = () => {
    const cutoff = Date.now() - o.keepResultsMs;
    for (const [id, j] of jobs) if ((j.finishedAt?.getTime() ?? Infinity) < cutoff) jobs.delete(id);
  };
  return {
    mode: "inline",
    async passwordReset(job: PasswordResetJob) {
      await processPasswordReset(deps(), job);
    },
    async document(job: DocumentJob) {
      prune();
      const info: JobInfo = { id: randomUUID(), kind: job.kind, state: "active", attempts: 1, error: null, document: null, createdAt: new Date(), finishedAt: null, actor: job.actor };
      jobs.set(info.id, info);
      try {
        info.document = await processDocument(deps(), job);
        info.state = "completed";
      } catch (e) {
        info.state = "failed";
        info.error = e instanceof JobFailure ? e.message : "Job failed";
      }
      info.finishedAt = new Date();
      return info;
    },
    async get(id: string) {
      prune();
      return jobs.get(id) ?? null;
    },
    async close() {
      jobs.clear();
    },
  };
}
```

## File: src/jobs/mailer.ts

```ts
import { createMailer, smtpTransport, type Brand, type Mailer as MailKitMailer } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/mail-kit";
import type { LabProfile } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import type { Config } from "../config/env";
import type { Mailer } from "../services/auth.service";

/**
 * The Mailer on mail-kit: the "password-reset" mail (our mail design language → HTML + text), sent
 * straight through mail-kit's transport. It runs inside the worker's password-reset job (or in the API
 * without Redis), so the queueing is the api's own and mail-kit is given no queue.
 */
export function mailKitMailer(mail: MailKitMailer): Mailer {
  return {
    async passwordReset(to, link, expiresAt) {
      await mail.send("password-reset", { name: to.name, email: to.email, link, expiresAt: expiresAt.toISOString() }, { to: { name: to.name, email: to.email } });
    },
  };
}

/** The lab as mail-kit's brand (header and footer of every mail). Details come from report-kit's lab profile. */
export function brandFromLab(lab: LabProfile): Brand {
  return {
    name: lab.name,
    ...(lab.addressLines?.length ? { addressLines: lab.addressLines } : {}),
    ...(lab.phone ? { phone: lab.phone } : {}),
    ...(lab.email ? { email: lab.email } : {}),
  };
}

/**
 * A Mailer that POSTs each email as JSON `{ to, subject, text }` to an HTTP relay (MAIL_WEBHOOK_URL):
 * your email provider's API, or a small function in front of it. No SMTP dependency here.
 */
export function webhookMailer(url: string, fetchImpl: typeof fetch = fetch): Mailer {
  return {
    async passwordReset(to, link, expiresAt) {
      const res = await fetchImpl(url, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          to: to.email,
          subject: "Reset your MGPL Diagnostics password",
          text: `Hello ${to.name},\n\nOpen this link to choose a new password:\n${link}\n\nIt works once and expires at ${expiresAt.toISOString()}. If you did not ask for it, ignore this email.`,
        }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`mail relay answered ${res.status}`);
    },
  };
}

/** The Mailer the configuration asks for: mail-kit over SMTP_URL, else MAIL_WEBHOOK_URL, else none. */
export function mailerFromConfig(config: Config, lab: LabProfile): Mailer | undefined {
  if (config.smtp) {
    return mailKitMailer(createMailer({ transport: smtpTransport(config.smtp.url), from: config.smtp.from, brand: brandFromLab(lab) }));
  }
  return config.mailWebhookUrl ? webhookMailer(config.mailWebhookUrl) : undefined;
}
```

## File: src/jobs/processors.ts

```ts
import { AuthError, type Auth } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/auth-kit";
import { ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationError, type Repositories } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import type { Services } from "../services";
import type { RenderedDocument } from "../services/document.service";
import { JobFailure, type DocumentJob, type PasswordResetJob } from "./types";

/** What a job needs: the same services the API uses. */
export interface JobDeps {
  repos: Repositories;
  auth: Auth;
  services: Services;
}

/** mail · password-reset: creates the single-use token (auth-kit) and sends the link (the Mailer). */
export async function processPasswordReset(deps: JobDeps, job: PasswordResetJob): Promise<{ sent: boolean }> {
  try {
    return { sent: await deps.services.auth.sendPasswordReset(job) };
  } catch (e) {
    // too many requests for this email or IP: drop quietly, retrying would only hit the limit again
    if (e instanceof AuthError && e.code === "RATE_LIMITED") return { sent: false };
    throw e;
  }
}

/** documents · invoice | booking_reports: renders a stored document with invoice-kit / report-kit. */
export async function processDocument(deps: JobDeps, job: DocumentJob): Promise<RenderedDocument> {
  const { actor } = job;
  const user = await deps.repos.users.get(actor.userId);
  if (!user || user.status !== "active" || user.orgId !== actor.orgId) throw new JobFailure("The user who started this job is no longer active", false);
  try {
    if (job.kind === "invoice") {
      const invoice = await deps.services.billing.get(actor, job.invoiceId!);
      return await deps.services.documents.renderStoredInvoice(actor, invoice, job.options);
    }
    return await deps.services.documents.renderBookingReports(actor, job.bookingId!, job.reportIds ?? null, job.options);
  } catch (e) {
    // domain errors will not change on a retry, and their messages are safe to show
    if (e instanceof NotFoundError || e instanceof ConflictError || e instanceof ValidationError) throw new JobFailure(e.message, false);
    console.error("[jobs] document job failed", e);
    throw new JobFailure("Rendering failed", true);
  }
}
```

## File: src/jobs/types.ts

```ts
import type { Id } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import type { Actor } from "../graphql/context";
import type { RenderedDocument, RenderOptions } from "../services/document.service";

/** Queue names (Redis keys are `<QUEUE_PREFIX>:<queue>:…`). */
export const QUEUES = { mail: "mail", documents: "documents" } as const;

/** mail queue: the worker creates the reset token itself, so no raw token ever sits in Redis. */
export interface PasswordResetJob {
  email: string;
  orgCode?: string | null;
  ip?: string;
}

export type DocumentJobKind = "invoice" | "booking_reports";

/** documents queue. Permissions were checked when the job was started; the worker re-reads the user. */
export interface DocumentJob {
  kind: DocumentJobKind;
  actor: Actor;
  invoiceId?: Id | null;
  bookingId?: Id | null;
  reportIds?: Id[] | null;
  options: RenderOptions;
}

export type JobState = "waiting" | "active" | "completed" | "failed" | "delayed";

/** A document job as the API shows it. Only the user who started it can read it. */
export interface JobInfo {
  id: string;
  kind: DocumentJobKind;
  state: JobState;
  attempts: number;
  error: string | null;
  document: RenderedDocument | null;
  createdAt: Date;
  finishedAt: Date | null;
  actor: Actor;
}

/**
 * Where services put background work. Two implementations with the same behaviour:
 * BullMQ on Redis (`bullmq.ts`, run `npm run worker`) and in-process (`inline.ts`, no Redis: dev, tests, one server).
 */
export interface JobQueue {
  readonly mode: "bullmq" | "inline";
  passwordReset(job: PasswordResetJob): Promise<void>;
  document(job: DocumentJob): Promise<JobInfo>;
  get(id: string): Promise<JobInfo | null>;
  close(): Promise<void>;
}

/** A job failure whose message is safe to show to the client. `retry: false` = retrying cannot help. */
export class JobFailure extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, readonly retry: boolean) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "JobFailure";
  }
}
```

## File: src/main.ts

```ts
// Starts the API: `npm run dev` (watch) or `npm run build && npm start`.
import { loadConfig } from "./config/env";
import { createContainer } from "./container";
import { buildServer } from "./server";

const config = loadConfig();
const container = await createContainer({ config });
if (config.env === "production" && !config.redisUrl) console.warn("[api] REDIS_URL is not set: sessions and jobs live in this process only (one server, lost on restart)");
if (config.jwt.generated) console.warn("[api] JWT_SECRET is not set: using a random secret, so tokens die when the process restarts");
// With REDIS_URL, emails and background documents are sent and rendered by `npm run worker`.
// Without it they run here; reset links go out through mail-kit (SMTP_URL), MAIL_WEBHOOK_URL, or createContainer({ config, mailer }).
if (config.env === "production" && !config.redisUrl && !config.smtp && !config.mailWebhookUrl) console.warn("[api] no Mailer configured: password-reset links are not sent");
const app = await buildServer(container);
await app.listen({ host: config.host, port: config.port });
console.log(`[api] GraphQL on http://${config.host}:${config.port}${config.graphqlPath} (${config.db.backend})`);

for (const signal of ["SIGINT", "SIGTERM"] as const) {
  process.once(signal, () => {
    app.close().then(() => process.exit(0), () => process.exit(1));
  });
}
```

## File: src/schema/auth.graphql.ts

```ts
/** Sign-in, sessions, passwords (auth-kit) and users and roles. */
export const authTypeDefs = /* GraphQL */ `
  enum UserStatus { active disabled invited }

  type RoleAssignment { role: String!, branchId: ID, branch: Branch }
  input RoleAssignmentInput { role: String!, branchId: ID }

  type User {
    id: ID!
    name: String!
    email: String!
    phone: String
    status: UserStatus!
    roles: [RoleAssignment!]!
    lastLoginAt: DateTime
    createdAt: DateTime!
  }

  type Role { id: ID!, key: String!, name: String!, permissions: [String!]!, system: Boolean! }

  "The signed-in user and what they may do."
  type Viewer {
    user: User!
    organization: Organization!
    "Permissions held in this branch (or organisation-wide when branchId is omitted)."
    permissions(branchId: ID): [String!]!
    "Branches where the user has this permission; null means every branch."
    branchesFor(permission: String!): [ID!]
    can(permission: String!, branchId: ID): Boolean!
  }

  type Session {
    id: ID!
    current: Boolean!
    createdAt: DateTime!
    lastSeenAt: DateTime!
    expiresAt: DateTime!
    ip: String
    userAgent: String
    "The device id sent at sign-in: refresh tokens of this session work only there."
    deviceId: String
    "The latest device description the client sent (platform, language, timezone, screen, …)."
    deviceInfo: JSON
  }

  """
  Security signals the client sends with login and refreshSession (the client SDK collects them).
  All optional; malformed values are dropped. See docs/06-authentication.md.
  """
  input DeviceInput {
    "Random id the client keeps per browser profile or app install (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . : + / = -)."
    deviceId: String
    "Client-side hash of stable device attributes. A change is logged, never blocked."
    fingerprint: String
    "Random id per tab or app run."
    clientSessionId: String
    "Descriptive values: at most 20 keys, short strings, numbers or booleans."
    info: JSON
  }

  """
  Tokens after login or refresh. Send the access token as 'Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>'; when
  it expires (UNAUTHENTICATED), trade the refresh token for a new pair with refreshSession.
  """
  type LoginResult {
    "Short-lived HS256 JWT (default 15 minutes). Every request still checks the session and re-reads the user."
    accessToken: String!
    accessExpiresAt: DateTime!
    "Opaque and single-use: refreshSession returns the next one. The server stores only its SHA-256."
    refreshToken: String!
    "Slides with each refresh (idle window), never past the session's maximum age."
    refreshExpiresAt: DateTime!
    user: User!
    "Same as accessToken."
    token: String! @deprecated(reason: "Use accessToken.")
    "Same as accessExpiresAt."
    expiresAt: DateTime! @deprecated(reason: "Use accessExpiresAt.")
  }

  extend type Query {
    "null when not signed in."
    viewer: Viewer
    mySessions: [Session!]!
    users: [User!]!
    user(id: ID!): User
    roles: [Role!]!
    "Every permission name the API checks."
    permissions: [String!]!
  }

  input LoginInput { email: String!, password: String!, "Only when the same email exists in several organisations." orgCode: String, device: DeviceInput }
  input CreateUserInput { name: String!, email: String!, phone: String, password: String!, roles: [RoleAssignmentInput!]! }
  input RoleInput { key: String!, name: String!, permissions: [String!]! }

  extend type Mutation {
    login(input: LoginInput!): LoginResult!
    """
    Spends a refresh token and returns a new access token and the next refresh token. A refresh token
    used twice ends its session (it was copied); within a few seconds (two tabs) the second use only fails.
    Send the same device as at login: a refresh from another device id ends the session (DEVICE_BINDING).
    INVALID_TOKEN when it is unknown, spent or expired: sign in again.
    """
    refreshSession(refreshToken: String!, device: DeviceInput): LoginResult!
    "Ends this session: the bearer token (even an expired access token), or the refresh token when given."
    logout(refreshToken: String): Boolean!
    "Ends every other session of the signed-in user; returns how many."
    logoutOtherSessions: Int!
    revokeSession(id: ID!): Boolean!
    changePassword(currentPassword: String!, newPassword: String!): Boolean!
    "Always true (never reveals whether the email exists). Queued: the worker creates the single-use token and mails the link."
    requestPasswordReset(email: String!, orgCode: String): Boolean!
    resetPassword(token: String!, newPassword: String!): Boolean!

    createUser(input: CreateUserInput!): User!
    setUserRoles(userId: ID!, roles: [RoleAssignmentInput!]!): User!
    disableUser(userId: ID!): User!
    enableUser(userId: ID!): User!
    setUserPassword(userId: ID!, newPassword: String!): Boolean!
    upsertRole(input: RoleInput!): Role!
  }
`;
```

```ts
/**
 * Shared scalars, enums and the root types. Money is Int paise (Rs 1 = 100). Instants are DateTime
 * (ISO-8601, UTC); calendar days are Day ("2026-10-14", IST). Every query is scoped to the signed-in
 * user's organisation: nothing takes an orgId.
 */
export const baseTypeDefs = /* GraphQL */ `
  scalar DateTime
  scalar Day
  scalar JSON

  enum Sex { male female other }
  enum PaymentMode { cash upi card netbanking wallet cheque insurance }
  enum ItemCategory { test package service consumable medicine other }
  enum Taxability { taxable exempt nil_rated non_gst }
  enum VoucherType { sales receipt payment journal contra credit_note debit_note purchase closing }

  type Address { line1: String, line2: String, city: String, district: String, state: String, pincode: String }
  input AddressInput { line1: String, line2: String, city: String, district: String, state: String, pincode: String }

  "Service health: database reachable, versions."
  type Health { ok: Boolean!, service: String!, version: String!, database: String!, time: DateTime! }

  type Query {
    health: Health!
  }

  type Mutation {
    "Does nothing; lets clients check that mutations reach the server."
    ping: String!
  }
`;
```

```ts
/** Patient invoices and payments. Issuing and paying post to the books automatically. */
export const billingTypeDefs = /* GraphQL */ `
  enum InvoiceStatus { draft issued partially_paid paid cancelled refunded credited }
  enum PaymentKind { payment refund }

  type InvoiceItem {
    code: String
    name: String!
    category: ItemCategory!
    qty: Float!
    ratePaise: Int!
    discountPaise: Int!
    taxPercent: Float!
    hsnSac: String
    taxability: Taxability
    amountPaise: Int!
  }

  type Invoice {
    id: ID!
    invoiceNo: String!
    status: InvoiceStatus!
    patient: Patient!
    branch: Branch!
    booking: Booking
    customer: Customer
    placeOfSupply: String
    buyerGstin: String
    items: [InvoiceItem!]!

    discountPaise: Int!
    taxPaise: Int!
    roundOffPaise: Int!
    totalPaise: Int!
    paidPaise: Int!
    creditedPaise: Int!
    duePaise: Int!
    issuedAt: DateTime
    cancelReason: String
    createdAt: DateTime!
    payments: [Payment!]!
    vouchers: [Voucher!]!
    creditNotes: [CreditNote!]!

  extend type Query {
    invoice(id: ID!): Invoice
    invoices(branchId: ID, status: InvoiceStatus, patientId: ID, customerId: ID, limit: Int = 50, offset: Int = 0): [Invoice!]!

  "A catalog-kit test code alone is enough: name and MRP come from the catalog."
```

## File: src/schema/books.graphql.ts

```ts
/** The books (tally-kit, our accounting engine): chart of accounts, vouchers, reports. */
export const booksTypeDefs = /* GraphQL */ `
  enum AccountNature { assets liabilities income expenses }
  enum VoucherStatus { posted cancelled }
  enum AgeBucket { D0_30 D31_60 D61_90 D90_PLUS }

  type AccountGroup { id: ID!, name: String!, nature: AccountNature!, parent: AccountGroup, affectsGrossProfit: Boolean! }

  type Ledger {
    id: ID!
    name: String!
    group: AccountGroup!
    openingPaise: Int!
    systemKey: String
    gstin: String
    active: Boolean!
    "Closing balance, positive = Debit."
    balancePaise(asOf: DateTime, branchId: ID): Int!
  }

  type VoucherEntry { ledger: Ledger!, debitPaise: Int!, creditPaise: Int!, invoiceId: ID }

  type Voucher {
    id: ID!
    type: VoucherType!
    voucherNo: String!
    date: DateTime!
    narration: String
    status: VoucherStatus!
    entries: [VoucherEntry!]!
    branch: Branch!
    invoiceId: ID
  }

  type StatementRow { date: DateTime!, voucherNo: String!, voucherType: VoucherType!, debitPaise: Int!, creditPaise: Int!, balancePaise: Int!, invoiceId: ID }
  type LedgerStatement { ledger: Ledger!, openingPaise: Int!, closingPaise: Int!, totalDebitPaise: Int!, totalCreditPaise: Int!, rows: [StatementRow!]! }
  type TrialBalanceRow { ledger: Ledger!, group: AccountGroup!, primaryGroup: AccountGroup!, debitPaise: Int!, creditPaise: Int! }
  type TrialBalance { rows: [TrialBalanceRow!]!, totalDebitPaise: Int!, totalCreditPaise: Int!, differencePaise: Int! }
  type LedgerAmount { ledger: Ledger!, amountPaise: Int! }
  type GroupLine { group: AccountGroup!, amountPaise: Int!, ledgers: [LedgerAmount!]! }
  type ProfitAndLoss { income: [GroupLine!]!, expenses: [GroupLine!]!, grossProfitPaise: Int!, netProfitPaise: Int! }
  type BalanceSheet { assets: [GroupLine!]!, liabilities: [GroupLine!]!, profitPaise: Int!, totalAssetsPaise: Int!, totalLiabilitiesPaise: Int!, differencePaise: Int! }
  type OutstandingRow { invoice: Invoice!, ageDays: Int!, bucket: AgeBucket! }
  type BucketTotals { d0to30: Int!, d31to60: Int!, d61to90: Int!, d90plus: Int! }
  type Outstanding { rows: [OutstandingRow!]!, buckets: BucketTotals!, totalDuePaise: Int! }
  type GstSummary { taxableValuePaise: Int!, cgstPaise: Int!, sgstPaise: Int!, igstPaise: Int!, totalTaxPaise: Int! }

  extend type Query {
    accountGroups: [AccountGroup!]!
    ledgers: [Ledger!]!
    ledger(id: ID!): Ledger
    voucher(id: ID!): Voucher
    ledgerStatement(ledgerId: ID!, from: DateTime!, to: DateTime!, branchId: ID): LedgerStatement!
    cashBook(from: DateTime!, to: DateTime!, branchId: ID): LedgerStatement!
    trialBalance(asOf: DateTime, branchId: ID): TrialBalance!
    profitAndLoss(from: DateTime!, to: DateTime!, branchId: ID): ProfitAndLoss!
    balanceSheet(asOf: DateTime!, branchId: ID): BalanceSheet!
    dayBook(from: DateTime!, to: DateTime!, branchId: ID, type: VoucherType): [Voucher!]!
    outstandingReceivables(asOf: DateTime, branchId: ID): Outstanding!
    gstSummary(from: DateTime!, to: DateTime!, branchId: ID): GstSummary!
  }

  input VoucherEntryInput { ledgerId: ID!, debitPaise: Int = 0, creditPaise: Int = 0, invoiceId: ID }
  input PostVoucherInput { branchId: ID!, type: VoucherType!, date: DateTime, narration: String, entries: [VoucherEntryInput!]! }
  input LedgerInput { name: String!, groupId: ID!, openingPaise: Int = 0, gstin: String }

  extend type Mutation {
    "Seeds the standard chart (28 groups, default ledgers) and finance-kit's ledgers. Idempotent."
    setupChartOfAccounts: [Ledger!]!
    createLedger(input: LedgerInput!): Ledger!
    postVoucher(input: PostVoucherInput!): Voucher!
    cancelVoucher(id: ID!): Voucher!
  }
`;
```

```ts
/** The test catalog (catalog-kit): tests, parameters, ranges, sample types, prices, search. */
export const catalogTypeDefs = /* GraphQL */ `

    female: CatalogInterval
```

## File: src/schema/documents.graphql.ts

```ts
/**
 * Documents rendered by report-kit (lab reports, letterhead) and invoice-kit (invoices), used as
 * internal libraries. PDFs come back base64-encoded in \`base64\`; HTML is self-contained in \`html\`.
 */
export const documentsTypeDefs = /* GraphQL */ `
  enum DocumentFormat { pdf html }
  enum ReportVariant { header non_header }
  enum ReportDesign { sidebar classic }

  type Document {
    format: DocumentFormat!
    fileName: String!
    mimeType: String!
    byteLength: Int!
    "PDF bytes, base64 (null for HTML)."
    base64: String
    "Self-contained HTML (null for PDF)."
    html: String
  }

  type TemplateField { key: String!, label: String!, unit: String, range: [String!] }
  type ReportTemplate { id: String!, name: String!, category: String, specimen: String, method: String, fields: [TemplateField!]! }
  type ReportProfile { id: String!, name: String!, tests: [String!]! }
  type TemplateCatalog { templates: [ReportTemplate!]!, profiles: [ReportProfile!]! }
  type PriceListEntry { code: String!, name: String!, category: String!, "rupees" rate: Float!, taxPercent: Float, hsn: String }
  type DocumentSample { id: String!, label: String!, group: String }

  enum JobState { waiting active completed failed delayed }
  enum DocumentJobKind { invoice booking_reports }

  "Background work run by the worker (BullMQ on Redis), or in the API process when there is no Redis."
  type Job {
    id: ID!
    kind: DocumentJobKind!
    state: JobState!
    "Tries so far (failed jobs are retried with back-off)."
    attempts: Int!
    "Why it failed (state failed)."
    error: String
    "The rendered document (state completed). Kept for an hour by default."
    document: Document
    createdAt: DateTime!
    finishedAt: DateTime
  }

  input DocumentJobInput {
    kind: DocumentJobKind!
    "kind invoice"
    invoiceId: ID
    "kind booking_reports"
    bookingId: ID
    "kind booking_reports: only these reports (default: every verified or released one)"
    reportIds: [ID!]
    format: DocumentFormat = pdf
    variant: ReportVariant = header
    design: ReportDesign = sidebar
  }

  extend type Query {
    "A job you started (null when unknown, expired, or someone else's)."
    job(id: ID!): Job
    reportTemplates: TemplateCatalog!
    "invoice-kit's sample price list (codes = report-kit template and profile ids, services, consumables)."
    priceList: [PriceListEntry!]!
    "Demo samples (empty unless the server enables them)."
    documentSamples: [DocumentSample!]!
    invoiceSamples: [DocumentSample!]!

    "Any report: request = report-kit's ReportRequest JSON (patient + tests | profile | report | sample)."
    renderReport(request: JSON!, format: DocumentFormat = pdf, variant: ReportVariant = header, design: ReportDesign = sidebar, fileName: String): Document!
    "Any invoice: request = invoice-kit's InvoiceRequest JSON ({ invoice } or { sample })."
    renderInvoice(request: JSON!, format: DocumentFormat = pdf, variant: ReportVariant = header, fileName: String): Document!
    "invoice-kit's calculation of an InvoiceRequest, without rendering (rupees)."
    invoiceTotals(request: JSON!): JSON!
    letterhead(format: DocumentFormat = pdf): Document!

    "A stored invoice, printed."
    invoiceDocument(invoiceId: ID!, format: DocumentFormat = pdf, variant: ReportVariant = header): Document!
    "A booking's verified or released reports, printed together (or only reportIds)."
    bookingReportDocument(bookingId: ID!, reportIds: [ID!], format: DocumentFormat = pdf, variant: ReportVariant = header, design: ReportDesign = sidebar): Document!
  }

  extend type Mutation {
    "Renders a stored invoice or a booking's reports in the background; poll job(id) until completed or failed."
    startDocumentJob(input: DocumentJobInput!): Job!
  }
`;
```

```ts
/**
 * finance-kit: GST, B2B receivables and credit notes, collection-centre settlements with TDS, day-end
 * cash, bank reconciliation, lock dates, year-end close, CSV exports. Compliance values are
 * configuration to be verified with the lab's CA (see verifyWithCA); nothing here is legal advice.
 */
export const financeTypeDefs = /* GraphQL */ `
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- GST
  type TaxRule { id: ID!, code: String, category: ItemCategory, hsnSac: String!, taxability: Taxability!, ratePercent: Float!, effectiveFrom: DateTime!, effectiveTo: DateTime, note: String }

  type TdsConfig { section: String!, rateBp: Int!, noPanRateBp: Int!, thresholdPaise: Int }
  type FinanceConfig { b2clThresholdPaise: Int!, tds: TdsConfig!, bankToleranceDays: Int!, bankMaxFeeBp: Int!, clearingLedgerKeys: [String!]! }

  type RateTotals { ratePercent: Float!, taxablePaise: Int!, igstPaise: Int!, cgstPaise: Int!, sgstPaise: Int!, cessPaise: Int! }
  type TaxTotals { taxablePaise: Int!, igstPaise: Int!, cgstPaise: Int!, sgstPaise: Int!, cessPaise: Int! }
  type Gstr1Invoice { invoiceId: ID!, invoiceNo: String!, day: Day!, valuePaise: Int!, placeOfSupply: String!, reverseCharge: String!, ctin: String, items: [RateTotals!]! }
  type Gstr1Note { noteId: ID!, noteNo: String!, day: Day!, noteType: String!, invoiceNo: String!, invoiceDay: Day!, valuePaise: Int!, placeOfSupply: String!, ctin: String, type: String, items: [RateTotals!]! }
  type B2csRow { supplyType: String!, placeOfSupply: String!, ratePercent: Float!, taxablePaise: Int!, igstPaise: Int!, cgstPaise: Int!, sgstPaise: Int!, cessPaise: Int! }
  type NilRow { description: String!, nilRatedPaise: Int!, exemptedPaise: Int!, nonGstPaise: Int! }
  type HsnRow { hsnSac: String!, ratePercent: Float!, taxability: Taxability!, qty: Float!, taxablePaise: Int!, igstPaise: Int!, cgstPaise: Int!, sgstPaise: Int!, cessPaise: Int!, totalValuePaise: Int! }
  type HsnSummary { b2b: [HsnRow!]!, b2c: [HsnRow!]! }
  type DocSeries { nature: String!, series: String!, from: String!, to: String!, total: Int!, cancelled: Int!, net: Int! }
  type Period { from: DateTime!, to: DateTime! }

  type Gstr1 {
    gstin: String!
    period: Period!
    b2b: [Gstr1Invoice!]!
    b2cl: [Gstr1Invoice!]!
    b2cs: [B2csRow!]!
    cdnr: [Gstr1Note!]!
    cdnur: [Gstr1Note!]!
    nil: [NilRow!]!
    hsn: HsnSummary!
    docs: [DocSeries!]!
    totals: TaxTotals!
    verifyWithCA: [String!]!
  }

  type InterStateRow { placeOfSupply: String!, taxablePaise: Int!, igstPaise: Int! }
  type Gstr3b {
    gstin: String!
    period: Period!
    "3.1(a)"
    outwardTaxable: TaxTotals!
    "3.1(c)"
    outwardNilExemptPaise: Int!
    "3.1(e)"
    outwardNonGstPaise: Int!
    "3.2"
    interStateUnregistered: [InterStateRow!]!
    verifyWithCA: [String!]!
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- receivables
  enum CustomerKind { hospital insurer tpa corporate other }
  enum OpenItemBucket { not_due D1_30 D31_60 D61_90 D90_PLUS }

  type Customer {
    id: ID!
    code: String!
    name: String!
    kind: CustomerKind!
    legalName: String
    gstin: String
    stateCode: String
    pan: String
    phone: String
    email: String
    address: Address
    "null = no limit."
    creditLimitPaise: Int
    creditDays: Int!
    ledger: Ledger!
    active: Boolean!
  }

  type OpenItem { invoiceId: ID!, invoiceNo: String!, day: Day!, dueDay: Day!, totalPaise: Int!, paidPaise: Int!, creditedPaise: Int!, duePaise: Int!, overdueDays: Int!, bucket: OpenItemBucket! }
  type Ageing { notDue: Int!, d1to30: Int!, d31to60: Int!, d61to90: Int!, d90plus: Int! }
  type CustomerStatement {
    customer: Customer!
    openingPaise: Int!
    rows: [StatementRow!]!
    totalDebitPaise: Int!
    totalCreditPaise: Int!
    closingPaise: Int!
    open: [OpenItem!]!
    ageing: Ageing!
    openTotalPaise: Int!
    availableCreditPaise: Int
  }
  type ReceivablesRow { customer: Customer!, balancePaise: Int!, overduePaise: Int!, ageing: Ageing! }
  type ReceivablesSummary { rows: [ReceivablesRow!]!, totalPaise: Int! }

  type CreditNoteLine { itemIndex: Int!, name: String!, code: String, hsnSac: String, taxability: Taxability, taxPercent: Float!, taxablePaise: Int!, taxPaise: Int!, cgstPaise: Int!, sgstPaise: Int!, igstPaise: Int! }
  type CreditNote {
    id: ID!
    noteNo: String!
    date: DateTime!
    reason: String!
    invoice: Invoice!
    customer: Customer
    lines: [CreditNoteLine!]!
    taxablePaise: Int!
    taxPaise: Int!
    cgstPaise: Int!
    sgstPaise: Int!
    igstPaise: Int!
    roundOffPaise: Int!
    totalPaise: Int!
    placeOfSupply: String
    buyerGstin: String
    status: String!
  }
  type CreditNoteResult { creditNote: CreditNote!, invoice: Invoice!, "Refund with refundPayment." refundablePaise: Int! }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- settlements
  enum PartnerKind { collection_centre franchise }
  enum AgreementKind { revenue_share fixed_rate }
  enum SettlementStatus { draft accrued paid cancelled }

  type PartnerTds { section: String!, rateBp: Int! }
  type Partner {
    id: ID!
    code: String!
    name: String!
    kind: PartnerKind!
    branch: Branch!
    legalName: String
    pan: String
    gstin: String
    stateCode: String
    phone: String
    email: String
    address: Address
    ledger: Ledger!
    "Overrides the default TDS (verify with CA)."
    tds: PartnerTds
    active: Boolean!
    agreements: [PartnerAgreement!]!
  }

  type ShareRate { code: String!, sharePaise: Int! }
  type PartnerAgreement { id: ID!, kind: AgreementKind!, shareBp: Int, rates: [ShareRate!], defaultSharePaise: Int, categories: [ItemCategory!], effectiveFrom: DateTime!, effectiveTo: DateTime, notes: String }

  type SettlementLine { invoiceId: ID!, invoiceNo: String!, day: Day!, code: String, name: String!, netPaise: Int!, sharePaise: Int!, agreementId: ID!, creditNoteId: ID }
  type SettlementDeduction { label: String!, amountPaise: Int!, ledgerId: ID }
  type Tds { section: String, rateBp: Int!, basePaise: Int!, tdsPaise: Int! }

  "A settlement computed but not saved."
  type SettlementPreview {
    partner: Partner!
    period: String!
    from: DateTime!
    to: DateTime!
    lines: [SettlementLine!]!
    grossPaise: Int!
    sharePaise: Int!
    deductions: [SettlementDeduction!]!
    deductionsPaise: Int!
    tds: Tds!
    netPaise: Int!
    "Invoice numbers with no agreement in force on their date."
    uncoveredInvoices: [String!]!
  }

  type Settlement {
    id: ID!
    partner: Partner!
    branch: Branch!
    period: String!
    from: DateTime!
    to: DateTime!
    lines: [SettlementLine!]!
    grossPaise: Int!
    sharePaise: Int!
    deductions: [SettlementDeduction!]!
    deductionsPaise: Int!
    tdsSection: String
    tdsRateBp: Int!
    tdsBasePaise: Int!
    tdsPaise: Int!
    netPaise: Int!
    status: SettlementStatus!
    accrualVoucher: Voucher
    payoutVoucher: Voucher
    paidAt: DateTime
    createdAt: DateTime!
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- cash and bank
  enum BankLineStatus { unmatched matched ignored }

  type CashDenomination { valuePaise: Int!, count: Int! }
  type CashClosing { id: ID!, branch: Branch!, day: Day!, bookPaise: Int!, countedPaise: Int!, "counted − book; negative = short." differencePaise: Int!, denominations: [CashDenomination!], voucher: Voucher, notes: String, createdAt: DateTime! }

  type BankStatement { id: ID!, branch: Branch!, ledger: Ledger!, fileName: String, from: DateTime, to: DateTime, openingPaise: Int, closingPaise: Int, lineCount: Int!, createdAt: DateTime! }
  type BankSettlementMatch { ledgerId: ID!, day: Day!, grossPaise: Int!, feePaise: Int! }
  type BankLine { id: ID!, statementId: ID!, date: DateTime!, description: String!, reference: String, debitPaise: Int!, creditPaise: Int!, balancePaise: Int, status: BankLineStatus!, matchKind: String, voucherIds: [ID!]!, settlement: BankSettlementMatch, matchedAt: DateTime }
  type BankImportResult { statement: BankStatement!, added: Int!, skipped: Int! }
  type ReconcileResult { matched: Int!, settlements: Int!, unmatched: Int! }
  type LedgerEntryRow { id: ID!, voucherId: ID!, voucherType: VoucherType!, voucherNo: String!, date: DateTime!, debitPaise: Int!, creditPaise: Int!, invoiceId: ID }
  type ReconciledTotals { lines: Int!, amountPaise: Int! }
  type BankReconciliation {
    bookPaise: Int!
    bankPaise: Int
    paymentsNotPresentedPaise: Int!
    depositsNotCreditedPaise: Int!
    bankCreditsNotInBooksPaise: Int!
    bankDebitsNotInBooksPaise: Int!
    expectedBankPaise: Int!
    differencePaise: Int
    reconciled: ReconciledTotals!
    unmatchedLines: [BankLine!]!
    unreconciledEntries: [LedgerEntryRow!]!
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- periods
  type PeriodLock { id: ID!, scope: String!, branch: Branch, lockedUpTo: DateTime, reason: String, updatedAt: DateTime! }
  type YearEndResult { vouchers: [Voucher!]!, netProfitPaise: Int! }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- exports
  type CsvFile { fileName: String!, mimeType: String!, content: String! }

  extend type Query {
    taxRules: [TaxRule!]!
    financeConfig: FinanceConfig!
    "Items the lab's CA must confirm before these values are relied on."
    verifyWithCA: [String!]!
    gstr1(from: DateTime!, to: DateTime!, gstin: String): Gstr1!
    gstr3b(from: DateTime!, to: DateTime!, gstin: String): Gstr3b!

    customers(activeOnly: Boolean = true): [Customer!]!
    customer(id: ID!): Customer
    customerStatement(customerId: ID!, from: DateTime!, to: DateTime!): CustomerStatement!
    receivablesSummary(asOf: DateTime!): ReceivablesSummary!
    creditNote(id: ID!): CreditNote
    creditNotes(invoiceId: ID, customerId: ID, limit: Int = 50, offset: Int = 0): [CreditNote!]!

    partners(branchId: ID): [Partner!]!
    partner(id: ID!): Partner
    "Computes a month's settlement without saving it. period: YYYY-MM."
    settlementPreview(partnerId: ID!, period: String!, deductions: [SettlementDeductionInput!]): SettlementPreview!
    settlements(partnerId: ID, status: SettlementStatus, branchId: ID, limit: Int = 50, offset: Int = 0): [Settlement!]!
    settlement(id: ID!): Settlement

    cashClosings(branchId: ID!, limit: Int = 31, offset: Int = 0): [CashClosing!]!
    bankStatements(ledgerId: ID, limit: Int = 50, offset: Int = 0): [BankStatement!]!
    bankLines(ledgerId: ID, statementId: ID, status: BankLineStatus, limit: Int = 100, offset: Int = 0): [BankLine!]!
    bankReconciliation(ledgerId: ID!, asOf: DateTime!): BankReconciliation!

    lockDates: [PeriodLock!]!

    exportDayBook(from: DateTime!, to: DateTime!, branchId: ID, bom: Boolean = false): CsvFile!
    exportLedger(ledgerId: ID!, from: DateTime!, to: DateTime!, branchId: ID, bom: Boolean = false): CsvFile!
    exportTrialBalance(asOf: DateTime, branchId: ID, bom: Boolean = false): CsvFile!
    exportProfitAndLoss(from: DateTime!, to: DateTime!, branchId: ID, bom: Boolean = false): CsvFile!
    exportBalanceSheet(asOf: DateTime!, branchId: ID, bom: Boolean = false): CsvFile!
    exportSettlement(settlementId: ID!, bom: Boolean = false): CsvFile!
    "One file per section: b2b, b2cl, b2cs, cdnr, cdnur, nil, hsn, docs."
    exportGstr1(from: DateTime!, to: DateTime!, gstin: String, bom: Boolean = false): [CsvFile!]!
    exportGstr3b(from: DateTime!, to: DateTime!, gstin: String, bom: Boolean = false): CsvFile!
  }

  input TaxRuleInput { code: String, category: ItemCategory, hsnSac: String!, taxability: Taxability!, ratePercent: Float!, effectiveFrom: Day!, note: String }

  input CustomerInput { code: String!, name: String!, kind: CustomerKind!, legalName: String, gstin: String, stateCode: String, pan: String, phone: String, email: String, address: AddressInput, creditLimitPaise: Int, creditDays: Int }
  input CustomerPatch { name: String, kind: CustomerKind, legalName: String, gstin: String, stateCode: String, pan: String, phone: String, email: String, address: AddressInput, "null removes the limit." creditLimitPaise: Int, creditDays: Int, active: Boolean }
  input CustomerInvoiceInput {
    branchId: ID!
    patientId: ID!
    customerId: ID!
    bookingId: ID
    items: [InvoiceItemInput!]!
    billDiscountPaise: Int = 0
    payments: [PaymentInput!]
    "State code override."
    placeOfSupply: String
    applyTaxRules: Boolean = true
  }
  input CreditNoteLineInput { itemIndex: Int!, taxablePaise: Int }
  input CreditNoteInput { invoiceId: ID!, reason: String!, "Default: everything not yet credited." lines: [CreditNoteLineInput!], date: DateTime }

  input PartnerTdsInput { section: String!, rateBp: Int! }
  input PartnerInput { code: String!, name: String!, kind: PartnerKind!, branchId: ID!, legalName: String, pan: String, gstin: String, stateCode: String, phone: String, email: String, address: AddressInput, tds: PartnerTdsInput }
  input PartnerPatch { name: String, kind: PartnerKind, legalName: String, pan: String, gstin: String, stateCode: String, phone: String, email: String, address: AddressInput, "null = default TDS." tds: PartnerTdsInput, active: Boolean }
  input ShareRateInput { code: String!, sharePaise: Int! }
  input AgreementInput { partnerId: ID!, kind: AgreementKind!, shareBp: Int, rates: [ShareRateInput!], defaultSharePaise: Int, categories: [ItemCategory!], effectiveFrom: Day!, effectiveTo: Day, notes: String }
  input SettlementDeductionInput { label: String!, amountPaise: Int!, ledgerId: ID }

  input CashDenominationInput { valuePaise: Int!, count: Int! }
  input CloseCashDayInput { branchId: ID!, day: Day!, countedPaise: Int!, denominations: [CashDenominationInput!], notes: String }
  input BankImportInput { branchId: ID!, ledgerId: ID!, "The bank's CSV export, as text." csv: String!, fileName: String }
  enum BankLineManualStatus { ignored unmatched }

  input LockDateInput { "Omit for the whole organisation." branchId: ID, "Last locked IST day; null removes the lock." upTo: Day, reason: String }

    "Closing vouchers on 31 March and a lock. fy: 2026-27."

  }
```

## File: src/schema/lab.graphql.ts

```ts
/** Patients, doctors, bookings, samples and reports (db-kit workflows). */
export const labTypeDefs = /* GraphQL */ `
  enum BookingStatus { booked sample_collected in_process completed cancelled }
  enum CollectionType { walk_in home }
  enum SampleStatus { pending collected received rejected }
  enum ReportStatus { draft entered verified released amended }
  enum ResultFlag { L H A NONE }

  type Patient {
    id: ID!
    uhid: String!
    title: String
    name: String!
    sex: Sex!
    dob: DateTime
    ageYears: Int
    phone: String
    email: String
    address: Address
    branch: Branch
    createdAt: DateTime!
    bookings(limit: Int = 20): [Booking!]!
    invoices(limit: Int = 20): [Invoice!]!
  }

  type Doctor { id: ID!, name: String!, qualification: String, phone: String, clinic: String, active: Boolean! }

  type BookingTest { testCode: String!, name: String!, pricePaise: Int!, sampleType: String, "The catalog entry, when the code is in catalog-kit." catalog: CatalogTest }
  type SampleCollection { type: CollectionType!, scheduledAt: DateTime, address: Address }

  type Booking {
    id: ID!
    bookingNo: String!
    status: BookingStatus!
    patient: Patient!
    doctor: Doctor
    branch: Branch!
    tests: [BookingTest!]!
    sampleCollection: SampleCollection!
    samples: [Sample!]!
    reports: [Report!]!
    invoice: Invoice
    notes: String
    createdAt: DateTime!
  }

  type Sample {
    id: ID!
    barcode: String!
    sampleType: String!
    status: SampleStatus!
    collectedAt: DateTime
    receivedAt: DateTime
    rejectReason: String
    booking: Booking!
  }

  type ResultValue { parameter: String!, value: String!, unit: String, flag: ResultFlag, range: String }

  type Report {
    id: ID!
    testCode: String!
    testName: String!
    status: ReportStatus!
    results: [ResultValue!]!
    version: Int!
    verifiedAt: DateTime
    releasedAt: DateTime
    patient: Patient!
    booking: Booking!
    updatedAt: DateTime!
  }

  type CreateBookingResult { booking: Booking!, samples: [Sample!]! }

  extend type Query {
    patient(id: ID!): Patient
    "Name, phone or UHID."
    patients(search: String!, limit: Int = 20): [Patient!]!
    doctors(activeOnly: Boolean = true): [Doctor!]!
    booking(id: ID!): Booking
    bookings(branchId: ID, status: BookingStatus, patientId: ID, limit: Int = 50, offset: Int = 0): [Booking!]!
    sample(id: ID!): Sample
    sampleByBarcode(barcode: String!): Sample
    report(id: ID!): Report
  }

  input RegisterPatientInput { branchId: ID!, title: String, name: String!, sex: Sex!, dob: DateTime, ageYears: Int, phone: String, email: String, address: AddressInput }
  input UpdatePatientInput { title: String, name: String, sex: Sex, dob: DateTime, ageYears: Int, phone: String, email: String, address: AddressInput }
  input DoctorInput { name: String!, qualification: String, phone: String, clinic: String, active: Boolean = true }
  input DoctorPatch { name: String, qualification: String, phone: String, clinic: String, active: Boolean }

  "A test by catalog code: name, price and sample type come from catalog-kit unless given."
  input BookingTestInput { testCode: String!, name: String, pricePaise: Int, sampleType: String }

  input CreateBookingInput {
    branchId: ID!
    patientId: ID!
    doctorId: ID
    tests: [BookingTestInput!]!
    collectionType: CollectionType = walk_in
    scheduledAt: DateTime
    notes: String
  }

  "Unit, range and flag are filled from catalog-kit when omitted and the test is in the catalog."
  input ResultInput { parameter: String!, value: String!, unit: String, flag: ResultFlag, range: String }

  extend type Mutation {
    registerPatient(input: RegisterPatientInput!): Patient!
    updatePatient(id: ID!, input: UpdatePatientInput!): Patient!
    createDoctor(input: DoctorInput!): Doctor!
    updateDoctor(id: ID!, input: DoctorPatch!): Doctor!

    createBooking(input: CreateBookingInput!): CreateBookingResult!
    cancelBooking(id: ID!): Booking!
    collectSample(id: ID!): Sample!
    receiveSample(id: ID!): Sample!
    rejectSample(id: ID!, reason: String!): Sample!

    createReport(bookingId: ID!, testCode: String!, testName: String): Report!
    saveResults(reportId: ID!, results: [ResultInput!]!): Report!
    verifyReport(id: ID!): Report!
    releaseReport(id: ID!): Report!
    amendReport(id: ID!): Report!
  }
`;
```

```ts
export const organizationTypeDefs = /* GraphQL */ `

    gstin: String
    phone: String
    email: String
```

## File: src/server.ts

```ts
import Fastify, { type FastifyInstance, type FastifyReply, type FastifyRequest } from "fastify";
import { NoSchemaIntrospectionCustomRule } from "graphql";
import { createYoga, type Plugin } from "graphql-yoga";
import { API_CSP, fastifySecurity, type RequestSecurity } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/security-kit/server";
import type { Container } from "./container";
import { createContext, type RequestContext } from "./graphql/context";
import { depthLimit } from "./graphql/limits";
import { buildSchema } from "./graphql/schema";

type ServerContext = { req: FastifyRequest; reply: FastifyReply };

/** What fastifySecurity put on the request (falls back to the socket address). */
const securityOf = (req: FastifyRequest): Pick<RequestSecurity, "ip"> => (req as FastifyRequest & { security?: RequestSecurity | null }).security ?? { ip: req.ip };

/** Validation rules on every operation: depth limit, and no introspection unless enabled. */
function rules(introspection: boolean): Plugin {
  return {
    onValidate({ addValidationRule }) {
      addValidationRule(depthLimit(12));
      if (!introspection) addValidationRule(NoSchemaIntrospectionCustomRule);
    },
  };
}

/**
 * The HTTP server: ONE GraphQL endpoint (Yoga on Fastify) for everything, plus GET /health for load
 * balancers. No other routes: PDFs and CSVs travel inside GraphQL responses.
 */
export async function buildServer(container: Container): Promise<FastifyInstance> {
  const { config } = container;
  const app = Fastify({ logger: config.env === "production" ? { level: "info" } : config.env === "test" ? false : { level: "warn" }, bodyLimit: config.bodyLimit, trustProxy: (_addr: string, hop: number) => hop < config.trustedHops });

  // security-kit: security headers on every response, and request.security = { ip, userAgent, … } with the
  // client IP taken from X-Forwarded-For only through the configured number of proxies (TRUST_PROXY).
  // CORS stays with Yoga below. GraphiQL (development) loads scripts, so it gets no CSP.
  await app.register(
    fastifySecurity({
      headers: { hsts: config.env === "production" ? 31_536_000 : false, csp: config.graphiql ? false : API_CSP },
      trustedHops: config.trustedHops,
    }),
  );

  const yoga = createYoga<ServerContext, RequestContext>({
    schema: buildSchema(),
    graphqlEndpoint: config.graphqlPath,
    graphiql: config.graphiql ? { title: "MGPL Diagnostics API" } : false,
    landingPage: false,
    // domain errors carry their own codes (src/graphql/errors.ts); everything else becomes "Unexpected error"
    maskedErrors: true,
    cors: { origin: config.corsOrigins.includes("*") ? "*" : config.corsOrigins, methods: ["GET", "POST", "OPTIONS"], allowedHeaders: ["content-type", "authorization"] },
    logging: config.env === "test" ? false : "warn",
    plugins: [rules(config.introspection)],
    context: ({ request, req }) => createContext(container, { headers: request.headers, ip: securityOf(req).ip ?? undefined }),
  });

  app.route({
    url: config.graphqlPath,
    method: ["GET", "POST", "OPTIONS"],
    handler: async (req, reply) => {
      const response = await yoga.handleNodeRequestAndResponse(req, reply, { req, reply });
      response.headers.forEach((value, key) => void reply.header(key, value));
      reply.status(response.status);
      reply.send(response.body);
      return reply;
    },
  });

  app.get("/health", async (_req, reply) => {
    try {
      await container.db.rawRepos.orgs.count();
      return { ok: true };
    } catch {
      return reply.status(503).send({ ok: false });
    }
  });

  app.addHook("onClose", async () => container.close());
  return app;
}
```
