## File: src/services/auth.service.ts

```ts
import { PERMISSIONS, SYSTEM_ROLES, type Auth, type DeviceSignals, type PublicUser } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/auth-kit";
import { ConflictError, createUser, NotFoundError, ValidationError, type Id, type Repositories, type Role, type RoleAssignment, type User } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import type { Actor } from "../graphql/context";
import type { JobQueue } from "../jobs/types";
import { mustOwn } from "./util";

/** Sends password-reset links. Plug in email/SMS in the container; the API never returns reset tokens. */
export interface Mailer {
  passwordReset(to: { email: string; name: string }, link: string, expiresAt: Date): Promise<void>;
}

const publicUser = ({ passwordHash: _p, ...u }: User): Omit<User, "passwordHash"> => u;

/** Sign-in, sessions and passwords (auth-kit), plus users and roles (db-kit storage). */
export class AuthService {
  constructor(
    private readonly repos: Repositories,
    private readonly auth: Auth,
    private readonly opts: { mailer?: Mailer; resetUrl: string | null; jobs: () => JobQueue },
  ) {}

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- sessions

  login(input: { email: string; password: string; orgCode?: string | null; ip?: string; userAgent?: string; device?: DeviceSignals }) {
    return this.auth.login({ ...input, orgCode: input.orgCode ?? undefined });
  }

  /** Spends a refresh token: a new access token and the next refresh token (rotation). */
  async refresh(input: { refreshToken: string; ip?: string; userAgent?: string; device?: DeviceSignals }) {
    const p = await this.auth.refresh(input);
    return { token: p.accessToken, expiresAt: p.accessExpiresAt, ...p };
  }

  /** Ends the session of an access token (even expired), or of a refresh token. */
  logout(token: string) {
    return this.auth.logout(token);
  }

  /** Ends every other session of the user (keeps the current one). */
  logoutOthers(actor: Actor, currentToken: string) {
    return this.auth.logoutAll(actor.userId, currentToken);
  }

  sessions(actor: Actor) {
    return this.auth.sessionsOf(actor.userId);
  }

  revokeSession(actor: Actor, sessionId: string) {
    return this.auth.revokeSession(actor.userId, sessionId);
  }

  changePassword(actor: Actor, currentPassword: string, newPassword: string, currentToken?: string) {
    return this.auth.changePassword({ userId: actor.userId, currentPassword, newPassword, currentToken });
  }

  /**
   * Always resolves (never reveals whether the email exists). Queued: the worker (or, without Redis,
   * this process) runs `sendPasswordReset`, so the answer takes the same time for every email.
   */
  requestPasswordReset(input: { email: string; orgCode?: string | null; ip?: string }): Promise<void> {
    return this.opts.jobs().passwordReset({ email: input.email, orgCode: input.orgCode ?? null, ip: input.ip });
  }

  /** The job: creates the single-use token (auth-kit) and mails the link. True when an email went out. */
  async sendPasswordReset(input: { email: string; orgCode?: string | null; ip?: string }): Promise<boolean> {
    const r = await this.auth.requestPasswordReset({ email: input.email, orgCode: input.orgCode ?? undefined, ip: input.ip });
    if (!r) return false;
    if (!this.opts.mailer) {
      console.warn("[auth] no Mailer configured: a password-reset link was not sent");
      return false;
    }
    const base = this.opts.resetUrl ?? "/reset-password";
    await this.opts.mailer.passwordReset({ email: r.user.email, name: r.user.name }, `${base}?token=${encodeURIComponent(r.token)}`, r.expiresAt);
    return true;
  }

  resetPassword(token: string, newPassword: string): Promise<PublicUser> {
    return this.auth.resetPassword({ token, newPassword });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- users

  async me(actor: Actor) {
    const u = await this.repos.users.get(actor.userId);
    if (!u) throw new NotFoundError("User", actor.userId);
    return publicUser(u);
  }

  async users(actor: Actor) {
    return (await this.repos.users.find({ orgId: actor.orgId }, { sort: { field: "name" } })).map(publicUser);
  }

  async user(actor: Actor, id: Id) {
    const u = await this.repos.users.get(id);
    return u && u.orgId === actor.orgId ? publicUser(u) : null;
  }

  async createUser(actor: Actor, input: { name: string; email: string; phone?: string | null; password: string; roles: RoleAssignment[] }) {
    await this.assertRoles(actor, input.roles);
    const passwordHash = await this.auth.hashNewPassword(input.password, { email: input.email, name: input.name });
    const u = await createUser(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, name: input.name, email: input.email, phone: input.phone ?? undefined, roles: input.roles, passwordHash }, actor.userId);
    return publicUser(u);
  }

  async setUserRoles(actor: Actor, userId: Id, roles: RoleAssignment[]) {
    mustOwn(await this.repos.users.get(userId), actor.orgId, "User", userId);
    await this.assertRoles(actor, roles);
    const u = await this.repos.users.update(userId, { roles });
    await this.repos.audit.log({ orgId: actor.orgId, userId: actor.userId, action: "user.roles", entity: "user", entityId: userId });
    return publicUser(u!);
  }

  /** Disabling ends every session at once (auth-kit re-reads the user on each request). */
  async setUserStatus(actor: Actor, userId: Id, status: "active" | "disabled") {
    mustOwn(await this.repos.users.get(userId), actor.orgId, "User", userId);
    if (userId === actor.userId && status === "disabled") throw new ConflictError("You cannot disable your own account");
    const u = await this.repos.users.update(userId, { status });
    if (status === "disabled") await this.auth.logoutAll(userId);
    await this.repos.audit.log({ orgId: actor.orgId, userId: actor.userId, action: `user.${status === "disabled" ? "disable" : "enable"}`, entity: "user", entityId: userId });
    return publicUser(u!);
  }

  async setUserPassword(actor: Actor, userId: Id, newPassword: string) {
    mustOwn(await this.repos.users.get(userId), actor.orgId, "User", userId);
    await this.auth.setPassword(userId, newPassword, actor.userId);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- roles

  roles(actor: Actor): Promise<Role[]> {
    return this.repos.roles.find({ orgId: actor.orgId }, { sort: { field: "key" } });
  }

  permissions(): readonly string[] {
    return PERMISSIONS;
  }

  /** Creates or replaces a custom role. System roles (seeded from auth-kit) cannot be changed. */
  async upsertRole(actor: Actor, input: { key: string; name: string; permissions: string[] }) {
    const key = input.key.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,40}$/.test(key)) throw new ValidationError("Role key: lower-case letters, digits and _");
    for (const p of input.permissions) {
      if (!/^([a-z_]+|\*):([a-z_]+|\*)$/.test(p)) throw new ValidationError(`Invalid permission "${p}"`);
    }
    const existing = await this.repos.roles.findOne({ orgId: actor.orgId, key });
    if (existing?.system) throw new ConflictError(`Role ${key} is a system role`);
    const role = existing
      ? await this.repos.roles.update(existing.id, { name: input.name, permissions: input.permissions })
      : await this.repos.roles.create({ orgId: actor.orgId, key, name: input.name, permissions: input.permissions, system: false });
    this.auth.invalidateRoles(actor.orgId);
    await this.repos.audit.log({ orgId: actor.orgId, userId: actor.userId, action: "role.upsert", entity: "role", entityId: role!.id });
    return role!;
  }

  /** Seeds auth-kit's SYSTEM_ROLES for an organisation that lacks some (idempotent). */
  async ensureSystemRoles(orgId: Id) {
    for (const r of SYSTEM_ROLES) {
      const existing = await this.repos.roles.findOne({ orgId, key: r.key });
      if (existing) await this.repos.roles.update(existing.id, { name: r.name, permissions: r.permissions, system: true });
      else await this.repos.roles.create({ orgId, key: r.key, name: r.name, permissions: r.permissions, system: true });
    }
    this.auth.invalidateRoles(orgId);
  }

  private async assertRoles(actor: Actor, roles: RoleAssignment[]) {
    if (!roles.length) throw new ValidationError("Give the user at least one role");
    const keys = new Set((await this.roles(actor)).map((r) => r.key));
    for (const r of roles) {
      if (!keys.has(r.role)) throw new ValidationError(`Unknown role "${r.role}"`);
      if (r.branchId) mustOwn(await this.repos.branches.get(r.branchId), actor.orgId, "Branch", r.branchId);
    }
  }
}
```

## File: src/services/billing.service.ts

```ts
import { getTestByCode } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/catalog-kit";
import {
  cancelInvoice, issueInvoice, recordPayment, ValidationError,
  type Id, type Invoice, type InvoiceStatus, type ItemCategory, type ItemInput, type PaymentMode, type Repositories, type Taxability,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { applyTaxRules } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit";
import type { Actor } from "../graphql/context";
import { clean, mustOwn, scopedFind } from "./util";

export interface InvoiceItemInput {
  code?: string | null;
  name?: string | null;
  category?: ItemCategory | null;
  qty?: number | null;
  ratePaise?: number | null;
  discountPaise?: number | null;
  taxPercent?: number | null;
  hsnSac?: string | null;
  taxability?: Taxability | null;
}

export interface PaymentInput {
  amountPaise: number;
  mode: PaymentMode;
  reference?: string | null;
}

export interface IssueInvoiceInput {
  branchId: Id;
  patientId: Id;
  bookingId?: Id | null;
  items: InvoiceItemInput[];
  billDiscountPaise?: number | null;
  payments?: PaymentInput[] | null;
  /** Fill GST (HSN/SAC, taxability, rate) from finance-kit's tax rules. */
  applyTaxRules?: boolean | null;
}

/** An invoice line; a catalog-kit test code alone is enough (name and MRP from the catalog). */
export function invoiceItem(i: InvoiceItemInput): ItemInput {
  const cat = i.code && (i.name == null || i.ratePaise == null) ? getTestByCode(i.code) : undefined;
  const name = i.name ?? cat?.name;
  const ratePaise = i.ratePaise ?? (cat?.mrp != null ? cat.mrp * 100 : undefined);
  if (!name || ratePaise == null) throw new ValidationError(`Item ${i.code ?? "(no code)"} is not in the catalog; send its name and ratePaise`);
  return clean({
    code: i.code, name, category: i.category ?? "test", qty: i.qty ?? 1, ratePaise, discountPaise: i.discountPaise ?? 0,
    taxPercent: i.taxPercent ?? 0, hsnSac: i.hsnSac, taxability: i.taxability,
  }) as ItemInput;
}

const paymentOf = (p: PaymentInput) => clean({ amountPaise: p.amountPaise, mode: p.mode, reference: p.reference }) as { amountPaise: number; mode: PaymentMode; reference?: string };

/** Patient invoices and payments (db-kit workflows; posting to the books happens inside them). */
export class BillingService {
  constructor(private readonly repos: Repositories) {}

  async get(actor: Actor, id: Id) {
    return mustOwn(await this.repos.invoices.get(id), actor.orgId, "Invoice", id);
  }

  list(actor: Actor, q: { scope: "all" | Id[]; status?: InvoiceStatus | null; patientId?: Id | null; customerId?: Id | null; limit: number; offset: number }) {
    return scopedFind(this.repos.invoices, clean({ orgId: actor.orgId, status: q.status, patientId: q.patientId, customerId: q.customerId }), q.scope, q.limit, q.offset, "createdAt");
  }

  payments(invoiceId: Id) {
    return this.repos.payments.find({ invoiceId }, { sort: { field: "receivedAt" } });
  }

  vouchers(invoiceId: Id) {
    return this.repos.vouchers.find({ invoiceId } as never, { sort: { field: "date" } });
  }

  creditNotes(invoiceId: Id) {
    return this.repos.creditNotes.find({ invoiceId } as never, { sort: { field: "date" } });
  }

  async issue(actor: Actor, input: IssueInvoiceInput) {
    mustOwn(await this.repos.branches.get(input.branchId), actor.orgId, "Branch", input.branchId);
    mustOwn(await this.repos.patients.get(input.patientId), actor.orgId, "Patient", input.patientId);
    if (input.bookingId) mustOwn(await this.repos.bookings.get(input.bookingId), actor.orgId, "Booking", input.bookingId);
    let items = input.items.map(invoiceItem);
    if (input.applyTaxRules) items = await applyTaxRules(this.repos, actor.orgId, items);
    const { invoice } = await issueInvoice(this.repos, {
      orgId: actor.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, patientId: input.patientId, bookingId: input.bookingId ?? null,
      items, billDiscountPaise: input.billDiscountPaise ?? 0, payments: input.payments?.map(paymentOf),
    }, actor.userId);
    return invoice;
  }

  async pay(actor: Actor, invoice: Invoice, payment: PaymentInput, kind: "payment" | "refund") {
    return (await recordPayment(this.repos, { invoiceId: invoice.id, ...paymentOf(payment), kind }, actor.userId)).invoice;
  }

  cancel(actor: Actor, invoice: Invoice, reason: string) {
    if (!reason.trim()) throw new ValidationError("Give a reason");
    return cancelInvoice(this.repos, invoice.id, reason.trim(), actor.userId);
  }

  /** Is any discount on this request? (Discounts need the invoice:discount permission.) */
  static discounted(input: Pick<IssueInvoiceInput, "billDiscountPaise" | "items">) {
    return (input.billDiscountPaise ?? 0) > 0 || input.items.some((i) => (i.discountPaise ?? 0) > 0);
  }
}
```

## File: src/services/booking.service.ts

```ts
import { getTestByCode } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/catalog-kit";
import { ConflictError, createBooking, ValidationError, type BookingStatus, type BookingTest, type CollectionType, type Id, type Repositories, type Sample } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import type { Actor } from "../graphql/context";
import { clean, mustOwn, owned, scopedFind } from "./util";

export interface BookingTestInput {
  testCode: string;
  name?: string | null;
  pricePaise?: number | null;
  sampleType?: string | null;
}

export interface CreateBookingInput {
  branchId: Id;
  patientId: Id;
  doctorId?: Id | null;
  tests: BookingTestInput[];
  collectionType?: CollectionType | null;
  scheduledAt?: Date | null;
  notes?: string | null;
}

/**
 * A test line from catalog-kit when only the code is given: name, price (MRP, rupees → paise) and
 * sample type come from the catalog; anything sent explicitly wins.
 */
export function bookingTest(t: BookingTestInput): BookingTest {
  const cat = getTestByCode(t.testCode);
  const name = t.name ?? cat?.name;
  const pricePaise = t.pricePaise ?? (cat?.mrp != null ? cat.mrp * 100 : undefined);
  if (!name || pricePaise == null) throw new ValidationError(`Test ${t.testCode} is not in the catalog; send its name and pricePaise`);
  if (!Number.isInteger(pricePaise) || pricePaise < 0) throw new ValidationError(`Test ${t.testCode}: pricePaise must be a whole number >= 0`);
  return clean({ testCode: t.testCode, name, pricePaise, sampleType: t.sampleType ?? cat?.sampleType ?? undefined }) as BookingTest;
}

/** Bookings and their samples (barcodes). */
export class BookingService {
  constructor(private readonly repos: Repositories) {}

  async get(actor: Actor, id: Id) {
    return mustOwn(await this.repos.bookings.get(id), actor.orgId, "Booking", id);
  }

  list(actor: Actor, q: { scope: "all" | Id[]; status?: BookingStatus | null; patientId?: Id | null; limit: number; offset: number }) {
    return scopedFind(this.repos.bookings, clean({ orgId: actor.orgId, status: q.status, patientId: q.patientId }), q.scope, q.limit, q.offset, "createdAt");
  }

  async create(actor: Actor, input: CreateBookingInput) {
    mustOwn(await this.repos.branches.get(input.branchId), actor.orgId, "Branch", input.branchId);
    mustOwn(await this.repos.patients.get(input.patientId), actor.orgId, "Patient", input.patientId);
    if (input.doctorId) mustOwn(await this.repos.doctors.get(input.doctorId), actor.orgId, "Doctor", input.doctorId);
    return createBooking(this.repos, {
      orgId: actor.orgId,
      branchId: input.branchId,
      patientId: input.patientId,
      doctorId: input.doctorId ?? null,
      tests: input.tests.map(bookingTest),
      sampleCollection: { type: input.collectionType ?? "walk_in", scheduledAt: input.scheduledAt ?? null },
      notes: input.notes ?? undefined,
    }, actor.userId);
  }

  async cancel(actor: Actor, id: Id) {
    const b = await this.get(actor, id);
    if (b.status === "cancelled") return b;
    if (b.invoiceId) {
      const inv = await this.repos.invoices.get(b.invoiceId);
      if (inv && inv.status !== "cancelled") throw new ConflictError("Cancel the booking's invoice first");
    }
    const out = await this.repos.bookings.update(id, { status: "cancelled" });
    await this.repos.audit.log({ orgId: b.orgId, branchId: b.branchId, userId: actor.userId, action: "booking.cancel", entity: "booking", entityId: id });
    return out!;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- samples

  samplesOf(bookingId: Id) {
    return this.repos.samples.find({ bookingId }, { sort: { field: "barcode" } });
  }

  async sample(actor: Actor, id: Id) {
    return mustOwn(await this.repos.samples.get(id), actor.orgId, "Sample", id);
  }

  async sampleByBarcode(actor: Actor, barcode: string) {
    return owned(await this.repos.samples.findOne({ orgId: actor.orgId, barcode: barcode.trim() }), actor.orgId);
  }

  async collectSample(actor: Actor, s: Sample) {
    if (s.status !== "pending") throw new ConflictError(`Sample is ${s.status}`);
    const out = await this.repos.samples.update(s.id, { status: "collected", collectedAt: new Date(), collectedBy: actor.userId });
    const b = await this.repos.bookings.get(s.bookingId);
    if (b?.status === "booked") await this.repos.bookings.update(b.id, { status: "sample_collected" });
    await this.repos.audit.log({ orgId: s.orgId, branchId: s.branchId, userId: actor.userId, action: "sample.collect", entity: "sample", entityId: s.id });
    return out!;
  }

  async receiveSample(actor: Actor, s: Sample) {
    if (s.status !== "collected") throw new ConflictError(`Sample is ${s.status}`);
    const out = await this.repos.samples.update(s.id, { status: "received", receivedAt: new Date() });
    await this.repos.bookings.update(s.bookingId, { status: "in_process" });
    await this.repos.audit.log({ orgId: s.orgId, branchId: s.branchId, userId: actor.userId, action: "sample.receive", entity: "sample", entityId: s.id });
    return out!;
  }

  async rejectSample(actor: Actor, s: Sample, reason: string) {
    if (s.status === "rejected") throw new ConflictError("Sample is already rejected");
    if (!reason.trim()) throw new ValidationError("Give a reason");
    const out = await this.repos.samples.update(s.id, { status: "rejected", rejectReason: reason.trim() });
    await this.repos.audit.log({ orgId: s.orgId, branchId: s.branchId, userId: actor.userId, action: "sample.reject", entity: "sample", entityId: s.id });
    return out!;
  }
}
```

## File: src/services/books.service.ts

```ts
import { NotFoundError, type Id, type Repositories, type VoucherEntry, type VoucherType } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { seedFinanceLedgers } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit";
import {
  balanceSheet, cancelVoucher, cashBook, dayBook, gstSummary, ledgerBalance, ledgerStatement, outstandingReceivables, postVoucher, profitAndLoss, trialBalance,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/tally-kit";
import type { Actor } from "../graphql/context";
import { mustOwn } from "./util";

export interface PostVoucherInput {
  branchId: Id;
  type: VoucherType;
  date?: Date | null;
  narration?: string | null;
  entries: { ledgerId: Id; debitPaise?: number | null; creditPaise?: number | null; invoiceId?: Id | null }[];
}

/**
 * The books, through tally-kit (our accounting engine): chart of accounts, ledgers, manual vouchers
 * and the books reports. Automatic posting of invoices and payments happens inside db-kit's workflows
 * through finance-kit's posting hook (set in the container).
 */
export class BooksService {
  constructor(private readonly repos: Repositories) {}

  groups(actor: Actor) {
    return this.repos.accountGroups.find({ orgId: actor.orgId }, { sort: { field: "name" } });
  }

  ledgers(actor: Actor) {
    return this.repos.ledgers.find({ orgId: actor.orgId }, { sort: { field: "name" } });
  }

  async ledger(actor: Actor, id: Id) {
    return mustOwn(await this.repos.ledgers.get(id), actor.orgId, "Ledger", id);
  }

  /** The standard chart (28 groups, default ledgers) plus finance-kit's ledgers. Idempotent. */
  setupChartOfAccounts(actor: Actor) {
    return seedFinanceLedgers(this.repos, actor.orgId);
  }

  async createLedger(actor: Actor, input: { name: string; groupId: Id; openingPaise?: number | null; gstin?: string | null }) {
    mustOwn(await this.repos.accountGroups.get(input.groupId), actor.orgId, "Account group", input.groupId);
    const l = await this.repos.ledgers.create({ orgId: actor.orgId, name: input.name.trim(), groupId: input.groupId, openingPaise: input.openingPaise ?? 0, gstin: input.gstin ?? undefined, systemKey: null, active: true } as never);
    await this.repos.audit.log({ orgId: actor.orgId, userId: actor.userId, action: "ledger.create", entity: "ledger", entityId: l.id });
    return l;
  }

  async postVoucher(actor: Actor, input: PostVoucherInput) {
    mustOwn(await this.repos.branches.get(input.branchId), actor.orgId, "Branch", input.branchId);
    await this.assertOwnLedgers(actor, input.entries.map((e) => e.ledgerId)); // no posting into another organisation's books
    for (const e of input.entries) if (e.invoiceId) mustOwn(await this.repos.invoices.get(e.invoiceId), actor.orgId, "Invoice", e.invoiceId);
    const entries: VoucherEntry[] = input.entries.map((e) => ({ ledgerId: e.ledgerId, debitPaise: e.debitPaise ?? 0, creditPaise: e.creditPaise ?? 0, invoiceId: e.invoiceId ?? null }));
    return postVoucher(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, type: input.type, date: input.date ?? undefined, narration: input.narration ?? undefined, entries }, actor.userId);
  }

  async voucher(actor: Actor, id: Id) {
    return mustOwn(await this.repos.vouchers.get(id), actor.orgId, "Voucher", id);
  }

  cancelVoucher(actor: Actor, id: Id) {
    return cancelVoucher(this.repos, id, actor.userId);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- reports (tally-kit)

  balance(orgId: Id, ledgerId: Id, q: { asOf?: Date | null; branchId?: Id | null }) {
    return ledgerBalance(this.repos, { orgId, ledgerId, asOf: q.asOf ?? undefined, branchId: q.branchId ?? undefined });
  }

  async ledgerStatement(actor: Actor, q: { ledgerId: Id; from: Date; to: Date; branchId?: Id | null }) {
    await this.assertOwnLedgers(actor, [q.ledgerId]);
    return ledgerStatement(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, ledgerId: q.ledgerId, from: q.from, to: q.to, branchId: q.branchId ?? undefined });
  }

  cashBook(actor: Actor, q: { from: Date; to: Date; branchId?: Id | null }) {
    return cashBook(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, from: q.from, to: q.to, branchId: q.branchId ?? undefined });
  }

  trialBalance(actor: Actor, q: { asOf?: Date | null; branchId?: Id | null }) {
    return trialBalance(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, asOf: q.asOf ?? undefined, branchId: q.branchId ?? undefined });
  }

  profitAndLoss(actor: Actor, q: { from: Date; to: Date; branchId?: Id | null }) {
    return profitAndLoss(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, from: q.from, to: q.to, branchId: q.branchId ?? undefined });
  }

  balanceSheet(actor: Actor, q: { asOf: Date; branchId?: Id | null }) {
    return balanceSheet(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, asOf: q.asOf, branchId: q.branchId ?? undefined });
  }

  dayBook(actor: Actor, q: { from: Date; to: Date; branchId?: Id | null; type?: VoucherType | null }) {
    return dayBook(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, from: q.from, to: q.to, branchId: q.branchId ?? undefined, type: q.type ?? undefined });
  }

  outstanding(actor: Actor, q: { asOf?: Date | null; branchId?: Id | null }) {
    return outstandingReceivables(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, asOf: q.asOf ?? undefined, branchId: q.branchId ?? undefined });
  }

  gstSummary(actor: Actor, q: { from: Date; to: Date; branchId?: Id | null }) {
    return gstSummary(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, from: q.from, to: q.to, branchId: q.branchId ?? undefined });
  }

  private async assertOwnLedgers(actor: Actor, ids: Id[]) {
    const unique = [...new Set(ids)];
    const found = await this.repos.ledgers.getMany(unique);
    const bad = unique.find((id) => !found.some((l) => l.id === id && l.orgId === actor.orgId));
    if (bad) throw new NotFoundError("Ledger", bad);
  }
}
```

```ts
import type { BankLineStatus, CashDenomination, Id, Repositories } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { bankReconciliation, closeCashDay, importBankStatement, matchBankLine, reconcileBank, setBankLineStatus } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit";
import type { Actor } from "../graphql/context";
import { clean, mustOwn } from "./util";

/** Day-end cash closing and bank reconciliation, through finance-kit. */
export class CashBankService {
  constructor(private readonly repos: Repositories) {}

  closeCashDay(actor: Actor, input: { branchId: Id; day: string; countedPaise: number; denominations?: CashDenomination[] | null; notes?: string | null }) {
    return closeCashDay(this.repos, { ...(clean(input) as typeof input), orgId: actor.orgId } as never, actor.userId);
  }

  cashClosings(actor: Actor, q: { branchId: Id; limit: number; offset: number }) {
    return this.repos.cashClosings.find({ orgId: actor.orgId, branchId: q.branchId }, { limit: q.limit, offset: q.offset, sort: { field: "day", dir: "desc" } });
  }

  importBankStatement(actor: Actor, input: { branchId: Id; ledgerId: Id; csv: string; fileName?: string | null }) {
    return importBankStatement(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, ledgerId: input.ledgerId, csv: input.csv, fileName: input.fileName ?? undefined }, actor.userId);
  }

  async bankStatement(actor: Actor, id: Id) {
    return mustOwn(await this.repos.bankStatements.get(id), actor.orgId, "Bank statement", id);
  }

  bankStatements(actor: Actor, q: { ledgerId?: Id | null; limit: number; offset: number }) {
    return this.repos.bankStatements.find(clean({ orgId: actor.orgId, ledgerId: q.ledgerId }) as never, { limit: q.limit, offset: q.offset, sort: { field: "createdAt", dir: "desc" } });
  }

  bankLines(actor: Actor, q: { ledgerId?: Id | null; statementId?: Id | null; status?: BankLineStatus | null; limit: number; offset: number }) {
    return this.repos.bankLines.find(clean({ orgId: actor.orgId, ledgerId: q.ledgerId, statementId: q.statementId, status: q.status }) as never, { limit: q.limit, offset: q.offset, sort: { field: "date", dir: "desc" } });
  }

  async bankLine(actor: Actor, id: Id) {
    return mustOwn(await this.repos.bankLines.get(id), actor.orgId, "Bank line", id);
  }

  reconcile(actor: Actor, q: { ledgerId: Id; statementId?: Id | null }) {
    return reconcileBank(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, ledgerId: q.ledgerId, statementId: q.statementId ?? undefined }, actor.userId);
  }

  matchLine(actor: Actor, q: { lineId: Id; voucherIds: Id[] }) {
    return matchBankLine(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, ...q }, actor.userId);
  }

  setLineStatus(actor: Actor, q: { lineId: Id; status: "ignored" | "unmatched" }) {
    return setBankLineStatus(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, ...q }, actor.userId);
  }

  reconciliation(actor: Actor, q: { ledgerId: Id; asOf: Date }) {
    return bankReconciliation(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, ...q });
  }
}
```

## File: src/services/catalog.service.ts

```ts
import * as catalog from "@mgpl-diagnostics/catalog-kit";
import type { LabTest, Parameter } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/catalog-kit";

/** catalog-kit: the lab's tests, parameters, ranges, sample types and prices. Pure data, no tenant. */
export class CatalogService {
  search(query: string, opts: { limit: number; department?: string | null; sampleType?: string | null; fuzzy?: boolean | null }) {
    return catalog.search(query, { limit: opts.limit, department: opts.department ?? undefined, sampleType: opts.sampleType ?? undefined, fuzzy: opts.fuzzy ?? undefined });
  }

  /** By numeric id or by code (case-insensitive). */
  test(key: { id?: number | null; code?: string | null }): LabTest | null {
    if (key.id != null) return catalog.getTest(key.id) ?? null;
    if (key.code) return catalog.getTestByCode(key.code) ?? null;
    return null;
  }

  tests(q: { department?: string | null; sampleType?: string | null; limit: number; offset: number }): LabTest[] {
    let list: readonly LabTest[] = catalog.TESTS;
    if (q.department) list = catalog.testsByDepartment(q.department);
    if (q.sampleType) list = list.filter((t) => t.sampleType === q.sampleType || t.secondarySampleTypes?.includes(q.sampleType!));
    return list.slice(q.offset, q.offset + q.limit);
  }

  count(): number {
    return catalog.TESTS.length;
  }

  departments(): readonly string[] {
    return catalog.DEPARTMENTS;
  }

  sampleTypes(): readonly string[] {
    return catalog.SAMPLE_TYPES;
  }

  isProfile(t: LabTest): boolean {
    return catalog.isProfile(t);
  }

  formatRange(p: Parameter, sex?: catalog.Sex | null): string {
    return catalog.formatRange(p, sex ?? undefined);
  }

  /** "L", "H" or "" for a numeric result against the parameter's range. */
  flag(p: Parameter, value: number, sex?: catalog.Sex | null): string {
    return catalog.flagResult(p, value, sex ?? undefined);
  }

  /** Price quote for test ids or codes: total in rupees, the tests found and the keys not found. */
  quote(items: (string | number)[]) {
    return catalog.totalPrice(items);
  }
}
```

## File: src/services/document.service.ts

```ts
import { getTestByCode } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/catalog-kit";
import {
  ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationError,
  type Id, type Invoice as DbInvoice, type Patient as DbPatient, type PaymentMode, type Report as DbReport, type Repositories,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import {
  computeInvoice, INVOICE_SAMPLES, invoiceFromRequest, invoiceTotalsJson, PRICE_LIST, renderInvoiceHtml, renderInvoicePdf,
  type Invoice as PrintInvoice, type InvoiceItem as PrintItem, type InvoiceRequest,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit";
import {
  buildReport, COLS_STD, defaultLab, renderLetterheadHtml, renderLetterheadPdf, renderReportHtml, renderReportPdf, reportFromRequest, SAMPLES, templateCatalog, TEMPLATES,
  type LabProfile, type Patient as PrintPatient, type Report as PrintReport, type ReportDesign, type ReportRequest, type ReportVariant, type Section, type TestRow,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import type { Actor } from "../graphql/context";
import { mustOwn } from "./util";

export type DocumentFormat = "pdf" | "html";

/** A rendered document. PDFs travel as base64 in `base64`; HTML (self-contained, fonts inlined) in `html`. */
export interface RenderedDocument {
  format: DocumentFormat;
  fileName: string;
  mimeType: string;
  byteLength: number;
  base64: string | null;
  html: string | null;
}

export interface RenderOptions {
  format: DocumentFormat;
  variant: ReportVariant;
  design?: ReportDesign;
  fileName?: string | null;
}

const MODE_LABEL: Record<PaymentMode, string> = { cash: "Cash", upi: "UPI", card: "Card", netbanking: "Online", wallet: "Wallet", cheque: "Cheque", insurance: "Insurance" };
const rupees = (paise: number) => paise / 100;
const titleCase = (s: string) => s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);

function ageOf(p: DbPatient, at: Date): number | string {
  if (p.ageYears != null) return p.ageYears;
  if (!p.dob) return "";
  const dob = new Date(p.dob);
  let years = at.getUTCFullYear() - dob.getUTCFullYear();
  if (at.getUTCMonth() < dob.getUTCMonth() || (at.getUTCMonth() === dob.getUTCMonth() && at.getUTCDate() < dob.getUTCDate())) years--;
  return Math.max(0, years);
}

/** db-kit patient → the printed patient block. */
export function printPatient(p: DbPatient, at: Date, extra: Partial<PrintPatient> = {}): PrintPatient {
  return {
    title: p.title, name: p.name, age: ageOf(p, at), sex: titleCase(p.sex), patientId: p.uhid, phone: p.phone,
    address: [p.address?.line1, p.address?.city].filter(Boolean).join(", ") || undefined, ...extra,
  };
}

/**
 * report-kit (lab reports, letterhead) and invoice-kit (invoices) used as internal libraries: render
 * from a request (any data) or from what is stored in db-kit (an invoice, a booking's reports).
 */
export class DocumentService {
  private readonly lab: LabProfile;
  private readonly samples: boolean;

  constructor(private readonly repos: Repositories, opts: { lab?: LabProfile; samples: boolean }) {
    this.lab = opts.lab ?? defaultLab();
    this.samples = opts.samples;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- catalogs

  templates() {
    return templateCatalog();
  }

  priceList() {
    return Object.entries(PRICE_LIST).map(([code, e]) => ({ code, ...e }));
  }

  reportSamples() {
    return this.samples ? SAMPLES.map((s) => ({ id: s.id, label: s.label, group: s.group })) : [];
  }

  invoiceSamples() {
    return this.samples ? INVOICE_SAMPLES.map((s) => ({ id: s.id, label: s.label, invoiceNo: s.invoice.invoiceNo })) : [];
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- from a request

  renderReportRequest(request: ReportRequest, o: RenderOptions) {
    return this.renderReport(reportFromRequest(request, { samples: this.samples }), o);
  }

  renderInvoiceRequest(request: InvoiceRequest, o: RenderOptions) {
    return this.renderInvoice(invoiceFromRequest(request, { samples: this.samples }), o);
  }

  /** invoice-kit's calculation (integer paise inside, rupees out) without rendering. */
  invoiceTotals(request: InvoiceRequest) {
    return invoiceTotalsJson(invoiceFromRequest(request, { samples: this.samples }));
  }

  async letterhead(format: DocumentFormat): Promise<RenderedDocument> {
    if (format === "html") return htmlDoc("letterhead.html", await renderLetterheadHtml({ lab: this.lab, inline: true }));
    return pdfDoc("letterhead.pdf", await renderLetterheadPdf({ lab: this.lab }));
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- from stored data

  /** The printed form of a stored invoice (with its payments). */
  async storedInvoice(actor: Actor, invoice: DbInvoice): Promise<PrintInvoice> {
    const patient = mustOwn(await this.repos.patients.get(invoice.patientId), actor.orgId, "Patient", invoice.patientId);
    const payments = await this.repos.payments.find({ invoiceId: invoice.id }, { sort: { field: "receivedAt" } });
    const at = invoice.issuedAt ?? invoice.createdAt;
    const lineDiscounts = invoice.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.discountPaise, 0);
    const billDiscount = invoice.discountPaise - lineDiscounts;
    const refunded = payments.filter((p) => p.kind === "refund").reduce((s, p) => s + p.amountPaise, 0);
    const items: PrintItem[] = invoice.items.map((i) => ({
      code: i.code, name: i.name, category: i.category === "package" ? "profile" : i.category, qty: i.qty, rate: rupees(i.ratePaise),
      discountAmount: i.discountPaise ? rupees(i.discountPaise) : undefined, taxPercent: i.taxPercent || undefined, hsn: i.hsnSac,
    }));
    const notes = [invoice.status === "cancelled" ? `CANCELLED: ${invoice.cancelReason ?? ""}`.trim() : "", refunded ? `Refunded Rs. ${rupees(refunded).toFixed(2)}` : ""].filter(Boolean);
    return {
      invoiceNo: invoice.invoiceNo,
      date: at,
      patient: printPatient(patient, at),
      items,
      discount: billDiscount > 0 ? { amount: rupees(billDiscount) } : undefined,
      payments: payments.filter((p) => p.kind === "payment").map((p) => ({ mode: MODE_LABEL[p.mode], amount: rupees(p.amountPaise), date: p.receivedAt, reference: p.reference })),
      notes: notes.length ? notes : undefined,
      roundOff: true,
    };
  }

  async renderStoredInvoice(actor: Actor, invoice: DbInvoice, o: RenderOptions) {
    const printed = await this.storedInvoice(actor, invoice);
    // the printed total must equal the stored one (both are integer-paise maths with the same rules)
    const t = computeInvoice(printed);
    if (Math.round(t.total * 100) !== invoice.totalPaise) throw new ConflictError(`Invoice ${invoice.invoiceNo}: printed total ${t.total} differs from the stored total`);
    return this.renderInvoice(printed, { ...o, fileName: o.fileName ?? `${invoice.invoiceNo.replaceAll("/", "-")}.${o.format}` });
  }

  /**
   * A booking's reports as one printed report. Only verified or released reports print. A report
   * whose test code is a report-kit template uses that template (results keyed by its field keys);
   * any other test prints as a standard Test | Result | Unit | Range table.
   */
  async renderBookingReports(actor: Actor, bookingId: Id, reportIds: Id[] | null, o: RenderOptions) {
    const booking = mustOwn(await this.repos.bookings.get(bookingId), actor.orgId, "Booking", bookingId);
    let reports = await this.repos.reports.find({ bookingId });
    if (reportIds?.length) reports = reports.filter((r) => reportIds.includes(r.id));
    if (!reports.length) throw new NotFoundError("Report", reportIds?.join(",") ?? bookingId);
    const unready = reports.find((r) => r.status !== "verified" && r.status !== "released");
    if (unready) throw new ConflictError(`Report ${unready.testName} is ${unready.status}; verify it before printing`);
    const patient = mustOwn(await this.repos.patients.get(booking.patientId), actor.orgId, "Patient", booking.patientId);
    const doctor = booking.doctorId ? await this.repos.doctors.get(booking.doctorId) : null;
    const samples = await this.repos.samples.find({ bookingId });
    const collected = samples.map((s) => s.collectedAt).filter(Boolean).sort()[0] ?? booking.createdAt;
    const reportedAt = reports.map((r) => r.verifiedAt ?? r.updatedAt).filter(Boolean).sort().at(-1) ?? new Date();
    const printed = printPatient(patient, reportedAt, {
      refDoctor: doctor?.name ?? "Self", sampleId: booking.bookingNo, sampleCollectionDate: collected, collectedAt: collected, registeredAt: booking.createdAt, reportedAt,
    });
    const report: PrintReport = { patient: printed, sections: reports.flatMap((r) => this.sections(r, printed)) };
    return this.renderReport(report, { ...o, fileName: o.fileName ?? `${booking.bookingNo}-${o.variant}.${o.format}` });
  }

  private sections(r: DbReport, patient: PrintPatient): Section[] {
    const template = (TEMPLATES as Record<string, (typeof TEMPLATES)[keyof typeof TEMPLATES]>)[r.testCode.toLowerCase()];
    const flag = (f: string | undefined): TestRow["flag"] => (f === "H" ? "high" : f === "L" ? "low" : f === "A" ? "abnormal" : f === "" ? "normal" : "auto");
    if (template) {
      // results match a template row by its key ("hb") or its label ("Haemoglobin (HB)"), ignoring case and punctuation
      const norm = (x: string) => x.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
      const keyOf = new Map<string, string>();
      for (const f of template.fields) {
        keyOf.set(norm(f.key), f.key);
        keyOf.set(norm(f.label), f.key);
      }
      const matched = r.results.flatMap((x) => {
        const key = keyOf.get(norm(x.parameter));
        return key ? [[key, { value: x.value, flag: flag(x.flag), unit: x.unit, range: x.range }] as const] : [];
      });
      if (matched.length === r.results.length && matched.length) return buildReport(patient, [{ template: template.id as never, results: Object.fromEntries(matched) }]).sections;
    }
    const cat = getTestByCode(r.testCode);
    return [{
      title: (cat?.department ?? "LABORATORY").toUpperCase(),
      subtitle: r.testName,
      specimen: cat?.sampleType ?? undefined,
      columns: COLS_STD,
      rows: r.results.map((x): TestRow => ({ kind: "test", name: x.parameter, result: x.value, unit: x.unit, range: x.range, flag: flag(x.flag) })),
    }];
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- rendering

  private async renderReport(report: PrintReport, o: RenderOptions): Promise<RenderedDocument> {
    const name = o.fileName ?? `${report.patient.patientId ?? "report"}-${o.variant}.${o.format}`;
    if (o.format === "html") return htmlDoc(name, await renderReportHtml({ report, variant: o.variant, design: o.design, lab: this.lab, inline: true }));
    return pdfDoc(name, await renderReportPdf({ report, variant: o.variant, design: o.design, lab: this.lab }));
  }

  private async renderInvoice(invoice: PrintInvoice, o: RenderOptions): Promise<RenderedDocument> {
    const name = o.fileName ?? `${invoice.invoiceNo.replaceAll("/", "-")}.${o.format}`;
    if (o.format === "html") return htmlDoc(name, await renderInvoiceHtml({ invoice, variant: o.variant, lab: this.lab, inline: true }));
    return pdfDoc(name, await renderInvoicePdf({ invoice, variant: o.variant, lab: this.lab }));
  }
}

function pdfDoc(fileName: string, pdf: Buffer): RenderedDocument {
  return { format: "pdf", fileName, mimeType: "application/pdf", byteLength: pdf.byteLength, base64: pdf.toString("base64"), html: null };
}

function htmlDoc(fileName: string, html: string): RenderedDocument {
  return { format: "html", fileName, mimeType: "text/html; charset=utf-8", byteLength: Buffer.byteLength(html), base64: null, html };
}

export const assertFormat = (f: string): DocumentFormat => {
  if (f !== "pdf" && f !== "html") throw new ValidationError(`format must be pdf or html`);
  return f;
};
```

## File: src/services/export.service.ts

```ts
import type { Id, Repositories } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import {
  balanceSheetCsv, dayBookCsv, gstr1, gstr1Csv, gstr3b, gstr3bCsv, ledgerCsv, profitAndLossCsv, settlementCsv, trialBalanceCsv,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit";
import type { Actor } from "../graphql/context";

export interface CsvFile {
  fileName: string;
  mimeType: string;
  content: string;
}

const csv = (fileName: string, content: string): CsvFile => ({ fileName, mimeType: "text/csv; charset=utf-8", content });
const day = (d: Date) => d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

/** CSV exports (finance-kit): every file ends with a TOTAL row equal to its report. */
export class ExportService {
  constructor(private readonly repos: Repositories) {}

  async dayBook(actor: Actor, q: { from: Date; to: Date; branchId?: Id | null; bom: boolean }) {
    return csv(`day-book-${day(q.from)}-${day(q.to)}.csv`, await dayBookCsv(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, from: q.from, to: q.to, branchId: q.branchId ?? undefined, bom: q.bom }));
  }

  async ledger(actor: Actor, q: { ledgerId: Id; from: Date; to: Date; branchId?: Id | null; bom: boolean }) {
    return csv(`ledger-${day(q.from)}-${day(q.to)}.csv`, await ledgerCsv(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, ledgerId: q.ledgerId, from: q.from, to: q.to, branchId: q.branchId ?? undefined, bom: q.bom }));
  }

  async trialBalance(actor: Actor, q: { asOf?: Date | null; branchId?: Id | null; bom: boolean }) {
    return csv(`trial-balance${q.asOf ? `-${day(q.asOf)}` : ""}.csv`, await trialBalanceCsv(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, asOf: q.asOf ?? undefined, branchId: q.branchId ?? undefined, bom: q.bom }));
  }

  async profitAndLoss(actor: Actor, q: { from: Date; to: Date; branchId?: Id | null; bom: boolean }) {
    return csv(`profit-and-loss-${day(q.from)}-${day(q.to)}.csv`, await profitAndLossCsv(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, from: q.from, to: q.to, branchId: q.branchId ?? undefined, bom: q.bom }));
  }

  async balanceSheet(actor: Actor, q: { asOf: Date; branchId?: Id | null; bom: boolean }) {
    return csv(`balance-sheet-${day(q.asOf)}.csv`, await balanceSheetCsv(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, asOf: q.asOf, branchId: q.branchId ?? undefined, bom: q.bom }));
  }

  async settlement(actor: Actor, q: { settlementId: Id; bom: boolean }) {
    return csv(`settlement-${q.settlementId}.csv`, await settlementCsv(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, settlementId: q.settlementId, bom: q.bom }));
  }

  /** One file per GSTR-1 section (b2b, b2cl, b2cs, cdnr, cdnur, nil, hsn, docs). */
  async gstr1(actor: Actor, q: { from: Date; to: Date; gstin?: string | null; bom: boolean }) {
    const r = await gstr1(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, from: q.from, to: q.to, gstin: q.gstin ?? undefined });
    return Object.entries(gstr1Csv(r, { bom: q.bom })).map(([section, content]) => csv(`gstr1-${section}-${day(q.from)}-${day(q.to)}.csv`, content));
  }

  async gstr3b(actor: Actor, q: { from: Date; to: Date; gstin?: string | null; bom: boolean }) {
    const r = await gstr3b(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, from: q.from, to: q.to, gstin: q.gstin ?? undefined });
    return csv(`gstr3b-${day(q.from)}-${day(q.to)}.csv`, gstr3bCsv(r, { bom: q.bom }));
  }
}
```

## File: src/services/gst.service.ts

```ts
import type { Id, ItemCategory, Repositories, Taxability } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { addTaxRule, DEFAULT_TAX_RULES, financeConfig, gstr1, gstr3b, seedTaxRules, VERIFY_WITH_CA } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit";
import type { Actor } from "../graphql/context";

export interface TaxRuleInput {
  code?: string | null;
  category?: ItemCategory | null;
  hsnSac: string;
  taxability: Taxability;
  ratePercent: number;
  /** IST day, "2026-04-01". */
  effectiveFrom: string;
  note?: string | null;
}

/**
 * GST through finance-kit: tax rules (configuration, to be verified with the lab's CA), GSTR-1 and
 * GSTR-3B data. Nothing here is legal advice; `verifyWithCA` travels with every return.
 */
export class GstService {
  constructor(private readonly repos: Repositories) {}

  taxRules(actor: Actor) {
    return this.repos.taxRules.find({ orgId: actor.orgId }, { sort: { field: "effectiveFrom", dir: "desc" } });
  }

  addTaxRule(actor: Actor, input: TaxRuleInput) {
    return addTaxRule(this.repos, actor.orgId, { ...input, code: input.code ?? null, category: input.category ?? null, note: input.note ?? undefined }, actor.userId);
  }

  /** finance-kit's starting rules (DEFAULT_TAX_RULES). Every rate is marked "verify with CA". */
  seedTaxRules(actor: Actor) {
    return seedTaxRules(this.repos, actor.orgId, DEFAULT_TAX_RULES, actor.userId);
  }

  config(actor: Actor) {
    return financeConfig(this.repos, actor.orgId);
  }

  verifyWithCA(): readonly string[] {
    return VERIFY_WITH_CA;
  }

  gstr1(actor: Actor, q: { from: Date; to: Date; gstin?: string | null }) {
    return gstr1(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, from: q.from, to: q.to, gstin: q.gstin ?? undefined });
  }

  gstr3b(actor: Actor, q: { from: Date; to: Date; gstin?: string | null }) {
    return gstr3b(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, from: q.from, to: q.to, gstin: q.gstin ?? undefined });
  }
}
```

```ts
import type { Auth } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/auth-kit";
import type { Repositories } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import type { LabProfile } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { AuthService, type Mailer } from "./auth.service";
import { BillingService } from "./billing.service";
import { BookingService } from "./booking.service";
import { BooksService } from "./books.service";
import { CashBankService } from "./cash-bank.service";
import { CatalogService } from "./catalog.service";
import { DocumentService } from "./document.service";
import { ExportService } from "./export.service";
import { GstService } from "./gst.service";
import { JobService } from "./job.service";
import type { JobQueue } from "../jobs/types";
import { OrganizationService } from "./organization.service";
import { PatientService } from "./patient.service";
import { PeriodService } from "./period.service";
import { ReceivablesService } from "./receivables.service";
import { ReportService } from "./report.service";
import { SettlementService } from "./settlement.service";

export interface ServiceDeps {
  repos: Repositories;
  auth: Auth;
  mailer?: Mailer;
  resetUrl: string | null;
  lab?: LabProfile;
  samples: boolean;
  /** The job queue (BullMQ or inline); a getter because the inline queue needs the services first. */
  jobs: () => JobQueue;
}

/** Every service, one instance each. Services know nothing about GraphQL; controllers call them. */
export function createServices(d: ServiceDeps) {
  return {
    auth: new AuthService(d.repos, d.auth, { mailer: d.mailer, resetUrl: d.resetUrl, jobs: d.jobs }),
    organization: new OrganizationService(d.repos),
    catalog: new CatalogService(),
    patients: new PatientService(d.repos),
    bookings: new BookingService(d.repos),
    reports: new ReportService(d.repos),
    billing: new BillingService(d.repos),
    books: new BooksService(d.repos),
    gst: new GstService(d.repos),
    receivables: new ReceivablesService(d.repos),
    settlements: new SettlementService(d.repos),
    cashBank: new CashBankService(d.repos),
    periods: new PeriodService(d.repos),
    exports: new ExportService(d.repos),
    documents: new DocumentService(d.repos, { lab: d.lab, samples: d.samples }),
    jobs: new JobService(d.repos, d.jobs),
  };
}

export type Services = ReturnType<typeof createServices>;
export type { Mailer };
```

## File: src/services/job.service.ts

```ts
import type { Id, Repositories } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import type { Actor } from "../graphql/context";
import type { DocumentJob, JobInfo, JobQueue } from "../jobs/types";
import type { RenderOptions } from "./document.service";
import { mustOwn } from "./util";

/** Background work started from the API: documents rendered by the worker, read back by their owner. */
export class JobService {
  constructor(
    private readonly repos: Repositories,
    private readonly queue: () => JobQueue,
  ) {}

  /** Queues a stored invoice for rendering. The caller has checked `invoice:read` on its branch. */
  async invoiceDocument(actor: Actor, invoiceId: Id, options: RenderOptions): Promise<JobInfo> {
    mustOwn(await this.repos.invoices.get(invoiceId), actor.orgId, "Invoice", invoiceId);
    return this.queue().document({ kind: "invoice", actor, invoiceId, options });
  }

  /** Queues a booking's reports for rendering. The caller has checked `report:read` on its branch. */
  async bookingReports(actor: Actor, bookingId: Id, reportIds: Id[] | null, options: RenderOptions): Promise<JobInfo> {
    mustOwn(await this.repos.bookings.get(bookingId), actor.orgId, "Booking", bookingId);
    return this.queue().document({ kind: "booking_reports", actor, bookingId, reportIds, options } satisfies DocumentJob);
  }

  /** A job of this user; null when unknown, expired, or started by someone else. */
  async get(actor: Actor, id: string): Promise<JobInfo | null> {
    const job = await this.queue().get(id);
    return job && job.actor.userId === actor.userId && job.actor.orgId === actor.orgId ? job : null;
  }

  mode() {
    return this.queue().mode;
  }
}
```

## File: src/services/organization.service.ts

```ts
import { ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationError, type Address, type Branch, type BranchKind, type Id, type Repositories } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { isValidGstin } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit";
import type { Actor } from "../graphql/context";
import { clean, mustOwn } from "./util";

export interface BranchInput {
  code: string;
  name: string;
  kind: BranchKind;
  phone?: string | null;
  gstin?: string | null;
  stateCode?: string | null;
  address?: Address | null;
  active?: boolean | null;
}

export interface OrganizationPatch {
  name?: string | null;
  legalName?: string | null;
  gstin?: string | null;
  phone?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
  address?: Address | null;
}

const checkGstin = (g?: string | null) => {
  if (g && !isValidGstin(g)) throw new ValidationError(`Invalid GSTIN ${g}`);
};

/** The signed-in user's organisation and its branches. */
export class OrganizationService {
  constructor(private readonly repos: Repositories) {}

  async organization(actor: Actor) {
    const org = await this.repos.orgs.get(actor.orgId);
    if (!org) throw new NotFoundError("Organization", actor.orgId);
    return org;
  }

  async updateOrganization(actor: Actor, patch: OrganizationPatch) {
    checkGstin(patch.gstin);
    const org = await this.repos.orgs.update(actor.orgId, clean(patch) as never);
    await this.repos.audit.log({ orgId: actor.orgId, userId: actor.userId, action: "org.update", entity: "organization", entityId: actor.orgId });
    return org!;
  }

  branches(actor: Actor): Promise<Branch[]> {
    return this.repos.branches.find({ orgId: actor.orgId }, { sort: { field: "code" } });
  }

  async branch(actor: Actor, id: Id) {
    return mustOwn(await this.repos.branches.get(id), actor.orgId, "Branch", id);
  }

  async createBranch(actor: Actor, input: BranchInput) {
    checkGstin(input.gstin);
    const code = input.code.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!/^[A-Z0-9]{2,12}$/.test(code)) throw new ValidationError("Branch code: 2-12 letters or digits");
    if (await this.repos.branches.findOne({ orgId: actor.orgId, code })) throw new ConflictError(`Branch ${code} already exists`);
    const b = await this.repos.branches.create({ ...(clean(input) as BranchInput), orgId: actor.orgId, code, active: input.active ?? true } as never);
    await this.repos.audit.log({ orgId: actor.orgId, branchId: b.id, userId: actor.userId, action: "branch.create", entity: "branch", entityId: b.id });
    return b as Branch;
  }

  async updateBranch(actor: Actor, id: Id, patch: Partial<Omit<BranchInput, "code">>) {
    mustOwn(await this.repos.branches.get(id), actor.orgId, "Branch", id);
    checkGstin(patch.gstin);
    const b = await this.repos.branches.update(id, clean(patch) as never);
    await this.repos.audit.log({ orgId: actor.orgId, branchId: id, userId: actor.userId, action: "branch.update", entity: "branch", entityId: id });
    return b!;
  }

  /** Audit trail, newest first. */
  audit(actor: Actor, q: { entity?: string | null; entityId?: Id | null; limit: number; offset: number }) {
    return this.repos.audit.find(clean({ orgId: actor.orgId, entity: q.entity, entityId: q.entityId }) as never, { limit: q.limit, offset: q.offset, sort: { field: "at", dir: "desc" } });
  }
}
```

## File: src/services/patient.service.ts

```ts
import { registerPatient, type Address, type Doctor, type Id, type Patient, type Repositories, type Sex } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import type { Actor } from "../graphql/context";
import { clean, mustOwn, owned } from "./util";

export interface RegisterPatientInput {
  branchId: Id;
  title?: string | null;
  name: string;
  sex: Sex;
  dob?: Date | null;
  ageYears?: number | null;
  phone?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
  address?: Address | null;
}

export interface DoctorInput {
  name: string;
  qualification?: string | null;
  phone?: string | null;
  clinic?: string | null;
  active?: boolean | null;
}

/** Patients (UHID per organisation) and referring doctors. */
export class PatientService {
  constructor(private readonly repos: Repositories) {}

  async get(actor: Actor, id: Id): Promise<Patient | null> {
    return owned(await this.repos.patients.get(id), actor.orgId);
  }

  search(actor: Actor, text: string, limit: number) {
    return this.repos.patients.search(actor.orgId, text, limit);
  }

  async register(actor: Actor, input: RegisterPatientInput) {
    mustOwn(await this.repos.branches.get(input.branchId), actor.orgId, "Branch", input.branchId);
    return registerPatient(this.repos, { ...(clean(input) as RegisterPatientInput), orgId: actor.orgId } as never, actor.userId);
  }

  async update(actor: Actor, id: Id, patch: Partial<Omit<RegisterPatientInput, "branchId">>) {
    mustOwn(await this.repos.patients.get(id), actor.orgId, "Patient", id);
    const p = await this.repos.patients.update(id, clean(patch) as never);
    await this.repos.audit.log({ orgId: actor.orgId, userId: actor.userId, action: "patient.update", entity: "patient", entityId: id });
    return p!;
  }

  doctors(actor: Actor, activeOnly: boolean): Promise<Doctor[]> {
    return this.repos.doctors.find(activeOnly ? { orgId: actor.orgId, active: true } : { orgId: actor.orgId }, { sort: { field: "name" } });
  }

  async createDoctor(actor: Actor, input: DoctorInput) {
    return this.repos.doctors.create({ ...(clean(input) as DoctorInput), orgId: actor.orgId, active: input.active ?? true } as never);
  }

  async updateDoctor(actor: Actor, id: Id, patch: Partial<DoctorInput>) {
    mustOwn(await this.repos.doctors.get(id), actor.orgId, "Doctor", id);
    return (await this.repos.doctors.update(id, clean(patch) as never))!;
  }
}
```

## File: src/services/receivables.service.ts

```ts
import type { Address, CustomerKind, Id, Repositories } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { createCustomer, customerStatement, issueCreditNote, issueCustomerInvoice, receivablesSummary, updateCustomer } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit";
import type { Actor } from "../graphql/context";
import { invoiceItem, type IssueInvoiceInput } from "./billing.service";
import { clean, mustOwn } from "./util";

export interface CustomerInput {
  code: string;
  name: string;
  kind: CustomerKind;
  legalName?: string | null;
  gstin?: string | null;
  stateCode?: string | null;
  pan?: string | null;
  phone?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
  address?: Address | null;
  creditLimitPaise?: number | null;
  creditDays?: number | null;
}

export interface CustomerInvoiceInput extends Omit<IssueInvoiceInput, "applyTaxRules"> {
  customerId: Id;
  placeOfSupply?: string | null;
  /** Default true: GST from the tax rules. */
  applyTaxRules?: boolean | null;
}

/** B2B receivables (hospitals, insurers, TPAs, corporates) and credit notes, through finance-kit. */
export class ReceivablesService {
  constructor(private readonly repos: Repositories) {}

  customers(actor: Actor, activeOnly: boolean) {
    return this.repos.customers.find(activeOnly ? { orgId: actor.orgId, active: true } : { orgId: actor.orgId }, { sort: { field: "code" } });
  }

  async customer(actor: Actor, id: Id) {
    return mustOwn(await this.repos.customers.get(id), actor.orgId, "Customer", id);
  }

  createCustomer(actor: Actor, input: CustomerInput) {
    return createCustomer(this.repos, { ...(clean(input) as CustomerInput), orgId: actor.orgId } as never, actor.userId);
  }

  updateCustomer(actor: Actor, id: Id, patch: Partial<Omit<CustomerInput, "code">> & { active?: boolean | null }) {
    // creditLimitPaise: null means "no limit", so it is passed through when present
    const p = clean(patch) as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (patch.creditLimitPaise === null) p.creditLimitPaise = null;
    return updateCustomer(this.repos, { ...p, orgId: actor.orgId, customerId: id } as never, actor.userId);
  }

  async issueInvoice(actor: Actor, input: CustomerInvoiceInput) {
    const { invoice } = await issueCustomerInvoice(this.repos, {
      orgId: actor.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, patientId: input.patientId, bookingId: input.bookingId ?? null, customerId: input.customerId,
      items: input.items.map(invoiceItem), billDiscountPaise: input.billDiscountPaise ?? 0,
      payments: input.payments?.map((p) => clean(p)) as never, placeOfSupply: input.placeOfSupply ?? undefined, applyTaxRules: input.applyTaxRules ?? true,
    }, actor.userId);
    return invoice;
  }

  statement(actor: Actor, q: { customerId: Id; from: Date; to: Date }) {
    return customerStatement(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, ...q });
  }

  summary(actor: Actor, asOf: Date) {
    return receivablesSummary(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, asOf });
  }

  async creditNote(actor: Actor, id: Id) {
    return mustOwn(await this.repos.creditNotes.get(id), actor.orgId, "Credit note", id);
  }

  creditNotes(actor: Actor, q: { invoiceId?: Id | null; customerId?: Id | null; limit: number; offset: number }) {
    return this.repos.creditNotes.find(clean({ orgId: actor.orgId, invoiceId: q.invoiceId, customerId: q.customerId }) as never, { limit: q.limit, offset: q.offset, sort: { field: "date", dir: "desc" } });
  }

  issueCreditNote(actor: Actor, input: { invoiceId: Id; reason: string; lines?: { itemIndex: number; taxablePaise?: number | null }[] | null; date?: Date | null }) {
    return issueCreditNote(this.repos, {
      orgId: actor.orgId, invoiceId: input.invoiceId, reason: input.reason, date: input.date ?? undefined,
      lines: input.lines?.map((l) => clean(l) as { itemIndex: number; taxablePaise?: number }),
    }, actor.userId);
  }
}
```

## File: src/services/report.service.ts

```ts
import { flagResult, formatRange, getTestByCode, type Sex as CatalogSex } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/catalog-kit";
import { ConflictError, saveResults, transitionReport, ValidationError, type Booking, type Id, type Report, type Repositories, type ResultValue, type Sex } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import type { Actor } from "../graphql/context";
import { mustOwn } from "./util";

const catalogSex = (s: Sex): CatalogSex | undefined => (s === "male" || s === "female" ? s : undefined);

/**
 * Fills unit, range and flag from catalog-kit when the report's test is in the catalog and the
 * result does not carry them. Values sent explicitly are kept (the pathologist has the last word).
 */
export function withCatalogDefaults(testCode: string, results: ResultValue[], sex: Sex): ResultValue[] {
  const test = getTestByCode(testCode);
  if (!test) return results;
  const byName = new Map(test.parameters.filter((p) => p.name).map((p) => [p.name!.trim().toLowerCase(), p]));
  return results.map((r) => {
    const p = byName.get(r.parameter.trim().toLowerCase());
    if (!p) return r;
    const out: ResultValue = { ...r };
    if (out.unit == null && p.unit) out.unit = p.unit;
    if (out.range == null) {
      const range = formatRange(p, catalogSex(sex));
      if (range) out.range = range;
    }
    const n = Number(r.value);
    if (out.flag == null && p.type === "numeric" && r.value.trim() !== "" && Number.isFinite(n)) out.flag = flagResult(p, n, catalogSex(sex));
    return out;
  });
}

/** Results entry and the report workflow: draft → entered → verified → released (→ amended → verified). */
export class ReportService {
  constructor(private readonly repos: Repositories) {}

  async get(actor: Actor, id: Id) {
    return mustOwn(await this.repos.reports.get(id), actor.orgId, "Report", id);
  }

  ofBooking(bookingId: Id) {
    return this.repos.reports.find({ bookingId });
  }

  async create(actor: Actor, booking: Booking, testCode: string, testName?: string | null) {
    const t = booking.tests.find((x) => x.testCode === testCode);
    if (!t) throw new ValidationError(`Test ${testCode} is not in booking ${booking.bookingNo}`);
    const existing = await this.repos.reports.findOne({ bookingId: booking.id, testCode });
    if (existing) throw new ConflictError(`Booking ${booking.bookingNo} already has a ${testCode} report`);
    const r = await this.repos.reports.create({
      orgId: booking.orgId, branchId: booking.branchId, bookingId: booking.id, patientId: booking.patientId,
      testCode, testName: testName ?? t.name, results: [], status: "draft", version: 1,
    } as never);
    await this.repos.audit.log({ orgId: actor.orgId, branchId: booking.branchId, userId: actor.userId, action: "report.create", entity: "report", entityId: r.id });
    return r as Report;
  }

  async saveResults(actor: Actor, report: Report, results: ResultValue[]) {
    const patient = await this.repos.patients.get(report.patientId);
    return saveResults(this.repos, report.id, withCatalogDefaults(report.testCode, results, patient?.sex ?? "other"), actor.userId);
  }

  verify(actor: Actor, report: Report) {
    return transitionReport(this.repos, report.id, "verified", actor.userId);
  }

  /** Releasing the last report of a booking completes the booking. */
  async release(actor: Actor, report: Report) {
    const out = await transitionReport(this.repos, report.id, "released", actor.userId);
    const all = await this.repos.reports.find({ bookingId: report.bookingId });
    if (all.every((x) => x.status === "released")) await this.repos.bookings.update(report.bookingId, { status: "completed" });
    return out;
  }

  amend(actor: Actor, report: Report) {
    return transitionReport(this.repos, report.id, "amended", actor.userId);
  }
}
```

## File: src/services/settlement.service.ts

```ts
import type { Address, AgreementKind, Id, ItemCategory, PartnerKind, PaymentMode, Repositories, SettlementDeduction, SettlementStatus } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import {
  accrueSettlement, addAgreement, cancelSettlement, computeSettlement, createPartner, createSettlement, paySettlement, updatePartner,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/finance-kit";
import type { Actor } from "../graphql/context";
import { clean, mustOwn } from "./util";

export interface PartnerInput {
  code: string;
  name: string;
  kind: PartnerKind;
  branchId: Id;
  legalName?: string | null;
  pan?: string | null;
  gstin?: string | null;
  stateCode?: string | null;
  phone?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
  address?: Address | null;
  /** Overrides the default TDS (e.g. a lower-deduction certificate). Verify with CA. */
  tds?: { section: string; rateBp: number } | null;
}

export interface AgreementInput {
  partnerId: Id;
  kind: AgreementKind;
  shareBp?: number | null;
  rates?: { code: string; sharePaise: number }[] | null;
  defaultSharePaise?: number | null;
  categories?: ItemCategory[] | null;
  effectiveFrom: string;
  effectiveTo?: string | null;
  notes?: string | null;
}

/**
 * Collection-centre and franchise settlements with TDS, through finance-kit. No doctor referral
 * commissions: settlements are for collection centres and franchises only.
 */
export class SettlementService {
  constructor(private readonly repos: Repositories) {}

  partners(actor: Actor, q: { branchIds: "all" | Id[] }) {
    return this.repos.partners.find({ orgId: actor.orgId }, { sort: { field: "code" } }).then((all) => (q.branchIds === "all" ? all : all.filter((p) => (q.branchIds as Id[]).includes(p.branchId))));
  }

  async partner(actor: Actor, id: Id) {
    return mustOwn(await this.repos.partners.get(id), actor.orgId, "Partner", id);
  }

  createPartner(actor: Actor, input: PartnerInput) {
    return createPartner(this.repos, { ...(clean(input) as PartnerInput), tds: input.tds ?? undefined, orgId: actor.orgId } as never, actor.userId);
  }

  updatePartner(actor: Actor, id: Id, patch: Partial<Omit<PartnerInput, "code" | "branchId">> & { active?: boolean | null }) {
    const p = clean(patch) as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (patch.tds === null) p.tds = null; // back to the default TDS
    return updatePartner(this.repos, { ...p, orgId: actor.orgId, partnerId: id } as never, actor.userId);
  }

  agreements(partnerId: Id) {
    return this.repos.partnerAgreements.find({ partnerId }, { sort: { field: "effectiveFrom", dir: "desc" } });
  }

  addAgreement(actor: Actor, input: AgreementInput) {
    return addAgreement(this.repos, { ...(clean(input) as AgreementInput), orgId: actor.orgId } as never, actor.userId);
  }

  compute(actor: Actor, q: { partnerId: Id; period: string; deductions?: SettlementDeduction[] | null }) {
    return computeSettlement(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, partnerId: q.partnerId, period: q.period, deductions: q.deductions ?? undefined });
  }

  async settlement(actor: Actor, id: Id) {
    return mustOwn(await this.repos.settlements.get(id), actor.orgId, "Settlement", id);
  }

  settlements(actor: Actor, q: { partnerId?: Id | null; status?: SettlementStatus | null; branchIds: "all" | Id[]; limit: number; offset: number }) {
    const filter = clean({ orgId: actor.orgId, partnerId: q.partnerId, status: q.status }) as never;
    return this.repos.settlements.find(filter, { limit: q.limit + q.offset, sort: { field: "createdAt", dir: "desc" } }).then((all) =>
      (q.branchIds === "all" ? all : all.filter((s) => (q.branchIds as Id[]).includes(s.branchId))).slice(q.offset, q.offset + q.limit),
    );
  }

  create(actor: Actor, q: { partnerId: Id; period: string; deductions?: SettlementDeduction[] | null }) {
    return createSettlement(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, partnerId: q.partnerId, period: q.period, deductions: q.deductions ?? undefined }, actor.userId);
  }

  accrue(actor: Actor, settlementId: Id) {
    return accrueSettlement(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, settlementId }, actor.userId);
  }

  pay(actor: Actor, q: { settlementId: Id; mode: PaymentMode; date?: Date | null; reference?: string | null }) {
    return paySettlement(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, settlementId: q.settlementId, mode: q.mode, date: q.date ?? undefined, reference: q.reference ?? undefined }, actor.userId);
  }

  cancel(actor: Actor, settlementId: Id) {
    return cancelSettlement(this.repos, { orgId: actor.orgId, settlementId }, actor.userId);
  }
}
```

## File: src/services/util.ts

```ts
import { NotFoundError, type Id, type Repo } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";

/** The entity when it belongs to `orgId`, otherwise null (tenant isolation). */
export const owned = <T extends { orgId: Id }>(entity: T | null | undefined, orgId: Id): T | null => (entity && entity.orgId === orgId ? entity : null);

/** The entity when it belongs to `orgId`; NotFoundError otherwise (another organisation's data looks absent). */
export function mustOwn<T extends { orgId: Id }>(entity: T | null | undefined, orgId: Id, what: string, id: Id): T {
  const e = owned(entity, orgId);
  if (!e) throw new NotFoundError(what, id);
  return e;
}

/** Drops undefined and null values (partial updates). */
export const clean = <T extends object>(o: T): Partial<T> =>
  Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(o).filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null)) as Partial<T>;

/** Branch-aware list: all branches, or a merge of each allowed branch, newest first. */
export async function scopedFind<T extends { id: Id }>(
  repo: Repo<T>,
  filter: Record<string, unknown>,
  scope: "all" | Id[],
  limit: number,
  offset: number,
  sortField: string,
): Promise<T[]> {
  const sort = { field: sortField as keyof T & string, dir: "desc" as const };
  if (scope === "all") return repo.find(filter as never, { limit, offset, sort });
  const lists = await Promise.all(scope.map((b) => repo.find({ ...filter, branchId: b } as never, { limit: limit + offset, sort })));
  const key = (x: T) => +((x as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] as Date);
  return lists.flat().sort((a, b) => key(b) - key(a)).slice(offset, offset + limit);
}
```

## File: src/worker.ts

```ts
// Starts the background worker: `npm run worker:dev` (watch) or `npm run build && npm run worker`.
// Same configuration as the API; REDIS_URL is required. Run as many workers as you like.
import { loadConfig } from "./config/env";
import { createContainer } from "./container";
import { startWorkers } from "./jobs";

const config = loadConfig();
if (!config.redisUrl) {
  console.error("[worker] REDIS_URL is required: the worker takes its jobs from Redis (BullMQ)");
  process.exit(1);
}
if (config.env === "production" && !config.smtp && !config.mailWebhookUrl) console.warn("[worker] neither SMTP_URL nor MAIL_WEBHOOK_URL is set: password-reset links are not sent");
const container = await createContainer({ config });
const workers = startWorkers(container.jobDeps, { redisUrl: config.redisUrl, prefix: config.jobs.prefix, keepResultsMs: config.jobs.keepResultsMs, concurrency: config.jobs.concurrency });
console.log(`[worker] queues ${workers.workers.map((w) => w.name).join(", ")} on ${config.jobs.prefix}: (concurrency ${config.jobs.concurrency}, ${config.db.backend})`);

for (const signal of ["SIGINT", "SIGTERM"] as const) {
  process.once(signal, () => {
    // finish the jobs in hand, then stop
    workers.close().then(() => container.close()).then(() => process.exit(0), () => process.exit(1));
  });
}
```

```ts
// End-to-end tests: the real server (Fastify + Yoga) over HTTP inject, real auth-kit sessions, real

import { spawn, type ChildProcess } from "node:child_process";

let passed = 0;

  else failed++;
  console.log(`${cond ? "✓" : "✗"} ${msg}`);

type Gql = { data?: any; errors?: { message: string; extensions?: { code?: string } }[] };

async function suite(db: Db, tag: string) {
  console.log(`\n[${tag}]`);

  let patientBatches = 0;
  const repos: Repositories = { ...db.repos, patients: { ...db.repos.patients, getMany: (ids) => { patientBatches++; return db.repos.patients.getMany(ids); } } };

    const out = res.json() as Gql;
    if (process.env.DEBUG && out.errors) console.log("   ", JSON.stringify(out.errors).slice(0, 400));
    return out;
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- setup: two organisations, auth-kit roles

  const other = await seedOrganization(db.rawRepos, { org: { name: "Other Lab", code: "OTH" }, branch: { code: "Z01", name: "Z", stateCode: "22" }, owner: { name: "X", email: "x@oth.test", passwordHash: await hashPassword(pw) }, roles: SYSTEM_ROLES });

  const owner = await login("owner@apl.test");

  ok(branchB?.code === "B01", `[${tag}] createBranch (code upper-cased)`);

  const cbc = cat.data?.catalogSearch[0]?.test;

  const rep = await gql(owner, 'mutation($b: ID!) { createReport(bookingId: $b, testCode: "CBC") { id status testName } }', { b: booking.booking.id });
  const reportId = rep.data?.createReport.id;
```
